novel_info.title: Evolving infinitely from ground zero
novel_info.author: Bamboo City's Little Overlord
novel_info.summary: 【Infant Stage, a cumulative total of 10,000 leg kicks】【Attribute gained: Use It or Lose It】【As long as you continuously exercise the same body part, that part can evolve infinitely, but it can’t break the limits of carbon-based lifeforms】【……】【Student Phase, a cumulative total of 100 million characters read】【Attribute gained: Heavenly Intellect】【Photographic memory, learning ability reached the pinnacle of humanity】【……】【Adult Stage, a cumulative matching of carbon-based lifeforms’ limits 100 times】【Attribute gained: Multi-form】【The body is no longer limited to the frailty of carbon-based lifeforms’ flesh and blood, capable of evolving beyond life forms】【……】Having transmigrated, Lin Zichen was born with an achievement-based cheat.In this life, he only wanted to evolve quietly, continuously breaking through the limits of life forms, and savoring the pleasure that comes with the leveling-up process.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 - 1: 1. Use It or Lose It
chapters.content:
"Baby, you must be starving. Here, let Mommy feed you some milk."
A gentle female voice spoke up.
The next moment, Lin Zichen felt something soft being placed in his mouth, and he instinctively began to suck.
Being just over a month old, his mind had some awareness, but not much.
All he knew was to cry when hungry and sleep when full.
His thoughts were mostly chaotic, without the capacity for complete reasoning.
[Energy +1]
[Energy +1]
[Energy +1]
[...]
As he sucked more and more breast milk, Lin Zichen suddenly felt his head itch, as if his brain was starting to grow.
Following that, a character panel slowly emerged from the void.
[Name: Lin Zichen]
[Age: 33 days]
[Biological Level: Normal (Tier 1)]
[Biometric Attributes: None]
Looking at the panel in the void, Lin Zichen finally realized something.
He had transmigrated.
He had transmigrated into an infant whose brain hadn't fully developed yet.
And he had acquired a golden finger.
After pondering these things for a while, Lin Zichen felt very tired and soon fell into a deep sleep.
"This little guy falls asleep as soon as he's full, truly enviable. Mommy has had many sleepless nights taking care of you," the woman murmured lovingly as she looked at Lin Zichen sleeping peacefully in her arms.
...
In the blink of an eye, over two months had passed.
Over these days, Lin Zichen's consciousness had become much clearer and he had a more complete ability to think.
The first thing he did with his new brain was to study his golden finger.
He learned that it was an achievement-oriented golden finger and had triggered his first achievement task.
[Achievement: Accumulate 10,000 leg kicks]
[Reward: Gain Biometric Attribute—Use It or Lose It]
[Total leg kicks: 1024/10000]
Lin Zichen glanced at the progress bar and quietly lay in his crib, kicking his legs.
"Baby, kicking your legs again."
"When did you wake up?"
"You woke up without crying or fussing, truly a baby that gives Mommy peace of mind."
Mother Zhang Wanxin entered the room, saw Lin Zichen lying quietly in his crib kicking his legs, and her face lit up with a relieved smile.
Lin Zichen smiled back at her.
Soon, his father Lin Yansheng also came in, full of expectation:
"Little guy is so lively, you can tell he has a natural talent for physical ability. Surely he'll grow up to be a lofty Genetic Integrator or, at the very least, a Mechanically Modified Human."
Genetic Integrator?
Mechanically Modified Human?
What are these things?
Lin Zichen's brow furrowed slightly, realizing that this world was quite different from his previous one.
...
Before he knew it, another month had passed.
In the last month, Lin Zichen managed to kick an average of 300 times a day and finally completed the 10,000 kicks.
[Accumulated 10,000 kicks, achievement reached]
[Gained Biometric Attribute: Use It or Lose It]
[Use It or Lose It: As long as you continuously and relentlessly train the same body part, that part can evolve and strengthen indefinitely, though it cannot break the limits of carbon-based lifeforms]
After reading the content, Lin Zichen immediately started kicking his legs, eager to experience the effects of Use It or Lose It.
[You are kicking, Qi-Blood +1, leg muscle strength +1, leg kicking proficiency +1]
The moment the notification appeared, Lin Zichen distinctly felt a surge of strength in his legs.
Excited, he kicked even harder.
When tired of kicking, he switched to waving his arms.
[You are waving, Qi-Blood +1, arm muscle strength +1, arm waving proficiency +1]
When his arms also became fatigued, he switched to twisting his body to get all his muscles moving and to achieve a full-body workout.
Thus, a week passed.
Lin Zichen's body had grown much stronger. He could now sit up on his own in the crib, no longer having to lie in bed and stare at the ceiling as before.
Under normal circumstances, infants usually manage to sit up on their own at around seven months.
Yet here he was, just over four months old, already capable of doing so.
...
In the following half month,
Lin Zichen specifically exercised his limbs and quickly mastered crawling.
[You are crawling, Qi-Blood +1, body coordination +1, crawling proficiency +1]
To avoid seeming too supernatural, too contrary to human nature, and thereby attracting unnecessary trouble,
Lin Zichen did not reveal his ability to crawl in front of his parents.
He only sneakily got out of bed and crawled on the floor when his parents were asleep at night.
Crawling faster than the cockroaches in the house.
Rapidly crawling back and forth in the dark corners.
...
A month later, Lin Zichen also learned how to walk.
[You are walking, Qi-Blood +1, body coordination +1, walking proficiency +1]
Meanwhile, he gathered a preliminary understanding of his world through watching the news on TV.
Humans were still on Earth, but Earth had mutated, spawning many terrifying unknown creatures.
These unknown creatures were collectively called Exotic Beasts.
To counter the Exotic Beasts, humanity had developed two paths over decades.
One, gene modification, integrating Exotic Beast genes to acquire some of their abilities, using magic to defeat magic.
Two, the weakness of flesh and bone, ascension through technology, using technology to conquer the Exotic Beasts.
And these two paths corresponded to the Genetic Integrators and the Mechanically Modified Humans.
"This world is so dangerous, I hope I can grow up safely, focus on evolving without any accidents,"
Lin Zichen hoped to himself.
...
Half a month later,
Lin Zichen's walking grew more proficient, and it seemed he would soon learn to run.
Most infants tend to learn walking around one year of age.
Yet here he was, only six months old and almost ready to run, indeed crushing dimensions.
"In the blink of an eye, I'm over six months old. I can crawl in front of my parents now, no need to hide anymore,"
he thought to himself.
Soon, Lin Zichen was showing off his crawling prowess in front of his parents.
"Honey, look, Chen Chen can crawl now, and he's so fast!"
Zhang Wanxin exclaimed in surprise.
Lin Yansheng was equally surprised, but more excited and thrilled, his face covered in smiles, "Just over six months old and he can crawl, and so fast, our son is a genius!"
"Ding dong!"
Suddenly, the doorbell at home rang.
Lin Yansheng went to check and found it was the neighbors who had just moved in a few days ago, coming over with a gift to visit.
Hearing the noise at the door, Zhang Wanxin picked up Lin Zichen, who was crawling around on the floor, and went to meet the new neighbors as well.
The visitors were a young couple.
The man was holding a gift while the woman cradled a baby girl in her arms.
Lin Yansheng accepted the gift and warmly invited the young couple to come in and sit.
Soon, both families sat down in the house, drinking tea and chatting merrily.
During the chat, they discovered that their children were born just a day apart, quite serendipitously.
Lin Zichen sat on Zhang Wanxin's lap, curiously sizing up the baby girl who was born a day later than he was.
Her eyes were big, watery, and very cute.
The baby girl was also curiously looking at him, bursting into a radiant smile whenever their eyes met.
Finding the adults' conversation boring, Lin Zichen struggled a bit in Zhang Wanxin's embrace, prompting his mother to let him down.
Zhang Wanxin got the hint, smiled, and said he was really active before putting him down on the floor.
Once on the floor, Lin Zichen quickly began crawling around, exercising his body.
[You crawled 10 meters, Qi-Blood +1, body coordination +1, crawling proficiency +1]
[You crawled 100 meters, Qi-Blood +10, body coordination +10, crawling proficiency +10]
[You crawled 500 meters...]
Lin Zichen crawled so fast, darting around the room like a mouse.
The baby girl's mother, witnessing this, was amazed, "That's incredible, your baby learned to crawl so quickly. My Han Han just learned to sit by herself."
Seeing the surprise on the other's face, Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin felt a bit smug, thinking it was great to have a genius son.
...
PS: Putting out a bowl, seeking monthly pass, recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 2: 2. Astute in Judging People
chapters.content:
[You were running, Qi-Blood +1, body coordination +1, running speed +1, running technique +1]
[You were jumping, Qi-Blood +1, leg muscle strength +1, jumping height +1, jumping technique +1]
[You were talking to yourself, Spirit +1, language ability +1, expression ability +1...]
Half a month had passed before he knew it.
Under the "Use It or Lose It" effect, Lin Zichen had mastered basic skills such as running, jumping, and speaking.
Although he had already mastered many skills, at only 7 months old, he dared not show off too much in front of his parents.
He worried that appearing too extraordinary could potentially bring about a lot of unnecessary trouble.
Let's not even discuss extreme scenarios like being studied.
At the very least, appearing on variety shows, becoming an internet celebrity, and participating in all sorts of competitions were definitely on the cards.
Lin Zichen just wanted to evolve quietly and didn't want to spend too much energy on other things.
Of course, showing off as a genius a little to make his parents happy was still okay.
"Chenchen, come, mom will take you to play at Han Han's sister's house."
Zhang Wanxin picked up Lin Zichen from the ground, her face beaming with a smile as she kissed him on the cheek.
The Han Han sister she mentioned was the baby girl living next door.
It was said that she was taking her son to play with the baby girl, but it was more about her wanting to chat with the baby girl's mother.
The two mommies were of similar age, both liked dressing up, and talked about celebrity gossip.
After visiting each other a few times, they quickly became confidantes who could talk about anything.
Arriving at the neighbor's house, Zhang Wanxin placed Lin Zichen next to the baby girl, then sat on the couch laughing and talking with the baby's mother.
When the baby girl saw Lin Zichen, her face lit up with a smile, and she reached out to touch him, wanting to make physical contact.
Lin Zichen had no interest in playing with a baby.
He quickly crawled away.
He moved around the neighbor's house to exercise his body.
The baby girl also wanted to follow and crawl, but she didn't have enough strength, so she just sat there watching Lin Zichen scurry around like a cockroach.
She seemed to really like Lin Zichen, and every time she saw him crawling in her direction, her eyes would curve into a radiant smile.
"Chenchen, don't just focus on crawling yourself, play with Han Han sister."
Seeing Lin Zichen's knees get dirty from crawling, Zhang Wanxin came forward, picked him up, and put him back next to the baby girl.
To give Zhang Wanxin some face in front of others, Lin Zichen obediently played with the baby girl, acting like a sensible and obedient boy.
The baby girl's mother said enviously, "Wanxin, your Chenchen really listens to you."
"Oh, Han Han is very well-behaved too, and she's so smiley! I wonder how many little boys she'll charm when she grows up," Zhang Wanxin returned the compliment.
While the two mommies were complimenting each other, the baby girl suddenly peed.
She wasn't wearing a diaper but open-crotch pants, and the urine spilled all over the floor.
Seeing the puddle on the floor, the baby girl immediately started clapping her hands in joy, splashing water everywhere.
She was peeing and clapping.
Clapping and laughing.
Having a blast playing by herself.
Lin Zichen couldn't stand it anymore and quickly moved away to avoid getting splashed with urine.
The baby girl's mother said with a bit of a headache, "Are you made of water, little one? You just peed, how come you're peeing again?"
After saying that, she picked up the baby girl and took her into the bathroom to change her pants.
Watching her friend hurry away, Zhang Wanxin felt her role as a mother was really quite breezy.
Caring for other people's babies seemed so troublesome.
Her own baby, apart from the first couple of months when he would wet his pants, hadn't peed his pants in the several months that followed.
Whenever he wanted to pee, he would grunt to notify the adults to take him to pee.
Most importantly, he didn't cry at night, greatly easing his parents' minds.
...
Time flew by.
Another month had passed in the blink of an eye.
By this time, Lin Zichen's body had become robust enough to do push-ups and sit-ups, which was nothing short of miraculous.
The first time he tried doing push-ups, he found it very challenging and did them very slowly.
But after a while, he quickly became proficient.
Watching him move up and down like a pile driver made the baby's crib creak and groan.
It made men feel inferior and women ecstatic.
Just when he was getting into it.
Zhang Wanxin pushed the door open and walked in.
Seeing Lin Zichen doing push-ups vigorously on the crib, her entire world stopped.
For a moment, she thought her eyes were deceiving her.
Instinctively, she started rubbing her eyes.
While Zhang Wanxin was rubbing her eyes, Lin Zichen quickly lay down and pretended to sleep.
"That's strange, did I see that wrong?"
Zhang Wanxin walked up to the side of the crib, turned Lin Zichen over so he was lying down, and muttered to herself somewhat doubtfully.
...
In the days that followed.
Whenever his parents left, Lin Zichen would secretly do push-ups and sit-ups to train.
[You are doing push-ups, Qi-Blood +1, arm muscle strength +1, chest muscle strength +1, push-up proficiency +1]
[You are doing sit-ups, Qi-Blood +1, abdominal muscle strength +1, sit-up proficiency +1]
[...]
After training for a while.
One day, while giving Lin Zichen a bath, Zhang Wanxin was shocked to discover that her little baby had developed abs, and she was completely stunned.
"Husband, something big has happened; come here quickly!"
"What happened?"
Lin Yansheng ran into the bathroom, his face filled with anxiety.
Then… he was stunned too.
"What, what's going on?!"
Looking at the barely visible six-pack on Lin Zichen's body, Lin Yansheng was in disbelief.
How could an eight-month-old baby have abs?
Could it be from crawling around every day, building up his abs?
Lin Yansheng was baffled.
...
That evening.
The family of three sat down for dinner.
Lin Zichen had weaned and was now able to drink some nourishing porridge.
He had a huge appetite, drinking one bowl after another.
It was because he exercised vigorously every day and burned a lot of energy.
His unknowing parents found it incredible that an infant could eat so much.
After dinner.
The family of three sat on the couch watching TV.
The news was on.
There was a report about an attack by Exotic Beasts. The parents watched with worried faces, commenting on how the frequency of these attacks was making the world increasingly dangerous.
Then they saw another report about a child prodigy.
It claimed that in the Capital City, a millennium-old Martial Arts Family had given birth to a naturally gifted child, who at just two years old could lift a 20kg dumbbell with one hand, stunning the entire country.
Lin Yansheng sighed and said, "Those Martial Arts Families in the Capital City have good genes and resources. Their descendants are born prodigies, truly enviable."
Out of a mother's bias for her son, Zhang Wanxin retorted with a face full of disdain, "My Chen Chen is also a prodigy. He will definitely not lose to those so-called family prodigies in the future."
Hearing Zhang Wanxin's words, Lin Zichen silently gave her a thumbs up in his heart, thinking that his mother indeed had a discerning eye.
Afterward, his gaze stayed on the TV screen, watching the prodigy who easily lifted the barbell with one hand, his mind full of thoughts.
A two-year-old lifting a 20kg dumbbell with ease…
A national sensation prodigy…
I wonder if by the time I'm two, I could also easily lift heavy objects like that?
...
PS: Setting up the bowl, asking for Monthly Pass recommendations!

chapters.title: Chapter 3 - 3: Childhood sweethearts
chapters.content:
As he grew older, Lin Zichen began to understand his family background.
They lived in a place called Shanhai City.
Residing in a detached house in an urban village.
Just a simple family of three, with no other relatives.
Both parents were internet novelists with very little social interaction, usually cooped up at home typing away on their keyboards.
Their only social life was the occasional dinner with the family of the baby girl who had just moved in next door.
After several dinner gatherings, Lin Zichen became familiar with the family of the baby girl.
He learned that the baby girl's name was Shen Qinghan, and her parents were both teachers; her mother was Xu Meng, and her father was Shen Jianye.
Beyond that, he didn't know much else.
...
That day.
Lin Zichen celebrated his second birthday.
Right after the celebration, the first thing he did was to find a box of miscellaneous items, loaded it with nearly 20kg of items, and then tried to lift it with one hand.
He lifted it with ease.
"Alright, now I too am a prodigy that astounds the whole country," Lin Zichen smiled to himself.
Just then, Zhang Wanxin's voice came from the living room, "Zi Chen, Han Han is here to play with you!"
Lin Zichen put down the box and walked unhurriedly to the living room.
Upon entering the living room, he saw a beautiful young woman and a delicately pretty little girl, who looked like a porcelain doll.
The visitors were none other than Shen Qinghan and her mother from next door.
The baby girl who once couldn't even crawl had now grown into an adorable little girl with twin ponytails.
"Zi Chen, these are the egg tarts Aunt Meng made; they're really tasty," Xu Meng said, handing over a box of egg tarts with a beaming smile.
Lin Zichen politely accepted the egg tarts and said, "Thank you, Aunt Meng."
This thanks sounded bitterly sweet to Xu Meng's ears.
At the same age, Lin Zichen could already converse fluently with adults, while her own daughter, Shen Qinghan, often couldn't express her thoughts completely.
It was too slow and made her seem quite unintelligent.
Truly, without comparison, there would be no harm.
After staying in the living room for a while and tasting a few egg tarts,
Lin Zichen, with nothing better to do, soon returned to his room, closed the door, and began intense physical training.
Shen Qinghan enjoyed being with him and followed him into the room, sitting beside him curiously watching as he frantically did push-ups off the floor.
"Try, try the egg tart," she said.
As she watched, Shen Qinghan extended an egg tart she was holding toward Lin Zichen's mouth.
Her voice was milky, with some unclear articulation, turning "eat" into "try."
"No need, you can eat it," Lin Zichen replied.
"Try, try it, it's really good," Shen Qinghan insisted that Lin Zichen have some.
Egg tarts were her favorite food, and she definitely wanted to share with Lin Zichen.
Having no other choice, Lin Zichen stopped to eat the egg tart she offered.
After eating the egg tart, he continued his push-up exercises.
After a good while, he felt the intensity was not quite enough; his body's improvement wasn't very noticeable.
As his body became stronger and stronger, simple exercises no longer met his evolutionary needs.
He paused and looked around the room until his gaze finally settled on Shen Qinghan and he had her sit on his back to serve as a weight.
Shen Qinghan was more than willing, clinging to him like a sloth.
While doing weighted push-ups, Lin Zichen noticed a strange sensation coming from Shen Qinghan's back; underneath her skirt, she was wearing a thick diaper.
Still wearing diapers at two years old was clearly a bit unusual.
Lin Zichen had heard Xu Meng lament to Zhang Wanxin about this matter; apparently, Shen Qinghan still liked to wet her pants, so they had to put her in diapers often.
...
Time flew by.
Another year flew by in the blink of an eye.
Lin Zichen turned three years old.
At this time, his physical strength was so abnormal that he could lift a 40kg rice sack single-handedly.
He didn't know what level that was.
All he knew was that the child prodigy from Capital City he saw on TV last year was now far behind him.
He had always been keeping an eye on news about that prodigy.
That prodigy, now four and a half years old, was still challenging himself to lift a 30kg dumbbell with one hand.
The gap in strength had become very substantial.
Lin Zichen was puzzled by this.
How could the Capital City prodigy, who could lift a 20kg dumbbell single-handedly at two, fail to do the same with a 30kg dumbbell at four and a half years old?
The progression of strength did not seem logical.
Lin Zichen thought about it for a moment and did not dwell on it too much, quickly casting the thought aside and opening his character panel to check the data.
[Name: Lin Zichen]
[Age: 3 years old]
[Biological Level: Ordinary (First Order)]
[Biometric Attributes: Use It or Lose It]
Lin Zichen's gaze fell on the Biological Level, where "Ordinary First Order" was still displayed.
If he could lift a 40kg object with one hand and still only be at the Ordinary First Order Biological Level, what level must Ordinary Second Order be?
Surpassing human limits?
While he was thinking, Zhang Wanxin came over from nowhere and said, "Chen, Mom will go shopping with Aunt Meng in a bit, do you want to go shopping with Mom or stay at home with Dad?"
"I'll go shopping with Mom."
Lin Zichen answered without hesitation.
Being cooped up at home practicing every day was a bit stifling; he needed to get out and take a break.
...
As the mother and son changed shoes and went outside, Shen Qinghan and her daughter were already waiting outside.
Three-year-old Shen Qinghan was wearing a dress with lace and a pink butterfly hair clip, her large Carina eyes sparkling, looking adorable and vivacious.
"Chen, have some cookie."
Shen Qinghan broke the cookie in her hand into two pieces, giving Lin Zichen the larger half.
Her voice was no longer babyish or unclear, sounding much smoother.
"Thank you."
Lin Zichen took the cookie and ate it in one bite.
Seeing this, Shen Qinghan's face was full of smiles; she still loved to laugh, also peed as usual, wearing a thick diaper underneath her skirt.
...
[You are walking, Qi-Blood +1, Body Coordination +1, Walking Proficiency +1...]
Upon reaching the street.
Lin Zichen was exercising by walking while observing the surroundings along the way.
The traffic was busy, skyscrapers were everywhere, looking not much different from his past life.
At most, the architectural structures, as well as the vehicles used for transportation, seemed more high-tech.
A noticeable difference was the occasional presence of beastmen and robots among the people.
The so-called beastmen were martial artists who had integrated Exotic Beast Genes, resulting in their bodies exhibiting certain exotic beast characteristics.
Some had beast ears on their heads.
Some had wings on their backs.
Others were covered in scales, like walking lizards in the middle of the crowd.
As for robots, they were Mechanically Modified Humans with several parts of their bodies metallic, looking like Genos from the anime One Punch Man, filled with a cyber-tech style.
Both Genetic Integrators and Mechanically Modified Humans were not numerous, and you would need to walk a long way to occasionally spot one.
However, the appearance of such individuals was quite eye-catching, and they tended to attract attention as soon as they appeared.
...
PS: Begging bowl extended, seeking Monthly Pass recommendations!

chapters.title: Chapter 4 - 4: 4. Divine Human Wisdom Root
chapters.content:
The two mothers strolled around and soon walked into a women's clothing boutique.
They tried on one item of clothing after another, constantly complimenting each other throughout the process.
Xu Meng exaggeratedly praised Zhang Wanxin for looking good in a short skirt, with long and white legs that were very sexy.
Zhang Wanxin complimented Xu Meng for looking good in a slip dress, pointing out her delicate and sexy collarbones, and her smooth and tender shoulders, which were particularly enticing.
Listening to the mothers' mutual flattery, Lin Zichen couldn't help but size them up.
It had to be said that the two young mothers were really charming.
Both in figure and appearance, they were top-notch, easily scoring at least 8 out of 10.
And they were in the prime of their twenties.
They looked both youthful and mature, exuding a woman's charm from head to toe.
Lin Zichen only observed them for a while before his gaze quickly moved from the two mothers onto Shen Qinghan who was beside them.
A melon-seed face, big eyes, a small upturned nose, cherry lips, tender white skin... one could say she had inherited her mother Xu Meng's beauty quite well, and would surely also be a delicate beauty when she grew up.
After leaving the women's clothing boutique.
The two mothers led their children into a toy store on the upper floor of the mall.
They were there to buy some toys for the kids.
Shen Qinghan walked around and didn't take a fancy to any toys but instead, took an interest in the snacks from the snack store across the way.
Lin Zichen was also uninterested in toys and said he wanted to go into the next-door bookstore to buy books to read, hoping to further understand the world through reading.
The two mothers were quite puzzled; at this age, other children all liked toys, so what made their children so special?
Regardless of their confusion, both mothers still bought their children what they wanted.
While buying books, Lin Zichen chose ones related to Exotic Beasts, Genetic Integrators, and Mechanically Modified Humans.
"Zi Chen, these books aren't really suitable for kids. How about we go to Han Han's section and buy a picture book instead?"
Zhang Wanxin pointed towards the children's area ahead and suggested.
Lin Zichen flipped through the books he had chosen and said to Zhang Wanxin, "These books have pictures too, and I like to look at these pictures."
Zhang Wanxin glanced at the pictures in the books—either fierce-looking Exotic Beasts, mutated Genetic Integrators, or various expensive parts of Mechanically Modified Humans—and thought children shouldn't be reading these books, they should be reading more cartoonish children's books. But since her son liked them, she decided to buy them all.
…
Back at home.
Lin Zichen couldn't wait to flip through the books he had brought back.
[You are reading a book, Spirit +1, Comprehension Ability +1, Knowledge +1]
[Achievement: Accumulate a total of one hundred million words read]
[Reward: Gain Biometric Attribute—Divine Human Wisdom Root]
[Total Words Read: 10086/100,000,000]
As Lin Zichen was concentrating on reading, he suddenly noticed several lines of text appear out of thin air.
He glanced at the content and couldn't help feeling a bit excited.
After his initial kicking achievement, another achievement task had finally appeared.
His daily routine, apart from the tedious exercises, would now have to include more reading for leisure.
…
As time passed, day by day.
Eventually, the time came for Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan to start attending kindergarten.
After discussing, both sets of parents decided to enroll their children in Rainbow Kindergarten, which was closest to their homes, to facilitate picking up and dropping off together.
The school fees for this kindergarten were quite expensive.
But correspondingly, the curriculum was richer than that of average kindergartens.
There were field trip activities.
And foreign language classes.
There were courses for intellectual development and so on.
On the day before school started, Lin Zichen's parents suddenly had to go out of town. Before they left, they dropped him off at Shen Qinghan's house, asking Shen Qinghan's parents to take him to kindergarten the next day to register.
At the neighbor's house.
Aunt Meng said in a gentle voice, "Zi Chen, your mom and dad won't be back until tomorrow night, so you'll stay at Aunt Meng's house tonight, and tomorrow morning Aunt Meng will take you and Han Han to kindergarten."
"Okay, thank you, Aunt Meng," Lin Zichen nodded and said.
Listening to him say this, Shen Jianye, who was nearby, couldn't help but remark with emotion, "Zi Chen is really sensible, even remembering to thank you, Aunt Meng. He's like a little adult. It would be great if Han Han could be as sensible as you."
In the evening, after Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan had bathed, they went to sleep in the room together.
Shen Qinghan was very happy to be sleeping with Lin Zichen.
She kept looking for conversation and chatting with him.
Talking about how much she was looking forward to going to kindergarten tomorrow and making many friends there.
Lin Zichen just occasionally responded to her, spending most of the time sitting on the bed against the wall reading a book.
[You are reading "Exotic Beasts Compendium," Spirit +1, Comprehension +1, Knowledge of Exotic Beasts +1]
[Cumulative Reading Words: 43.96 million/100 million]
To complete the reading achievement, Lin Zichen maintained a rate of reading 300,000 words a day, persisting for nearly five months.
Yet, he hadn't even reached half of the progress bar.
The difficulty of this reading achievement was more than 10 times higher than the previous leg pressing achievement.
After reading for a while, Lin Zichen felt it was about time to sleep, so he put down the book and got ready for bed.
Meanwhile, Shen Qinghan, who had been chattering nonstop just moments ago, was already lying beside him, fast asleep with a sweet expression, sweet enough that drool had leaked from the corner of her mouth.
Lin Zichen took a tissue and wiped off her drool. As he was doing so, his gaze involuntarily fell on the diaper she was wearing.
Even at the age of four, Shen Qinghan still wet her pants and had to wear diapers on a regular basis.
Her parents had taken her to several hospitals for physical examinations, but none could find the specific cause.
...
The next morning.
Aunt Meng got up early to make porridge and called the two children to eat breakfast.
Lin Zichen had been awake for a while. When Aunt Meng came to wake them up, he had already been exercising in the room for more than an hour.
In contrast, Shen Qinghan had lazily lingered in bed for half the morning before Aunt Meng dragged her out to the living room.
During breakfast,
Lin Zichen quickly finished his porridge and even washed his own bowl, acting very sensible.
Meanwhile, Shen Qinghan, half-consciously scooping porridge into her mouth, struggled to stay awake, caught in a bug-like state of being too tired to eat and too hungry to sleep.
While waiting for Shen Qinghan to finish her porridge,
Lin Zichen sat quietly reading a book, continuously absorbing the knowledge it contained.
He learned that Biological Levels are divided into six categories: Ordinary, Advanced, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythical.
Moreover, each category is further subdivided into nine orders.
These levels have been used by humanity for centuries, obtained from ancient steles in mysterious ruins.
After hundreds of years of exploration and research, humans discovered a very despairing fact.
Due to their weak flesh and blood, humans have an extremely low Evolution ceiling, with the highest being Ordinary Ninth Rank.
To evolve further, one must integrate the genes of powerful Exotic Beasts.
Alternatively, one could also become a Mechanically Modified Human, enabling the flesh to have the strength to rival Advanced-level Creatures, Rare Level Creatures, or even Epic-level Creatures.
And the power of an Epic-level Creature was such that they could withstand a nuclear blast with their bare bodies.
"Withstand a nuclear blast with their bare bodies... Can that really be done?" Lin Zichen found this hard to believe.
...
PS: Bowls out, looking for Monthly Passes and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - 5: 5. Bedwetting King
chapters.content:
Rainbow Kindergarten.
At the school gate.
Countless children were looking at their parents outside the fence, their little faces streaming with tears.
For most of these children, it was the first time they were going to be away from their parents, spending a day in a strange place.
"Mommy, don't go, wuu wuu wuu…"
Shen Qinghan leaned against the fence, crying as if her tears cost nothing, weeping like a little tearful figure.
Xu Meng spoke softly to comfort her, "Han Han, don't cry. When school is over in the afternoon, Mommy will come and take you home."
Shen Qinghan continued to cry.
Xu Meng, helpless, could only look to Lin Zichen and say, "Zi Chen, help Aunt Meng take care of Qinghan. Aunt Meng will come to take you home in the afternoon."
"Okay, I understand Aunt Meng," Lin Zichen nodded in response.
Before long, the kindergarten gate was completely closed.
Many children stopped crying when they could no longer see their parents.
After all, with no audience, the actors naturally lost their motivation to perform.
In their stead, the kindergarten teachers began to bustle about.
To make the children like the kindergarten, the teachers spoke gently as they organized the kids to play games.
The game Lin Zichen's class played was arm wrestling to see who was stronger.
The game had simple rules that were easy for the children to understand.
Most importantly, it involved face-to-face interaction, which helped the children get to know each other quickly.
Lin Zichen wasn't interested in arm wrestling and thought about finding a corner to work out.
But seeing Shen Qinghan wanting to play, he ultimately accompanied her.
After playing for a while and seeing that Shen Qinghan had fully integrated into the game atmosphere, laughing and talking with a little girl with buns in her hair, Lin Zichen quietly left the group to find a place to do push-ups.
Not long after he left, Shen Qinghan suddenly wanted to pee and went to the restroom hand in hand with the bun-haired girl.
They went there chatting and laughing, but when they came out from the restroom, their relationship had soured.
"You're so big and still wearing diapers, shame shame, I don't want to play with someone who wears diapers!"
"I'm not, I don't…"
Facing the disdain from the girl with bun hair, Shen Qinghan felt somewhat at a loss.
"Don't play with her everybody, she's so big and still wears diapers, it's too shameful!"
Whenever other little girls passed by, the bun-haired girl would tell them not to play with Shen Qinghan.
Shen Qinghan was nearly in tears upon seeing this.
She had originally hoped to make many friends at school, so how had everything suddenly turned out this way?
She blamed the diapers and quickly ran into the restroom to take them off.
But even so, the bun-haired girl still scorned her.
She even gave her the nickname "Diaper Princess" and intended to make everyone ostracize her.
The malice of children always comes without reason and suddenly.
Shen Qinghan felt the malice of the bun-haired girl and instantly lost all expectation for life in kindergarten.
Wiping her tears in grievance, Shen Qinghan turned and ran off to look for Lin Zichen.
She now finally understood that only Lin Zichen wouldn't mind her wetting her pants and that he would always be her friend.
...
[You are doing sit-ups, Qi-Blood +1, abdominal muscle strength +1, proficiency in sit-ups +1]
[You are doing squats, Qi-Blood +1, leg muscle strength +1, proficiency in squats +1]
[You are doing pull-ups, Qi-Blood +1, arm muscle strength +1, back muscle strength +1, proficiency in pull-ups +1]
[Your Biological Level has advanced to Ordinary Second Order]
Lin Zichen was exercising with focus when he suddenly saw an unexpected prompt in the void.
Biological Level breakthrough!
He was somewhat incredulous and quickly stopped to open his character panel to check.
[Name: Lin Zichen]
[Age: 4 years old]
[Biological Level: Ordinary (Second Order)]
[Biometric Attributes: Use It or Lose It]
His Biological Level had indeed broken through, from Ordinary First Order to Ordinary Second Order.
A few days ago, he had tested his physical data.
He could lift an 80kg rice bin with one hand.
He could jump 1.2 meters high from a standstill.
The sprinter could break 11 seconds in the 100-meter dash...
All these metrics were still a great distance from the world records of my previous life.
But altogether, they placed me among the elite of ordinary people.
Without relevant professional training, it was simply impossible to reach this level.
"So... does a common Second Order level equate to elite adults from my previous life?"
For the first time, Lin Zichen gained a certain understanding of the common stages of Biological Level.
Gauging by the strength of the common Second Order, he figured the Third Order's power should be enough to shatter the world records of his past life.
Moreover, by a wide margin.
While Lin Zichen was lost in these thoughts, Shen Qinghan's voice came from up ahead.
"Chen Chen!"
"Chen Chen, I miss my mom!"
"I want to go home..."
Shen Qinghan trotted up to Lin Zichen, her eyes brimming with tears as she poured out her grievances to him.
Lin Zichen was puzzled.
Hadn't she just made a good friend?
Why was she suddenly crying and wanting to go home?
"What happened?"
Lin Zichen wiped away Shen Qinghan's tears, asking in a gentle voice.
Shen Qinghan sobbed as she recounted her recent ordeal.
After listening, Lin Zichen patted her head and said, "It's okay, we'll always be good friends."
"Yes, always good friends, pinky promise... hang on a noose... for a hundred years, no changing it!"
Shen Qinghan, smiling through tears, hooked pinkies with Lin Zichen.
...
During nap time.
As soon as the homeroom teacher Peach left, Shen Qinghan immediately left her own bed and, like a little kitten, snuggled into Lin Zichen's blanket next to her.
Because of the ostracism experienced that morning by the girl with the bun, she had become even clingier to Lin Zichen, relying on him more than ever before.
Lin Zichen thought it was too hot and uncomfortable for two people to share such a small bed, but he let her have her way regardless.
Soon, Lin Zichen fell asleep as well.
Partway through, he suddenly felt warmth spreading over him.
He quickly woke up and pulled back the blanket to see, discovering that Shen Qinghan had wet the bed.
The mattress was soaked through a large area.
Lin Zichen was somewhat exasperated.
Wasn't she wearing a diaper?
Where was the diaper?
Why didn't it work?
As Lin Zichen was wondering, a little boy who hadn't fallen asleep next to them, with sharp eyes saw the wet mattress and immediately pointed and yelled:
"Bed-wetter!"
"Look, Chen Chen wet the bed!"
"And Han Han too, how embarrassing!"
"..."
The other kids around heard the shouting, and turned to look over at Lin Zichen's side.
Upon seeing the large wet spot on Lin Zichen's mattress, they began to taunt and jeer.
"So big and still wetting the bed, both of you are naughty kids!"
"We shouldn't play with them anymore!"
"Bed-wetting King, from now on, you two will be called the Bed-wetting Kings!"
"..."
Shen Qinghan woke up to the sound of mockery and rejection around her, her eyes reddened, and she burst into tears: "Mommy, I don't want to go to kindergarten anymore, I want to go home, *sob*..."
If it were just him being ostracized, Lin Zichen would not bother with these little kids.
But hearing the cries from Shen Qinghan beside him, he knew he had to do something.
So, he jumped out of bed with force, landing with a "thud" on the tabletop, looked down imperiously at the gaggle of little brats in the class, and commanded in an extremely domineering voice:
"Shut up, all of you!"
...
PS: Bowing down, begging for Monthly Pass recommendations!

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - 6: 6. Excel in both civil and military affairs
chapters.content:
Lin Zichen's shout of "Shut up" was loud and powerful, buzzing in the ears of all the children.
For a moment, all the children were stunned into silence.
They had never seen a peer jump over a meter high, let alone with such a domineering voice; he was just like an angry dad at home.
Lin Zichen looked around at everyone and warned even more assertively:
"If you dare to call anyone 'bed-wetting king' again or bully Han Han, I'll make sure you wet your beds every single day!"
"Do you understand!!!"
When he said the last sentence, he deliberately raised his voice even more.
That increase in volume, like the final straw that broke the camel's back, scared many of the children into tears.
"Waaa, daddy, I'm scared!"
"Mommy, wahhhh..."
"Mommy, daddy, school isn't fun, I want to go home, wahhhh..."
Among them, the girl with the bun was crying the hardest.
Because Lin Zichen's warning was almost exclusively directed at her, it was extremely personal.
Soon, the commotion in the classroom attracted the teachers.
"What's going on, what exactly happened?"
"There, there, everyone stop crying."
"Chen, why are you standing on the desk? It's very dangerous, come down immediately."
"..."
Lin Zichen paid no attention to the arriving teachers.
At the moment, all his attention was on the words that appeared out of thin air.
[You've dominated with your aura, frightening all the children in class, successfully unlocking the title – Kindergarten King]
[Achievement: Dominate nine years of compulsory education]
[Reward: You have obtained the "Biometric Attribute – Survival of the Fittest"]
[Titles: Kindergarten King (Unlocked), Primary School Master (Not Unlocked), Junior High Overlord (Not Unlocked)]
An unexpected third achievement task?
Lin Zichen was somewhat surprised.
He hadn't even completed the previous reading achievements, and now another task had appeared.
It seemed that multiple achievement tasks could exist at the same time.
This was good news.
With this thought, Lin Zichen couldn't help but smile, out of place in a classroom filled with crying.
...
The next day.
The kindergarten received complaints from several parents of the class.
These parents, having heard about the previous day's events from their children, called the kindergarten to demand an explanation.
With no other option, the kindergarten had to invite the concerned parents to the school for a face-to-face reconciliation.
The complaining parents thought Lin Zichen was to blame and directed their ire towards Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin.
Shen Qinghan's parents, Shen Jianye and Xu Meng, felt this was unreasonable.
Both considered their daughter the victim of bullying, while Lin Zichen was simply standing up for her. What wrong had he done?
As a result, the couple lashed back at the angry parents.
As teachers themselves, they were articulate and reasoned, silencing the complaining parents with their logical arguments.
It wasn't until the headmaster came out and gave everyone a way out that the matter was temporarily settled, saying it was all a misunderstanding and no one was to blame.
Out of consideration for the children.
The next day, the headmaster moved Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan to another class.
In the new class, with Lin Zichen's protection, Shen Qinghan was no longer ostracized by the other children and even made a lot of friends.
However, they were just ordinary friends.
For Shen Qinghan, Lin Zichen was her only true friend.
...
In the blink of an eye, half a year passed.
That evening.
Lin Zichen, having finished his bath, was reading in his room.
After not too long, several notifications emerged in the void.
[Accumulated reading of a hundred million characters, achievement reached]
[You have gained the "Biometric Attribute: Divine Human Wisdom Root"]
[Divine Human Wisdom Root: Photographic Memory, learning capability reaching the pinnacle of humanity]
Having read the attribute description, Lin Zichen randomly flipped to a never-before-read page in the book, skimmed the content quickly, and then closed the book, trying to recall the entire page from memory.
To his delight, he found he could recite the content word for word without missing a beat.
It was truly photographic memory!
As night deepened.
After his parents had gone to sleep in their room, Lin Zichen left his own room and sneaked into his parents' study. He turned on their work computer and searched for a video tutorial on high school mathematics concerning derivative functions to watch.
In his previous life, he had been tormented by derivative functions during high school.
Now, he was going to test the effect of the "Divine Human Wisdom Root" with derivative functions.
[You are studying mathematics, spirit +1, logical thinking +1, computing ability +1…]
In the dimly lit room, the fluorescent light from the computer screen shone directly onto Lin Zichen's face, making it appear somewhat shadowy.
About half an hour later, the video ended.
It was at this moment.
Lin Zichen felt as if he had experienced an epiphany and instantly understood the concept of derivative functions.
He immediately searched for past math college entrance examination papers and worked on a few problems involving derivatives. He solved them swiftly.
Back in his high school senior year, no matter how he tried, he couldn't get the derivatives right; but now, in his pre-school class, he could solve them with ease.
Is this what it means to have learning abilities at the pinnacle of humanity?
Too powerful!
From this moment on, I am a genius excelling in both arts and martial prowess!
Lin Zichen felt a surge of excitement in his heart.
…
The next morning.
Lin Zichen arrived at kindergarten for his weekly intelligence development class.
The teacher of the class was a young-looking woman, fresh as if she had just graduated from high school, and everyone called her Teacher Strawberry.
In the classroom, Teacher Strawberry posed a question to the kids.
— If the teacher gave everyone 100 dollars and you could only buy one type of thing to fill up the entire classroom, what would you buy?
"Buy chocolate because chocolate is yummy!"
"Then I'll buy ice cream, I think ice cream is yummier than chocolate!"
"Dad likes the graphics card 4070ti, he even talks about it in his dreams, I want to buy a graphics card to give to dad!"
The children all eagerly responded.
However, unfortunately, none of them hit the mark; it was clear they didn't really understand the question.
"Any other answers? There's a reward for the correct answer, you know!" Teacher Strawberry looked around and asked.
However, no child could provide the right answer.
In the end, Teacher Strawberry had to reveal the answer, "We could buy candles; as long as the candles are lit, their light can fill up the entire classroom."
Shen Qinghan muttered from below, "I really want the reward from Teacher Strawberry, but I'm too dumb to answer…"
Hearing the little girl's mutterings, Lin Zichen stood up, looked at Teacher Strawberry on the podium and said, "Teacher Strawberry, I think candles won't work."
"Oh?" Teacher Strawberry was surprised as she hadn't expected a child to directly refute the standard answer.
She was curious and smiled at Lin Zichen, "Chen, why won't candles work?"
Lin Zichen answered, "Because there are desks and chairs in the classroom, there are all sorts of things that will create shadows under the candlelight."
Upon hearing this, Teacher Strawberry's eyes brightened.
Though Lin Zichen's answer sounded a bit like splitting hairs, she liked children who had their own ideas.
"Then Chen, what do you think could fill up the whole classroom?"
Teacher Strawberry only asked as a formality, not expecting Lin Zichen to have an answer.
Even she couldn't think of a better answer than candles on the spot.
However, Lin Zichen's next answer stunned her.
"I would take the 100 dollars to buy a skirt for Teacher Strawberry, then Teacher Strawberry's joy at receiving the skirt could fill up the entire classroom."
"You, you want to give me a skirt?"
Teacher Strawberry's eyes widened in disbelief.
The answer was perfect!
Could a four-year-old child come up with this?
Am I dreaming?
Teacher Strawberry suddenly felt as though she had really received a skirt and had been charmed by the four-year-old Lin Zichen.
After class.
Teacher Strawberry took Lin Zichen to the office, handed him a box of puzzle toys, and said with a sweet smile:
"Chen, Teacher Strawberry really liked your answer in class, so as a reward, here is a puzzle toy just for you. Teacher Strawberry hopes you will become even smarter."
"Thank you, Teacher Strawberry."
Lin Zichen accepted the gift without any emotional ripples in his heart.
With the attribute of the "Divine Human Wisdom Root," he didn't need puzzle toys to help develop his intelligence.
To him, the gift was nothing more than a mere trinket.
So, when he returned to the classroom, he gave the puzzle toy to Shen Qinghan.
Shen Qinghan, who received the gift, was delighted, hugging the puzzle toy and not letting go, her eyes filled with the image of her Chen.
…
PS: Bowls out, asking for Monthly Passes and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - 7: 7. Special Transfer Student
chapters.content:
"Come on, everyone line up and smile."
"Alright, no more crying, we'll see each other again. Who knows, we might be classmates again in primary school."
"Parents, come join us for a group photo!"
At Rainbow Kindergarten, a group of teachers was busy organizing the senior class children for a photo session to remember.
The three years of kindergarten had passed in the blink of an eye.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan, childhood friends, had both graduated smoothly from Rainbow Kindergarten.
They had grown from four-year-old kids to now seven-year-old big kids.
They had left a significant mark on their lives.
"Han Han, come over here to Aunt Xin, and take a photo with Chen Chen."
"Coming!"
Shen Qinghan ran over to Zhang Wanxin with a smile and took a joint photo with her favorite, Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen looked at Shen Qinghan next to him and realized his childhood friend had unknowingly grown into an astonishing beauty.
In the entire Rainbow Kindergarten, she was a particularly dazzling presence, the secret crush of most boys.
Luckily, his looks weren't bad either, just as dazzling.
And over the past three years, he had scooped up all the awards at Rainbow Kindergarten, making his charm even more overwhelming than Shen Qinghan's.
Over those three years, he had received many gifts from the girls in kindergarten.
Every once in a while, he would find snacks from secret admirers stuffed into his drawer.
After the photo session ended.
Xu Meng found Zhang Wanxin and asked:
"Wanxin, where do you plan to send Chen Chen for elementary school?"
"Feels like all the nearby schools are similar, so we're thinking of the closest one, Sunshine Primary School."
"Sunshine Primary School is quite good. Then I'll have our Han Han follow along."
Xu Meng said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Shen Qinghan immediately beamed and looked at Lin Zichen, very excitedly saying:
"Chen Chen, we can continue to be classmates in primary school."
"Yeah, continue to be classmates."
"Then for middle school, high school, and university, can we keep being classmates?"
"Sure." Lin Zichen said with a smile.
He had grown accustomed to having Shen Qinghan around and enjoyed the feeling of growing up together as childhood friends, hoping it would continue indefinitely.
...
Summer vacation passed quickly.
In the blink of an eye, it was the September school season.
For Lin Zichen, life in elementary school wasn't much different from kindergarten.
His days were spent deep into his own books during classes, delving further into the background of this world.
Then, after classes, he would find a secluded corner to secretly engage in intense physical training, pushing further on the path of evolution.
The only difference was that Lin Zichen no longer needed his parents to drop him off or pick him up from school.
He chose to walk to and from school, giving himself a bit more freedom while also giving his parents a break.
Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin were both quite reassured about not having to pick him up or drop him off.
After all, the school was not far away, just a ten-minute walk.
However, what truly reassured the couple was that Lin Zichen had always been exceptionally excellent from a young age, skilled in both academics and athletics, and could protect himself well without their worries.
Seeing Lin Zichen walking to and from school, Shen Qinghan also clamored to join him.
Shen Jianye and Xu Meng were initially reluctant, but seeing how persistent she was, they finally agreed.
Thinking that with Lin Zichen, their somewhat naive daughter would be well-protected.
...
This morning.
Lin Zichen finished his breakfast and waited at the house entrance for Shen Qinghan to come out so they could go to school together.
While waiting, with nothing better to do, he thought to open his character panel to check the data on it.
[Name: Lin Zichen]
[Age: 7 years]
[Biological Level: Ordinary (Second Order)]
[Biometric Attributes: Use It or Lose It, Divine Human Wisdom Root]
The Biological Level is still Ordinary, Second Order.
However, compared to two and a half years ago when he was still in the junior class of Rainbow Kindergarten, Lin Zichen's strength had greatly improved.
He could now lift a 200kg barbell with one hand.
His vertical jump could reach up to 2 meters.
His 100-meter sprint had broken the 8-second barrier...
Each of these figures had shattered the world records of his previous life.
If he were in his previous life, he would have been regarded as a superhuman.
But in this Earth with extraordinary powers, he was still far from the definition of a superhero.
In the past two and a half years, Lin Zichen had searched online and watched many videos related to Genetic Integrators, Mechanically Modified Humans, and Exotic Beasts.
Those in the videos could fly in the sky, move mountains to fill seas, and do anything imaginable, comparable to terrestrial Immortal Gods.
Every time he watched, he felt extremely shocked and filled with awe.
"This world contains many powerful beings beyond comprehension; I must strive to evolve and hopefully one day reach that status akin to that of Immortal Gods..."
Lin Zichen thought to himself.
At that moment, Shen Qinghan finished her breakfast and came out.
She was wearing a light blue summer school uniform, bouncing energetically up to Lin Zichen with her radiant, water-brimming eyes, smiling:
"Xiao Chen, sorry to keep you waiting."
Since Lin Zichen graduated from kindergarten, Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin no longer called him Chenchen, switching to Xiao Chen instead, making it sound less childish.
Shen Qinghan, having heard it frequently, also started calling him Xiao Chen.
As for Shen Qinghan, Lin Zichen still called her Han Han.
After all, girls are different from boys.
The repetitive nicknames just sound cute for girls, not childish.
...
Arriving at Sunshine Primary School.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan were still seated together.
But they never talked during class, both quietly engaging in their own activities.
Lin Zichen was reading an extracurricular book he brought from home.
Shen Qinghan, on the other hand, was attentively listening to the teacher.
Back in kindergarten, Shen Qinghan appeared rather dull and seemed not very bright.
When learning English, she could pronounce "grandmother" as "rolling your mother's land".
But come primary school, she became exceptionally clever, consistently scoring second in her class in every test.
The reason for such a drastic change was partly that her teacher parents tutored her well at home, and partly that Lin Zichen tutored her at school.
"Zi Chen, have you finished reading the 'Biological Structure' book from yesterday?"
During class, the math teacher passed by Lin Zichen and seeing that he was reading a different book from yesterday, asked with a smile.
Lin Zichen turned to the next page of his book, without looking up, and replied, "Yes, I have finished it."
He always scored full marks in math tests, earning the right to read extra books during math classes without worrying about the math teacher's opinion.
The math teacher exclaimed, "Zi Chen, you really are amazing. I'm counting on you for next week's national primary school math competition."
Lin Zichen coolly said, "Don't worry, teacher, I'll take first place."
The other students in the class watched this scene, their faces showing envy.
Feeling the gazes from her classmates, Shen Qinghan straightened up slightly, proud and honored by the excellence of her childhood friend.
Meanwhile, Lin Zichen was internally unfazed, simply quietly absorbing knowledge from his book.
...
In the days that followed.
Lin Zichen was always the top of his school in every test and broke school records at every sports event.
Whether they were good or bad students, they all felt awe in his presence.
Just when he thought his six years of elementary school would pass uneventfully, and he would smoothly become the top student of the school,
one day, the class suddenly welcomed a very special transfer student.
It was during a math class in the first half of the second grade.
In the middle of the class, the homeroom teacher suddenly brought a girl with white hair into the classroom and told everyone that she was the new transfer student, starting from today.
The moment he saw the girl with white hair.
Lin Zichen sensed an aura from her that was not of this world.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 8 - 8: 8. Passers-by of Childhood
chapters.content:
The arrival of the girl with white hair instantly attracted the attention of everyone and became the center of attention in the class.
That head of white hair was simply too eye-catching.
"Xiao Chen, her hair is so pretty, just like the snowflakes in winter," Shen Qinghan said, whispering into Lin Zichen's ear.
Lin Zichen had no time to care whether the white-haired girl's hair looked good or not.
At that moment, his thoughts were entirely focused on the faint non-human aura emanating from her.
Why would there be an aura that did not belong to humans?
Could she be a Genetic Integrator?
Or... is she the descendant of a Genetic Integrator?
Lin Zichen's mind was filled with a thousand thoughts.
Over the following days, he kept an eye on the white-haired girl.
The white-haired girl was named Bai Xue.
The name was quite common, but it matched her white hair well.
Several days had passed since she transferred to the school, and she had never taken the initiative to interact with anyone.
As soon as class was over, she would lay her head on the desk and not move an inch.
She rarely even went to the restroom.
At first, everyone was curious about her.
But as time passed, their interest in her gradually waned.
The classroom returned to its usual tranquility.
Except for one corner where there was an apparently autistic white-haired girl, everything else was the same as before.
Until after more than a month.
The calm in the classroom was finally broken.
The white-haired girl in the corner often emitted an unpleasant smell.
It wasn't pungent, but it was uncomfortable to smell up close.
Lin Zichen made a point to observe her and found that the smell came from a white substance secreted by her skin.
It wasn't clear exactly what the substance was. Although it looked clean in color, it smelled bad.
Because of the odor, the white-haired girl became unwelcome.
She started to be excluded and ridiculed by her classmates.
In the face of this exclusion and ridicule, the white-haired girl remained indifferent from beginning to end, as usual, laying her head on the desk to sleep once class was over.
Lin Zichen saw all this and was surprised at how much the white-haired girl could endure. He considered her to be a dangerous person and was full of caution.
Until one day.
A mischievous boy deliberately spilled water on the white-haired girl's desk to prevent her from laying her head down to sleep after class.
The girl who had always been expressionless suddenly couldn't hold back her tears.
They streamed down her face uncontrollably.
She cried until her eyes were swollen.
Lin Zichen was stunned. The dangerous person he had always considered her to be actually cried?
Shen Qinghan couldn't stand watching any longer, remembering how she had been excluded by her classmates when she first started kindergarten. She immediately turned to Lin Zichen and said,
"Xiao Chen, I feel sorry for Bai Xue, shall we go and help her?"
"Okay,"
Lin Zichen responded without any hesitation.
He did not know the details about the white-haired girl and did not understand what was going on with her.
He only knew that she was not the dangerous person he had imagined, but more of a self-reclusive little girl who had been bullied into tears by her classmates.
"Guan Chun, wipe the water off Bai Xue's desk."
Lin Zichen walked up to the mischievous boy and stopped in front of him, speaking to him in a calm tone.
Utterly calm.
So calm that there was no ripple at all.
However, the mischievous boy was so frightened that he hurriedly grabbed one of his own books and used it like a tissue, quickly drying the water on the white-haired girl's desk.
He was too afraid of Lin Zichen and feared upsetting this prominent figure known for both his intellectual and physical prowess.
Not just the students in the class, but even the sixth graders were afraid of Lin Zichen.
Every student in Sunshine Primary School had witnessed Lin Zichen's feats at the sports meet and knew how strong he was physically, not daring to offend him.
"Those who have bullied Bai Xue before, come and apologize to her now,"
Lin Zichen looked around the class and said to everyone his gaze landed on.
As soon as the words were spoken, the students who had once bullied the girl with white hair gradually and conscientiously came forward to apologize to her.
Some simply said they were sorry.
Others brought out their snacks as a token of apology.
Whether sincere or not, everyone was apologizing to the girl with white hair.
Facing so many apologies, the girl with white hair felt a bit overwhelmed and, for a moment, even forgot to cry.
After everyone had finished apologizing,
Shen Qinghan walked up to the girl with white hair, stopped by her side, turned to the class, and said, "From now on, no one is allowed to bully Bai Xue. She is our classmate, and we should all be her friends."
With Lin Zichen around, no one dared to ignore Shen Qinghan's words.
From that moment on, no one in the class dared to bully the girl with white hair again.
"Thank you, thank you all..."
The girl with white hair, while quietly sobbing, whispered her gratitude to Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan, barely audible.
Shen Qinghan smiled and said, "No need to thank us, we're classmates and we should help each other."
Lin Zichen didn't say anything, but he took out a tissue and handed it to the girl with white hair.
The girl with white hair reached out for the tissue, timidly looked up at Lin Zichen for a moment, and etched his features deeply into her heart.
...
After that day,
Shen Qinghan began to approach the girl with white hair actively, wanting to befriend her.
She shared anything tasty or fun with her right away.
She even introduced her to Lin Zichen.
Saying that from now on, the three of us will play together and become the best trio of friends in the class.
The reason Shen Qinghan went to such lengths was because she too had experienced exclusion, and she felt compassion for the girl with white hair who had suffered the same.
The girl with white hair was quite taken aback by this and said in a feeble voice, "I... I smell so bad, aren't you disgusted by me?"
Ever since she could remember, she had always been ostracized and disliked by her peers.
Now, having met Shen Qinghan and Lin Zichen, who were willing to be friends with her, it all felt very unreal, as if she were dreaming.
Shen Qinghan held the girl with white hair's hand with a serious face and said, "We won't dislike you. We will always be good friends."
After getting Shen Qinghan's response, the girl with white hair timidly looked towards Lin Zichen, standing aside, wanting to hear his reply, caring greatly about what he thought.
"I feel the same way,"
Lin Zichen said nonchalantly.
The girl with white hair was touched by his words. She took off the pair of Beast Fangs she wore around her neck and placed them in the hands of both, saying with little confidence:
"Han Han, Xiao Chen, you always give me tasty and fun things, and I want to give you something too."
"These Beast Fangs were a birthday present from my mom last year, and now I'm giving them to you, hoping you won't disdain them."
"And, I hope... I hope we will always be good friends forever and ever."
"Yeah, we'll always be good friends," Shen Qinghan accepted the Beast Fangs, her face beaming with smiles.
Afterward, she looked at them both and suggested, "Let's make a pinky promise, the kind where we can't change for a hundred years."
Soon, on the playground of Sunshine Primary School, the slightly childish voices of the three could be heard lingering in the air.
"Pinky promise..."
"A hundred years..."
"No changing allowed!"
...
The next day, the girl with white hair withdrew from school.
Upon hearing this news, Shen Qinghan was completely dumbfounded and couldn't understand what had happened.
The day the girl with white hair withdrew from school, Lin Zichen had seen a tall man accompanying her into the administrative office.
He had a deep impression of the man.
Because the man's arms, half of his chest, and his neck were all made of alloy.
He appeared to be a Mechanically Modified Human.
In light of this, Lin Zichen realized that the girl with white hair might not have a simple identity.
But he didn't dwell on it too much.
After all, the girl with white hair had already transferred schools, and they might never see each other again in this lifetime.
She would just become a passing figure from his childhood.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 9: 9. Roaring at Night
chapters.content:
About the incident with the white-haired girl, several months had passed by unknowingly.
On this particular evening, Lin Zichen was massaging his parents' shoulders in the living room.
Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin, having sat in front of their computers for long periods to write novels, had many areas of their bodies become stiff and uncomfortable.
Especially the shoulders, which often made cracking sounds with just a simple move.
"Xiao Chen is really thoughtful, even knowing to massage Mom's shoulders. Mom's love for you hasn't been in vain."
Zhang Wanxin lay on the sofa, enjoying the appropriately firm massage from Lin Zichen, her face filled with happiness and pleasure.
Sitting to one side, Lin Yansheng felt somewhat disgruntled and complained, "It's unfair. You only massaged me for less than half an hour just now, but you've been massaging her for almost an hour and are still going!"
Zhang Wanxin hummed, "I was the one who changed all his diapers when he was a child and bathed him too. Now I'm enjoying a bit more of my son's filial piety. How is that unfair?"
"If you put it that way, then I really need to have a good talk with you— I was the one who made his baby formula."
"You have the nerve to mention that? The baby formula you prepared for him was either too hot or too cold, shameless."
The couple began to bicker over their words.
Lin Zichen listened and smiled, not taking it too seriously.
He knew that his parents were just bickering for fun and wouldn't actually start a real argument.
Moreover, a bit of verbal sparring could add to the family atmosphere, which was pretty good.
Meanwhile, a news report was airing on the television screen in the front.
"Capital City's Prodigy, Creating More Splendor!"
"At just ten years old, he successfully fused with the Exotic Beast Gene, able to lift a thousand-pound boulder with one hand!"
"A promising future!"
Upon hearing the term "Capital City's Prodigy," Lin Zichen immediately turned to look at the television.
Indeed, it was the prodigy from Capital City who could lift 20kg with one hand at just two years of age.
"It's this Capital City's Prodigy again, the frequency of this kid appearing on screen is way too high. Are they trying to turn him into an internet celebrity to earn money through endorsements?"
Lin Yansheng muttered, touching the stubble on his chin as he watched the news on television.
Zhang Wanxin expressed her confusion, "This child is only just ten years old, his body hasn't even developed properly yet, and they're letting him fuse with the Exotic Beast Gene. Aren't they afraid that he won't be able to suppress the gene and that it could lead to mutations?"
After some thought, Lin Yansheng said, "After all, it is a thousand-year-old Martial Arts Family from Capital City. They know much more than we do. Perhaps they have some advanced Genetic Fusion technology."
"Advanced as it may be, it's still not right to experiment on their own child. I can't understand it." Zhang Wanxin shook her head, not appreciative of the Martial Arts Family on television.
Lin Yansheng disagreed, "You don't understand; these Martial Arts Families often place more emphasis on family interests. Sacrificing personal interests is quite normal for them; otherwise, they wouldn't have grown to such an extent."
"Yes, yes, you know best!" Zhang Wanxin gave him a look and didn't want to continue the conversation with Lin Yansheng.
Lin Zichen listened silently to the side, not voicing any opinions.
He had been keeping an eye on this Capital City's Prodigy from time to time even now.
He learned that at the beginning of the month, the boy had been working on lifting a 100kg barbell with one hand.
Unexpectedly, by the end of the month, he had grown to be able to lift a 500kg weight with one hand.
His strength had quintupled.
All he could think was that having resources at home was a good thing, allowing some to win right from the starting line.
However, I'm only 8 years old, and I haven't yet fused with the Exotic Beast Gene. Still, I can lift a 300kg barbell with one hand. Even without my family being able to provide resource support, I'm more promising than this Capital City's Prodigy...
With this thought, a smile couldn't help but appear on Lin Zichen's face.
Very soon.
Another piece of news started to be reported on television.
It was about something overseas.
In a neighboring country across the sea, an incident with Exotic Beasts attacking had occurred.
Relevant videos were released.
In the video, a dilapidated abandoned city is overrun with black swarms of giant mutant rats.
In one scene, an extremely gruesome sight can even be seen.
A giant mutant rat with eight eyes, three meters in length, is gnawing on a fresh human corpse.
Its fangs are covered in scarlet blood.
It looks abnormally ferocious.
This scene wasn't censored; it was fully displayed on the television screen, with even close-up shots, which were quite unsuitable for children.
Furthermore, Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin did not change the channel to prevent Lin Zichen from watching.
This was due to the different living environments.
In this mutated Earth, the authorities wanted everyone to clearly understand the dangers of exotic beasts.
Even children were no exception.
Thus, many reports about exotic beasts tended to be quite graphic.
"Upon investigation, this exotic beast attack incident was exacerbated by the involvement of the Heretical Sect members."
"We hope that other countries can provide us, Sakura Sea Country, with some assistance to jointly eradicate the Heretical Sect members."
"We, the Sakura Sea Country, will fight to the death with the Heretical Sect elements!"
In the video, an elderly man from Sakura Sea Country with graying temples bows deeply to the viewers in front of the television after delivering his angry speech.
It was the first time Lin Zichen had heard the term "Heretical Sect."
He immediately picked up Zhang Wanxin's phone to look it up online.
He then discovered that the so-called Heretical Sect was an anti-human organization founded by traitors.
These Heretical Sect traitors, for the sake of their own interests, had betrayed the human race and become lapdogs of the exotic beasts, aiming their spears at their kin and frequently launching attacks within human territories.
Many weaker nations often suffered greatly as a result.
"It's a good thing I was born in a strong and powerful country with a relatively stable environment for me to grow up steadily," Lin Zichen thought to himself relievedly.
Now, he wished for nothing else but for his homeland to remain secure so he could develop peacefully until he turned eighteen.
By then, with his trump card, even if he encountered those giant mutant rats from the news, he would possess sufficient strength to protect himself and his family.
"Boom——"
"Boom——"
"Boom——"
Suddenly, bursts of explosive sounds came from outside the window.
The glass trembled.
Eardrums buzzed with the resonance.
Hearing the noise, Lin Zichen quickly gathered his thoughts and ran to the window to check the situation.
He drew back the curtains and saw dozens of Mechanically Modified Humans streaking through the night sky, leaving trails behind.
"Why are there so many official Mechanically Modified Humans flying at this time? Has something happened?"
Lin Yansheng, who had also come over to the window at some point, was looking at the retreating figures of the official Mechanically Modified Humans in the night sky with a puzzled expression.
Zhang Wanxin also came over, and as she looked up at the night sky, she said worriedly, "I hope nothing bad has happened."
Lin Zichen stood in front of Zhang Wanxin, quietly staring at the lingering flight trails in the night sky, sharing the same concerns as Zhang Wanxin.
...
