chapters.title: Chapter 10 - 10: Blinding light
chapters.content:
"Xiao Chen, Xiao Chen, Xiao Chen!"
"Did you just see the Mechanically Modified Humans in the sky?"
"They flew over in such a large group, it was spectacular!"
Lin Zichen was still looking at the night sky from the window when suddenly Shen Qinghan's voice came from outside the house.
The girl's voice sounded very excited, much like a village child in a previous life seeing an airplane for the first time.
"Zi Chen, Qinghan is here to see you. Hurry and go open the door." Zhang Wanxin looked down and urged Lin Zichen in front of her.
Lin Zichen quickly left the window and went to open the door for Shen Qinghan outside.
As the door opened, what came into view was Shen Qinghan, fresh from a bath, wearing a set of light pink pajamas with damp hair, looking very refreshing.
Lin Zichen looked at her and said, "It's not like we haven't seen it on TV before, are you that excited?"
Shen Qinghan bounced into the room with a brilliant smile and said, "It's different. It's not as spectacular on TV as seeing it in person."
Lin Zichen didn't speak, he quietly closed the door.
After sitting down in the room and noticing Shen Qinghan's damp hair, he fetched a hairdryer and said, "Your hair is too wet. Come over here and I'll dry it for you."
Shen Qinghan obediently sat down and let Lin Zichen dry her hair.
While drying her hair, her slender legs kept swinging, quite eye-catching.
Zhang Wanxin, sitting beside her, grew more and more fond of her and, with an auntie's smile, said, "Xu Meng's daughter is truly beautiful. I bet there are quite a few boys at school who have a crush on her."
"Why don't we have a daughter too?" Lin Yansheng joked while smiling.
Zhang Wanxin gave a dismissive look and said, "With Qinghan here, why bother having another one when I can just treat her like my own daughter?"
Meanwhile.
Finally, with her hair dried, Shen Qinghan turned to look at Lin Zichen, resting her cheek on her hand and tilting her head, her big watery eyes shining, she asked:
"Zi Chen, I don't quite understand a few problems in my math homework. Can you teach me later?"
"Sure."
Lin Zichen said without hesitation.
For the next while, the two of them spent time in the room working on their math homework.
One teaching.
One learning.
Shen Qinghan was clever, understanding most of the problems after a little explanation, and soon all the tough questions were resolved.
After finishing the homework, Shen Qinghan carelessly laid back on Lin Zichen's bed, fiddling with her fingers and chatting with Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen, who was doing sit-ups, could only half-heartedly respond.
After chatting for a while, it was almost time to go to sleep.
Shen Qinghan yawned and said, "Zi Chen, I'm so sleepy. I don't feel like getting out of bed to go home. I'll just sleep here tonight."
"That's fine."
"Then can you let my mom know? I don't feel like getting up to make a call."
"Okay."
Lin Zichen then got out of bed and asked Zhang Wanxin to call Xu Meng to inform her that Shen Qinghan would be sleeping over.
Xu Meng agreed and brought over Shen Qinghan's school uniform for the next day, including shoes, socks, and toiletries.
Lin Zichen brought all these things up to the room to make it convenient for Shen Qinghan to get dressed in the morning.
"This girl fell asleep so quickly."
Looking at Shen Qinghan lying spread-eagled on the bed, sound asleep and looking blissful, Lin Zichen smiled, fetched a paper towel, and wiped the drool that had trickled from the corner of her mouth.
Then, he turned off the light and went to bed.
One pillow each, one blanket each, to avoid anyone getting cold from blanket-hogging in the middle of the night.
...
The next day, Lin Zichen woke up early.
It was still dark outside.
The clock on the bedside showed it was only five o'clock.
Waking up at five o'clock every morning was precisely his biological sleep clock.
He had gotten used to waking up early to exercise. If he didn't do a few hundred push-ups to warm up in the morning, he felt sluggish all day.
[You are doing push-ups, Qi-Blood +1, arm muscle strength +1, chest muscle strength +1, push-up proficiency +1]
[You are doing squats, Qi-Blood +1, leg muscle strength +1, squat proficiency +1]
[You are doing sit-ups, Qi-Blood +1, abdominal muscle strength +1, sit-up proficiency +1]
After intense physical training,
Lin Zichen went downstairs to wash up.
While there, he stood in front of the washbasin mirror, took off his shirt, and examined the results of his years of training.
The muscles were not exaggeratedly large but looked sharply defined, bursting with explosive strength.
Especially the abs, perfectly chiseled, which felt particularly nice to touch.
"Tsk tsk, Xiao Chen, looks like you're just as vain as your dad, striking different poses in front of the mirror early in the morning."
Zhang Wanxin, who was up making breakfast, passed by the bathroom and couldn't help but laugh upon seeing Lin Zichen posing in front of the mirror like a bodybuilder.
Lin Zichen, who had been admiring himself, suddenly turned red-faced with embarrassment from Zhang Wanxin's comment and wished he could dig a hole and bury himself right there.
"Oh my, you're even blushing! Come here and let mom feel your abs."
"I'll go and call Qinghan had breakfast."
After dropping that line, Lin Zichen fled the bathroom as if flying.
That was too embarrassing.
He didn't want to see Zhang Wanxin at all today.
He just couldn't face her.
...
When Lin Zichen returned to his upstairs room,
Shen Qinghan was still not fully awake.
She lay sprawled on the bed, the blanket nowhere in sight.
Looking down, it turned out she had kicked the blanket off the bed at some point.
"You're so big now, and you're still kicking off your blanket while sleeping."
Lin Zichen shook his head and picked up the blanket.
Casually tossing the blanket back on the bed, his gaze fell on Shen Qinghan's lower body.
The crotch area was bulging, still wearing diapers like when she was a child.
An eight-year-old girl still needing to wear diapers definitely indicated a health problem.
Strangely enough, they could never diagnose the cause.
Fortunately, Shen Qinghan only had a chronic bed-wetting issue up to now.
Apart from that, there were no other issues.
Consider it a fortunate misfortune.
Lin Zichen didn't dwell on it any longer, gently pinched Shen Qinghan's cheek, and softly called, "Han Han, it's already past six, wake up, brush your teeth, wash your face, and come have breakfast."
"Mmm~"
Shen Qinghan slowly opened her eyes and instinctively sat up and stretched.
Then, with sleepy eyes, she looked at Lin Zichen and said in a soft voice, "Xiao Chen, I just dreamt about Bai Xue. I wonder where she is now, what she's doing."
"Bai Xue is having breakfast at her home. Hurry up, get dressed, or the breakfast downstairs will get cold."
"Got it," said Shen Qinghan, then, right in front of Lin Zichen, she took off her nightgown to change into her school uniform.
The moment the nightgown came off, Lin Zichen suddenly felt a flash of discomfort.
Shen Qinghan's chest was glowing!
To be more precise, the Beast Fang she wore on her chest was glowing!
That was the Beast Fang that the white-haired girl had given her.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 11 - 11: 11. An uninvited guest
chapters.content:
"Han Han, the beast fang you're wearing around your neck is glowing."
"It really is!"
"Take it off and let me have a look."
"Here, for you!"
Shen Qinghan obediently removed the beast fang and handed it to Lin Zichen in front of her.
Lin Zichen took the beast fang and examined it closely in his hand.
The room was dark without the lights on, making the glow from the beast fang exceptionally bright, like a firefly shimmering in the night.
Holding it in hand, he could feel a vigorous life force within the beast fang.
However, it was not a human life force, but rather more akin to Exotic Beasts, filled with brutal wildness.
It was not until this moment that Lin Zichen realized the non-human aura he had sensed from the white-haired girl initially came from the beast fang, not the girl herself.
So what kind of creature's tooth was this?
Exotic Beasts?
Lin Zichen studied the beast fang for a good while, but couldn't figure it out.
Because the light emitting from the beast fang soon dissipated.
It again became inconspicuous.
Unable to investigate further.
Seeing this, Lin Zichen could only put away the beast fang for the time being and, urged by Zhang Wanxin, went downstairs for breakfast with Shen Qinghan.
While eating breakfast, he asked Zhang Wanxin for her phone, took a photo of the beast fang, and uploaded it online for image recognition.
Unfortunately, he found nothing.
Now there was no other way but to rely on himself.
So before leaving for school, he went back to his room, took his own beast fang with him, and planned to study it properly at school.
...
On their way.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan walked side by side, attracting the attention of people wherever they went.
Their good looks surpassed even the filtered beauty of child stars on TV, drawing a glance from everyone who passed by.
Lin Zichen had grown accustomed to these gazes and didn't care much, quietly hurrying to school with Shen Qinghan.
"Wow, such beautiful children, are you two brother and sister, or sister and brother?"
As they passed a bar, a heavily made-up woman approached them, looking at the two with an aunt-like smile and asked.
Her dress was very revealing, as if she wanted to expose every part of herself that could attract men's gazes, and she held a lit cigarette, not seeming like a decent person.
"We're not siblings; we are childhood friends, best friends," Shen Qinghan said softly.
"Childhood friends, how nice. I wish I had a childhood friend too," the woman said with an envious smile, then asked, "You are still so young, why are you going to school on your own with backpacks, where are your parents?"
"Our parents, they..."
"Don't chat, we'll be late for school, let's go."
Shen Qinghan hadn't finished speaking when Lin Zichen interrupted her and quickly pulled her away by the hand.
After walking a good distance, Lin Zichen slowed down a bit and said to Shen Qinghan with a serious tone:
"In the future, don't casually chat with strangers on the street, okay?"
"Mhm, I got it."
Shen Qinghan nodded obediently.
...
Soon, they arrived at school.
During class, while the teacher on stage lectured non-stop, Lin Zichen studied the beast fang with his head down.
The scene he had seen in the room that morning made him curious about the beast fang given by the white-haired girl.
What kind of creature's tooth would inexplicably glow and, having been out of the mouth for so long, still contain such a robust life force?
Clearly, it couldn't be from a normal creature; it was very likely from Exotic Beasts.
Moreover, it was probably a beast not yet recorded by mankind.
Otherwise, with the clear traits displayed by the beast fang in the room that morning, a simple online search would have yielded results.
However, during breakfast that morning, he specifically used Zhang Wanxin's phone to check, and nothing came up.
This could somewhat prove that the owner of the tooth was very likely an unknown Exotic Beast not yet recorded.
What on earth does that white-haired girl's family do?
How could her mother give her such a special birthday gift?
Could she be the illegitimate daughter of a Martial Arts Family?
Lin Zichen was baffled.
...
Time flew by quickly.
In the blink of an eye, it was time to leave school in the afternoon.
As the chorus of "Goodbye, teacher" rang out, the classroom emptied quickly, leaving only Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan, who took their time to leave.
Both of them walked to and from school on their own, not needing to rush out of the school gates to find their parents as soon as classes ended, for fear that a slow departure would lead to traffic jams on the way home.
"Xiao Chen, next month we are going to celebrate our birthdays together, and I've already prepared your gift in advance. Have you prepared mine?"
No sooner than they stepped out of the classroom, Shen Qinghan looked at Lin Zichen with anticipation and asked.
Their birthdays were only a day apart, and since childhood, both families had always celebrated together, this year being no exception.
However, Lin Zichen hadn't given a thought to his birthday, let alone prepared a gift in advance.
Now suddenly faced with Shen Qinghan's question, he had no choice but to lie, "Just like you, I've prepared it in advance."
"Really?" Shen Qinghan's face broke into a delighted smile, "I'm really looking forward to your gift, Xiao Chen."
Lin Zichen just smiled and did not respond.
"Xiao Chen, which way shall we take home today?"
Shen Qinghan bounced along cheerfully, turning her head to Lin Zichen and asked.
After thinking for a moment, Lin Zichen answered, "Let's go through the abandoned alleys in the old town area today. There are still many paths we haven't taken there; let's explore them today."
For some reason, after his life's reset, he had become very eager to explore, always liking to take different routes home from school.
He had pondered this, feeling that maybe it was because he had come to an unfamiliar world and was eager to understand it at every moment.
Gradually, during the process of growing up, a strong desire to explore had formed.
"Chen, it's so quiet inside the alley."
Walking through the deserted old alleys, Shen Qinghan looked around curiously with her wide, round eyes.
Lin Zichen explained, "This place is going to be demolished next month, and the residents who used to live here have mostly moved away, that's why it's quieter."
"Xiao Chen, Xiao Chen, look at this!"
"There's a dandelion here!"
"I have never seen a wild dandelion before, and I'm this old!"
Shen Qinghan ran ahead, pointing to a dandelion in the corner, her face beaming with excitement.
Lin Zichen walked over with a smile, while she crouched down, looking at the delicate dandelion flower in front of her, eyes filled with pity as she said:
"Dandelions are so pretty, it would be great if they could be more robust, so they wouldn't be scattered by the wind, and could remain beautiful for everyone passing by to see."
Lin Zichen chuckled and said, "If dandelions were robust, you wouldn't be able to see this pretty one now."
"Why is that?"
Shen Qinghan lifted her little face to look up at Lin Zichen, her watery eyes shimmering with clarity.
Lin Zichen enlightened her, "Because the 'flyers' inside the dandelion are its seeds, and they need the wind to scatter them to take root and sprout everywhere, growing new dandelions."
"Dandelions are so amazing," Shen Qinghan said, finding it incredible, while thinking Lin Zichen was so smart, seeming to know everything.
After the brief lesson, Lin Zichen also crouched down beside her, gently picked the dandelion, and handed it to Shen Qinghan, saying softly:
"Han Han, stand up, hold the dandelion a bit higher, and blow away the 'flyers' so the seeds can drift with the wind to different places to bloom."
"Xiao Chen, Xiao Chen, watch closely, I'm about to spread flowers like a Goddess scattering blossoms," Shen Qinghan declared excitedly, standing up and lifting the dandelion high in her hand, even standing on tiptoe to reach higher.
Then, taking a deep breath, she blew forcefully at the dandelion!
The next moment, the dandelion's 'flyers' were blown away in an instant, scattering forward in a big cloud before dispersing into the distance.
Both found the scene very beautiful and tacitly remained silent, quietly watching the dandelion seeds drift away with the wind.
Until, a familiar woman appeared at the alley entrance up ahead, breaking the precious tranquility they had found.
It was the woman they had encountered that morning on their way to school, passing by a bar.
This time, the woman was no longer approachable as she had been that morning, her eyes now greedily smiling at the two of them:
"I've been following you two little cuties for a while, and finally, I've found my chance."
...
