chapters.title: Chapter 12 - 12: 12. Giant Mutant Rat
chapters.content:
"Brother Sheng, no need to search anymore, the two kids are in the alley on my side!"
The woman turned and shouted back loudly.
Soon after, a man with two large tattoos on his arms appeared next to her.
The man was skinny as a rail, his face sapped of spirit, and he occasionally sniffed his nose, appearing to be a drug addict.
"What do you want to do?"
Faced with these two unwelcome guests, Lin Zichen didn't run; instead, he shielded Shen Qinghan behind him and calmly faced the two, questioning them.
Having evolved since birth, his physical strength had long surpassed that of normal humans, giving him enough confidence to calmly handle crises.
Seeing Lin Zichen so composed unexpectedly surprised the pair.
Suddenly, the woman with bright makeup resumed her friendly demeanor from the morning, and smiling, she said to Lin Zichen, "Little brother, little sister, I have delicious and fun things at my home, would you like to come and play at my place?"
No sooner had she finished speaking when the tattooed man impatiently interjected, "Damn it, you old hag! Why bother scheming to lure these kids? Just go up, knock them out, grab them, and let's get it over with! I need to sell them fast for money!"
With that, he pulled two pungent-smelling cloths from his pocket and tossed one to the woman before briskly walking toward Shen Qinghan.
"Xiao Chen..." Shen Qinghan was very frightened, her small hand gripping Lin Zichen's arm tightly.
Lin Zichen patted her small hand, signaling her not to be afraid.
Then, he let go of her hand, forcefully drove his feet against the ground, and in the next moment, he shot forward like an arrow released from a bow, turning into a blur as he rushed toward the approaching man.
"Bang!"
A dull punching sound erupted.
Lin Zichen, who had instantly rushed to the man's side, fiercely punched him in the stomach, sending him flying.
He rolled several times on the ground before stopping, curled up like a shrimp, his mouth emitting painful "heh heh" sounds as blood flowed continually.
"You, you you you...!"
The woman was dumbfounded on the spot, completely unable to comprehend what had just happened. She was so terrified she couldn't even speak.
She couldn't understand how a primary school student, appearing to be in about the second or third grade, could punch an adult man flying. It made no sense at all!
Lin Zichen didn't waste words with the woman; he immediately used Blink Step to charge in front of her, leaped high with the force from the ground, and fiercely punched her heavily made-up face.
"Bang!"
Another sound followed.
The woman was sent flying by the punch, several teeth expelled from her mouth as she fell flat on the ground, completely silent.
It was unknown whether she was knocked out or dead.
Lin Zichen scanned the surroundings; seeing no surveillance cameras, he decided to overcome his discomfort and finish off the two to eliminate any future threats.
Just as he picked up a brick, preparing to obliterate the two on the ground, a loud noise suddenly came from an abandoned tile house in front.
Then, a three-meter long Giant Mutant Rat with eight eyes emerged from the tile house, opening its massive maw and biting the woman closest to it on the head.
With just one bite, the woman's head was viciously snapped off, blood splattering everywhere, instantly killing her.
Seeing this horrifying scene, Lin Zichen reacted incredibly fast, immediately turning around to run. As he passed by Shen Qinghan, he swiftly scooped her up and dashed away from the location, desperate to distance himself from the Giant Mutant Rat.
Exotic Beasts!
It was the Giant Mutant Rat that had appeared in Sakura Sea Country before!
They were here too?!
Something big was happening!
Adrenaline surged throughout Lin Zichen's body, his heartbeat accelerating, shattering the sense of safety he had built up from years of evolution.
Shen Qinghan, held in his arms, had already turned pale with fear from the recent events, her body trembling uncontrollably, but she held back her tears, not wanting to burden him.
After running out of the alley and distancing themselves sufficiently,
Lin Zichen finally set Shen Qinghan down, his hands trembling as he activated his children's watch to dial the official security team to report the incident.
"Old town area, in an alley in the old town, a Giant Mutant Rat appeared, just like the one that appeared in Sakura Sea Country recently!"
Lin Zichen, gasping for breath, tried his best to steady his voice and explain the situation completely.
But the surge of adrenaline made his voice tremble nonetheless.
As soon as his words fell, before the security team could respond, a roaring sound of machinery came from the sky above the alley behind him.
He turned his head at the sound and saw a Mechanically Modified Human, half of whose body was painted black, hovering steadily above the alley, raising its right hand made of pure alloy, aiming at the alley below.
Then, a burst of sparks erupted from the right hand of the Mechanically Modified Human, shooting a smoke-laden cannonball toward the alley below.
"Boom——"
The cannonball fell into the lower part of the alley, exploding in a burst of purple-blue flames.
The noise was loud, but the destructive power seemed weak.
Lin Zichen, standing outside the alley, felt no shockwave.
Simultaneously, the buildings inside the alley did not turn into ruins as he had expected.
The scene before him was just the alley filled with dense purple-blue smoke.
The recent cannonball appeared to be something akin to a smoke grenade.
What exactly it was, Lin Zichen did not know.
But he guessed it was something that could potentially reduce the combat effectiveness of the Giant Mutant Rat.
Like, perhaps, smoke with anaesthetic effects.
Soon, Lin Zichen saw the Mechanically Modified Human hovering in the air slowly descend into the smoky alley and engage in close combat with the Giant Mutant Rat on the ground.
Having evolved over the years since his birth, he possessed sharp sensory abilities, allowing him to clearly hear the sounds of the fight coming from inside the alley even while standing outside.
"Xiao Chen, what should we do now?"
Shen Qinghan tightly grasped Lin Zichen's hand, her voice trembling.
Seeing her distressed state, Lin Zichen did not hesitate, "We're going home."
Although curious about the fight currently happening in the alley, he did not dare to risk watching it and only wanted to hurry home.
Then, he would wait for tonight's news to see if it would cover the incident in the alley.
As he thought about these things, the voice of the security team operator continuously came from the children's watch on his hand.
"Little one?"
"Hey, little one, can you hear my voice?"
"Quickly move away from the alley, do not get close, it's dangerous there!"
The operator's voice sounded very anxious, clearly worried about Lin Zichen's safety.
Lin Zichen quickly regained his composure and responded calmly, "Sister, I've already left the alley, I'm safe now."
"That's good, that's good." The female operator from the security team sighed with relief.
Lin Zichen held Shen Qinghan's hand tightly to comfort her, then curiously asked the female operator, "Sister, I just saw a Mechanically Modified Human fly into the alley, is that one of your team members from the security team?"
"It's a member of the security team," the operator responded before advising Lin Zichen, "Little one, if it's not necessary, don't stay outside. Hurry home and stay safe with your mom and dad, okay?"
"Understood, thank you, sister."
He thanked her politely and then disconnected the communication with the security team.
Afterward, his gaze returned to the alley still emanating rolling smoke ahead.
At that moment, intense sounds of a fight still echoed from there, mixed with a large number of sharp rat noises, suggesting the Giant Mutant Rat was at a disadvantage.
Seeing him disconnect the call, Shen Qinghan then stammered through trembling lips, "Xiao Chen, I want to go home..."
"I'm taking you home now."
"Okay."
"Can you walk? If not, I'll carry you."
"My legs are a bit weak..."
"Then come on, I'll carry you home."
Lin Zichen turned around, lifted Shen Qinghan onto his back, and silently hurried toward their home.
...
PS: Bowing and asking for Monthly Pass recommendations!

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - 13: 13. Promise on the Birthday
chapters.content:
"You two, why did you come home later than usual today?"
"We stayed in the classroom for a while, so we came back late."
At Shen Qinghan's doorstep, Lin Zichen explained to Xu Meng, who had come out to open the door.
Xu Meng nodded her head and didn't ask further, telling him to go home early and not to worry his parents.
Before leaving, Lin Zichen glanced at Shen Qinghan.
Seeing that the little girl was much better, he turned around and headed back to his own home with relief.
About today's incident in the alley, he had already agreed with Shen Qinghan that it would remain a secret between the two of them, not to be shared with a third person.
The giant mutant rat was one matter.
Primarily because the combat power he demonstrated when he severely injured that malicious couple was excessively exaggerated and totally inconsistent with his age.
If others were to find out, it might bring a lot of trouble.
At this stage, Lin Zichen only wanted to maintain an image of a little genius.
That way, he could gain certain privileges and a tilt in educational resources in school, and make his parents proud.
And that was about enough.
Anything more would be inappropriate.
It would greatly disrupt his current life rhythm, making it impossible for him to evolve peacefully.
...
Back at home.
After dinner.
Lin Zichen did nothing but sit in front of the television, waiting for the evening news.
He hoped that the security forces could be effective and announce the day's incidents in the alley tonight.
About fifteen minutes later.
Lin Zichen finally got the news report he had been eagerly awaiting—it was about the giant mutant rat that had appeared in the alley that afternoon.
The content of the broadcast was more detailed than he had anticipated.
Two different angles of video were released.
One was a third-person view shot from a drone above.
The other was a first-person view recorded face-to-face during the close-quarter combat between the mechanically modified human and the giant mutant rat.
Lin Zichen watched the videos combining both perspectives.
The mechanically modified human, at first, barely took the initiative to strike, just keeping distance and managing the giant mutant rat.
It didn't enter the giant mutant rat's range of attack nor allow it to escape the purple-blue smoke.
Before long, the once agile giant mutant rat gradually moved more slowly, appearing as though it had been anesthetized.
Clearly, the purple-blue smoke could reduce the combat ability of the giant mutant rat.
Once the giant mutant rat's combat ability had decreased significantly, the mechanically modified human's arm sprouted sharp blades, beginning to actively engage and wrestle closely with the giant mutant rat.
The battle lasted nearly seven minutes.
In the end, the giant mutant rat was finally slain with a cut to its throat, its heart pierced, and it lay gasping on the ground.
"This mechanically modified human's level must not be high."
After watching the video, Lin Zichen came to this conclusion.
He had previously searched for videos of mechanically modified humans in combat, involving artillery bombardments and destructive laser clearings, both spectacular and ferocious in power.
However, the mechanically modified human he saw on the news station was wrestling its enemy with poison for a long while, slowly grinding it to death, which seemed considerably weaker in performance.
As he pondered these things, his parents, who had just cleaned up the dining table and washed the dishes, also came over to sit in the living room.
The couple's faces were instantly filled with surprise upon seeing the news on TV.
"What's going on? Isn't this the same kind of giant mutant rat that attacked Sakura Sea Country a while ago? Why do we have them domestically now?" Zhang Wanxin said worriedly.
Lin Yansheng also frowned and turned to Lin Zichen, saying, "Chen, don't walk to and from school by yourself during this period. Dad will take you there and back."
No sooner had he finished his sentence than Zhang Wanxin said, "That won't be necessary. The school just sent a message, saying that because of the giant mutant rat appearing in the old city district, they will suspend classes for half a month."
Suspending classes for half a month?
Hearing this, Lin Zichen furrowed his brows slightly.
He realized that the matter of the giant mutant rat might be more complicated—there were probably other giant mutant rats in the old city district or nearby areas.
Otherwise, they wouldn't suddenly suspend classes for half a month.
Lin Zichen carefully reconsidered it, finding yesterday's incident in the alley somewhat peculiar.
The mechanically modified human had appeared too quickly.
Not long after the giant mutant rat emerged, the mechanically modified human arrived at the scene to exterminate it.
It was as if he knew beforehand that the giant mutant rat was in the old city district, or he was constantly tracking it, able to quickly reach the scene at any disturbance.
Forget it, this isn't something I should worry about.
With no concern for the world outside, I immersed myself in training and evolution at home—this was what I should focus on.
However, it was appropriate to learn a bit about the giant mutant rat…
Thinking this, Lin Zichen left the living room and entered his parents' study room, where he searched the computer for information related to the giant mutant rat.
He learned that the giant mutant rat, once adult, could grow up to three meters long.
And upon reaching adulthood, its biological level was typically as high as common tier five.
Common tier five?
It was a good thing that his first reaction when he encountered the giant mutant rat in the alley yesterday was to run away rather than foolishly try to fight it. Otherwise, his head might have been bitten off by now…
Lin Zichen felt a surge of fright.
"No, I'm not training hard enough, I must increase the intensity of my workouts…"
He became urgent again and quickly left the study room, running upstairs to his room to begin intensive training.
[You are doing weighted push-ups, Qi-Blood +2, arm muscle strength +2, chest muscle strength +2, push-up proficiency +1]
[You are doing weighted squats, Qi-Blood +2, leg muscle strength +2, squat proficiency +1]
[You are doing weighted sit-ups, Qi-Blood +2, abdominal muscle strength +2, sit-up proficiency +1]
…
Time flew by.
Before he knew it, a month had passed.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan, childhood sweethearts, celebrated each other's ninth birthday.
To be precise, it was Shen Qinghan's own ninth birthday.
Their birthdays were one day apart, and in order for them to celebrate together every year, their parents had deliberately arranged to alternate celebrating each other's birthdays.
Last year was Lin Zichen's birthday, so this year it was Shen Qinghan's turn.
That evening.
Both families gathered at Shen Qinghan's house for a birthday dinner.
The two birthday children had both prepared birthday gifts for each other with great care.
Knowing that Lin Zichen liked books, Shen Qinghan bought him a set related to mechanically modified humans, genetic integrators, and exotic beasts.
Lin Zichen gave Shen Qinghan a handcrafted hairpin.
Made of pure wood, hand-carved and polished, it bore Shen Qinghan's name and a dandelion she liked on it, making it exquisitely beautiful.
"Xiao Chen, this hairpin is so beautiful, I love it!"
Shen Qinghan was extremely surprised, not expecting a handmade gift from Lin Zichen.
She eagerly put on the hairpin and, looking in the mirror, grew fonder of it by the second, so much so that she felt the books she gave him seemed somewhat cheap in comparison.
Compared to gifts bought with money, those handmade held more meaning and value.
"Xiao Chen, how about we give each other homemade gifts every year for our birthdays?" Shen Qinghan proposed as she looked at Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen smiled and said, "Sure."
"Xiao Chen, when did you learn the craft of woodworking, and how come Mom didn't know about it?"
Zhang Wanxin, looking at the exquisite wooden hairpin on Shen Qinghan's head, felt a bit of jealousy.
Lin Zichen explained, "I often stay in my room and don't come out, and I spend a lot of that time working on handicrafts."
This was a lie; he often stayed in his room to exercise intensely.
As for the woodworking skills, he had casually watched a video online last week, paid close attention, and then learned it.
This was the power of the "Divine Human Wisdom Root."
"Mom, actually, I also made a wooden hairpin for you. I'll give you a surprise after the birthday celebration when we get home."
Lin Zichen noticed the bitterness in Zhang Wanxin's heart and whispered these words in her ear.
Upon hearing this, the bitterness in Zhang Wanxin's heart was swept away, and a sweet smile appeared on her face. My beloved son still knows how to be filial to his mother.
…
After the birthday celebration.
Lin Zichen returned to his home, turned off the lights, and lay on his bed, but he didn't rush to sleep. Instead, he quietly stared at the ceiling, bathed in the faint moonlight coming through the window, lost in thought.
About the giant mutant rat incident that happened last month, he had been keeping up with it, wanting to know why a giant mutant rat suddenly appeared in the old city area.
However, the authorities hadn't provided a clear explanation, leaving it still a mystery.
Fortunately, there had been only that one appearance of the giant mutant rat, and it hadn't shown up again, allowing life to return to normal.
"I hope the appearance of that giant mutant rat was just an accident, not part of some conspiracy."
This world wasn't as peaceful as in his previous life, with exotic beasts and traitors from the Heretical Sect wreaking havoc both outside and inside, it was hard for Lin Zichen not to overthink.
…
PS: Putting out a bowl, seeking monthly pass recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 14 - 14: 14. Elementary School Graduation
chapters.content:
The six years of elementary school flew by in the blink of an eye.
In no time at all, Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan graduated from Sunshine Primary School.
On the graduation ceremony day, both families gathered together for a group photo, just as they did when the children graduated from kindergarten.
The only difference being, Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan had grown much taller than they were six years ago.
The childishness on their faces was fading, replaced by the vibrancy and vitality unique to teenagers.
"Han Han, how can you be so beautiful? You get prettier every year; it's melting Aunt Xin's heart."
Zhang Wanxin gazed at Shen Qinghan who now stood slightly taller than her shoulder, with eyes full of a mother's adoration for her daughter.
Although Shen Qinghan wasn't her own daughter, she had long since regarded her as one.
Lin Yansheng also remarked, "Kids these days grow up so fast. Barely in sixth grade, just twelve years old, and they're nearly as tall as adults."
He was mainly talking about Lin Zichen.
At the moment, Lin Zichen was almost eye to eye with Zhang Wanxin, standing at a little over 1.6 meters tall.
Keep in mind, he had just graduated from elementary school.
By the time he finished middle and high school, with another six years of growth, he would be at least 1.8 meters tall.
In Lin Yansheng's generation, that height would have made him one of the tallest in the class.
On the other side, Shen Jianye and Xu Meng were also marveling at how quickly the two children had grown.
Among them, Xu Meng said with a smile, "Looking at these two kids, I can't help feeling like just yesterday they were babies, and now they've suddenly become little adults."
"Yeah, time flies so quickly." Shen Jianye said, embracing Xu Meng around the waist.
"Zi Chen, Han Han, come a little closer together."
Zhang Wanxin held a DSLR camera and called out to Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan in front.
At the sound of her voice, Shen Qinghan reached out and pulled Lin Zichen a bit closer, standing nearly hand in hand.
"Okay, cheese!"
At Zhang Wanxin's command,
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan struck a "yeah" pose simultaneously, revealing a smile that was three parts youthful and seven parts tender.
After snapping dozens of photos, Zhang Wanxin finally let the childhood sweethearts go and turned to join the three parents behind her to admire her photography skills.
Then, completely lost in the compliments of "These are really good shots," she beamed with pride.
"Zi Chen, you've grown so fast. Just two years ago, when we celebrated your tenth birthday in fourth grade, we were the same height, and now you're half a head taller than I am."
Shen Qinghan stood in front of Lin Zichen, tiptoed slightly to compare their heights, and found herself half a head shorter, feeling somewhat disappointed.
Lin Zichen reached out to touch her head, teasingly commented, "Don't worry, three years from now, I might be a whole head taller than you, and then three years after that, one and a half heads taller."
"Don't get too smug," Shen Qinghan said with a plump, rosy pout, "I might just overtake you in junior high and be a bit taller than you, just like in the third grade."
Lin Zichen just chuckled and didn't reply, looking closely at the 12-year-old Shen Qinghan before him, suddenly feeling like a father watching his daughter grow up.
The once giggling baby girl, the unintelligible little loli, the bouncing young girl had unknowingly grown into a clear-voiced young lady.
Like a lark, full of agility and liveliness.
"Why do you keep staring at me?"
Shen Qinghan, with her clear eyes, waved her hand in front of Lin Zichen and asked.
Lin Zichen smiled and replied, "Nothing special."
Shen Qinghan teasingly said with a mischievous face, "You must think I'm pretty, right?"
"Han Han, you really are very pretty," Lin Zichen nodded sincerely.
Caught off guard by his candid response, Shen Qinghan's face turned red instantly, and she hastily turned away, saying, "If you think I'm pretty, then you should take a few more glances."
Lin Zichen smiled without a word, thinking to himself that the once childish little girl now understood blushing and shyness—it was definitely a sign of growing up, a sign of impending adolescence.
...
The graduation ceremony soon came to an end.
The two families, as always, found a restaurant nearby to celebrate with a meal.
However, unlike at kindergarten graduation,
This time, in the private room of the restaurant, there were a few more scholarly middle-aged men wearing glasses.
They were the principals of several prestigious high schools in Shanhai City, and today they had come personally to entice Lin Zichen to enroll in their schools.
No one had invited them.
They had insisted on entering the private room themselves.
This wasn't a matter of them being impolite.
The blame, if any, lay with Lin Zichen, who had performed too excellently over the past six years.
He had almost swept up all the awards in the city.
Moreover, he had always been in first place, never slipping.
Such dazzling achievements had made him the most talented primary school graduate in the history of Shanhai City, the crème de la crème in the eyes of every middle school principal.
Under the persuasion of several principals, Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin were very tempted.
No matter which school's offer they looked at, it all seemed very enticing, making it difficult for the couple to decide.
In the end, Zhang Wanxin turned toward Lin Zichen and asked in a gentle voice, "Xiao Chen, which school would you like to attend for junior high?"
"I'm fine with any, it depends on where Han Han wants to go."
Lin Zichen tossed the choice to Shen Qinghan, indifferent to which school he would attend for junior high,—with the perks he had, he could bulldoze his way through anywhere.
Upon hearing this, Shen Jianye and Xu Meng felt somewhat flattered and taken aback.
Shen Qinghan's performance was very strong, but she couldn't get into every school.
Especially the prestigious schools where the present principals worked, at best, Qinghan would barely scrape through to admission, and there was always a risk of failing.
But at this moment, because of Lin Zichen's single sentence, Shen Qinghan suddenly had the privilege to choose from any school, which left Shen Jianye and Xu Meng somewhat at a loss.
"Wanxin, I think it'd be better to let Xiao Chen make the decision himself."
Xu Meng looked at Zhang Wanxin and returned the choice to her, feeling that letting her own daughter decide would be too much pressure for them to bear.
Zhang Wanxin laughed, "It's fine, Xiao Chen will only go to the same middle school as Qinghan anyway, so let Qinghan choose what she likes."
After speaking, she turned her gaze to Shen Qinghan, smiling affectionately as she said, "Han Han, feel free to pick any middle school you want, this is Xiao Chen giving you the choice."
"Aunt Xin... I, I don't know."
Unsure how to choose, Shen Qinghan ultimately handed the decision back to Lin Zichen, "Xiao Chen, you choose."
Seeing that everyone was too embarrassed to choose, Lin Zichen had no choice but to decide himself.
He looked at the Shanhai High School's principal across from him and spoke politely, "Principal Chen, I have a request: I want to be in the same class as Shen Qinghan. Would that be possible?"
"Certainly, of course!" The principal of Shanhai High School beamed, nodding his head in rapid agreement.
Forget being in the same class—if it meant setting up a special class for the two of them and assigning the best teachers, the principal was willing to agree with his eyes closed.
Such was the cachet of genius.
After Lin Zichen had made his decision,
The principals of the other schools wisely took their leave, not staying to disturb the celebration of the two families.
The principal of Shanhai High School stayed a bit longer to say a few more words but quickly followed suit and left perceptively.
As the parents raised their glasses to celebrate,
Lin Zichen's mind moved, and he opened his achievement tasks to check his progress.
[Achievement: Dominate Nine Years of Compulsory Education]
[Reward: Gain Biometric Attribute — Survival of the Fittest]
[Title: Kindergarten King (Already Lit), Primary School Boss (Already Lit), Junior High Tyrant (Unlit)]
He had finally made it through primary school!
He was finally going to junior high!
As long as he lit the last title, "Junior High Tyrant," he could acquire the long-awaited Biometric Attribute "Survival of the Fittest"!
Feeling excitement he hadn't felt in a long time, Lin Zichen thought about showing his absolute dominance over the whole school once he started junior high, lighting up the title "Junior High Tyrant" in the first stage, and acquiring the Biometric Attribute "Survival of the Fittest" at the quickest speed possible.
...
PS: Holding out my bowl, begging for a Monthly Pass and recommendation votes!

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - 15: 15. Junior high! Start!
chapters.content:
During the summer break before entering junior high school,
Lin Zichen didn't waste his time doing nothing, just waiting for school to start.
He set a strict training schedule for himself.
Every day he completed 1,000 weighted push-ups, 1,000 weighted sit-ups, 1,000 weighted squats, and 300 weighted pull-ups.
In addition, he ran five kilometers twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening.
It wasn't a jog.
It was high-intensity interval running.
And the route he ran had ups and downs, thickets, and various obstacles.
The intensity of the training was immense each day.
If an ordinary person trained with such high intensity every day without giving their body any time to recover, they'd probably drop dead within three days.
But Lin Zichen, who possessed the "Use It or Lose It" trait, had a physical endurance far surpassing that of an ordinary person.
With the current training intensity, it wasn't enough to overtax his body; it only made him stronger with each session, his physique growing more powerful day by day.
"You have done 1,000 weighted push-ups, Qi-Blood +2000, arm muscle strength +2000, chest muscle strength +2000, push-up proficiency +1000"
"You have done 1,000 weighted sit-ups, Qi-Blood +2000, abdominal muscle strength +2000, sit-up proficiency +1000"
"You have done 1,000 weighted squats, Qi-Blood +2000, leg muscle strength +2000, squat proficiency +1000"
"You have done 300 weighted pull-ups, Qi-Blood +600, arm muscle strength +600, back muscle strength +600, pull-up proficiency +300"
"You have interval run for 10 kilometers, Qi-Blood +4396, stamina and endurance +1000, body coordination +1000, running speed +1000, running technique +1000"
"Your Biological Level has advanced to Ordinary Third Order"
During the summer vacation, over two months like a single day, Lin Zichen maintained this training intensity.
Finally, just as school was about to start, his Biological Level successfully broke through to Ordinary Third Order, and his physical attributes significantly improved.
He could easily lift a 700 kg weight with one hand.
He could do a vertical jump to a height of 4 meters from a standstill.
He could sprint 100 meters in just 6 seconds.
"Strength, jumping ability, and speed, all have been raised to these levels, and my Biological Level has just barely evolved to Ordinary Third Order. The value of this level is truly high," Lin Zichen couldn't help but exclaim after having just tested these three data himself in the wild.
Then, he muttered to himself, "I wonder what level that Capital City prodigy is at now, I'll check it when I get home."
With his strength far surpassing his peers, with no one close to being a match for him, he could only compare himself to the prodigy on the television.
...
When he returned home, he took a quick shower.
Afterward, Lin Zichen sprawled on the bed in his upstairs room, holding his cell phone to search for news about the Capital City prodigy.
This cell phone was a gift from Zhang Wanxin, a reward for his outstanding performance during his six years of elementary school.
Zhang Wanxin trusted his self-control and wasn't worried that he would become addicted to the phone's entertainment.
Soon, the news about the Capital City prodigy came up.
The most recent news was from three days ago.
The report was about a 14-year-old Capital City prodigy, who could easily lift a 2,000 kg alloy with one hand.
This strength data was more than three times that of Lin Zichen's current capacity.
"2,000 kg? Not bad," Lin Zichen murmured to himself, not taking the Capital City prodigy's strength data seriously.
Because he was well aware that the other's current strength was all thanks to the fusion with the Exotic Beast Gene.
It was the gene of the "Giant Strength Ant."
Normally, fusing the gene of such an Exotic Beast could increase one's strength by 4 to 8 times.
Let's assume the Capital City prodigy increased his strength fourfold.
Subtract that, and only 400 kg of strength remains.
Being able to lift 400 kg with one hand at 14 years old certainly is genius-level.
But when compared to Lin Zichen's 700 kg, it seems rather weak.
Not to mention, Lin Zichen is even younger than him.
Taking both aspects into account, the gap between the two was like heaven and earth.
"Sure enough, I have a brighter future."
Xiao Chen smiled, already fantasizing about just how powerful he would become after merging with the Exotic Beast Gene.
...
In a blink of an eye.
The date had arrived at September 1st.
Xiao Chen, who had been training intensively at home all summer, was finally welcoming the eagerly anticipated start of the school year.
Shanhai High School was not far from home, about a five-kilometer distance.
But because it was the start of the school year, the roads were congested, and it took Lin Yansheng over half an hour to drive there with difficulty and finally reach the school gate.
"Old Lin, it's too crowded near the school gate. I'm afraid it's difficult to find parking!"
From the car behind, Shen Jianye wound down the window and yelled to Lin Yansheng.
Lin Yansheng also stuck his head out and replied, "No problem, we can drive into the school later and look for a spot to park!"
Drive into the school?
Shen Jianye was a bit puzzled. Could cars be allowed into the school?
At that moment, the principal of Shanhai High School appeared at the security room door and instructed the security guard to let Lin Yansheng and Shen Jianye through.
Seeing this, Shen Jianye understood that the Lin family enjoyed privileges at Shanhai High School.
"Old Lin is really lucky, having fathered such a genius son like Xiao Chen. It's like one person has acquired the way, and the whole family benefits," Shen Jianye said enviously.
Xu Meng laughed and said, "It's not just their family that benefits; even our family has gained from it."
"That's true. Being neighbors with Old Lin's family, and moreover, our children getting along so well, we really have benefited," Shen Jianye replied with a smile.
Xu Meng said, "You better not say that in front of Han Han. It wouldn't be good if she heard it."
"Don't worry, I'm not brainless. I know what should be said and what shouldn't," Shen Jianye replied while driving the car into the school.
...
Soon enough.
Both families had parked their cars inside the school.
"Zi Chen, quick, quick, let's get out of the car and take a walk around the school to see if the environment is really as beautiful as the promotional video showed," Shen Qinghan said excitedly as soon as the car stopped, urging Xiao Chen, who was sitting beside her in the backseat of Lin Yansheng's car.
Xiao Chen smiled, got out of the car with Shen Qinghan, and began to wander around the campus aimlessly.
Meanwhile, the parents of both families followed the principal of Shanhai High School to the office to sit down for tea and handle the enrollment procedures.
...
"That guy is so handsome, and the girl next to him is really pretty, too."
"Why aren't those two wearing uniforms?"
"Could they be the children of one of the teachers?"
"..."
Wherever Xiao Chen and Shen Qinghan went, their exceptional looks caused a buzz of quiet chatter.
Xiao Chen listened without a ripple in his heart.
Shen Qinghan, on the other hand, felt utterly delighted, loving the compliments on her beauty.
It wasn't long before the two had made a complete round of the school.
Then they realized that the environment of Shanhai High School wasn't as beautiful as in the promotional videos, not even half as nice, hinting at some false advertising.
However, neither of them felt disappointed.
Both were well aware that promotional videos were all about selling an image, as fake as could be, just to be viewed and not taken seriously.
While wandering, Xiao Chen's phone rang.
It was a call from Zhang Wanxin.
She told him and Shen Qinghan to come over to the principal's office to meet the various subject teachers of their class.
...
PS: Holding out the bowl, asking for Monthly Pass and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - 16: 16. Making up for regrets
chapters.content:
Soon, Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan arrived at the principal's office.
As soon as they entered, they saw the room was packed with teachers, so full that there weren't enough seats for everyone, and half of them were standing.
"Come, Zichen, let me introduce you."
"This is your homeroom teacher, Mr. Guan Feng."
"This is your math teacher, Mr. Bai Yuanhe."
"This is your physics teacher..."
As soon as Lin Zichen entered, Principal Chen immediately got up and enthusiastically introduced him to the various subject teachers in the class.
The class he was in was the top class, where they started learning physics and chemistry in the first year of junior high, and even had extra competition classes, making the learning intensity very high.
"Zichen, the school has high hopes for you, and we hope that in the next three years, you can bring countless honors to the school."
After introducing the teachers, Principal Chen patted Lin Zichen's shoulder, placing great expectations on him.
Then, he asked Lin Zichen to communicate well with the subject teachers, while he turned to continue conversing with his parents.
On the other side, Shen Qinghan's family was sitting unnoticed in a corner of the office, feeling very out of place throughout the entire process.
For this, Shen Jianye and Xu Meng were very worried.
Their daughter was very smart and beautiful, but compared to Lin Zichen, who was the center of everyone's attention at the moment, she seemed too ordinary, even inconspicuous.
With such a big gap, the two children would gradually drift apart over time, eventually becoming people from two different worlds.
What should they do?
Unlike her parents, Shen Qinghan had never thought about these issues; she just thought Lin Zichen was amazing, and as his closest childhood friend, she felt very proud.
Look, this boy is not only handsome but also excels in both arts and athletics, exceptionally outstanding.
You might not believe it, but he is my childhood friend. We grew up together and have a super close relationship.
Are you jealous?
...
Lin Zichen didn't have much to talk about with the teachers.
By that time, he had already self-taught all the junior and senior high school courses, even completed calculus.
With the aid of the "Divine Human Wisdom Root," he had mastered them to a very high level.
Take math, for example; he could easily achieve perfect scores in every exam.
Therefore, Lin Zichen merely exchanged pleasantries with each teacher to get acquainted, then made up an excuse to leave with Shen Qinghan.
After the two children left.
Lin Yansheng noticed Shen Jianye and Xu Meng feeling awkward in the corner and realized his negligence.
In his earlier conversation with the principal, he had been so engrossed that he forgot about his two friends.
Once he realized this, he immediately directed the conversation towards his friends and told the teachers, "All teachers, our Xiao Chen and their Han Han have been the best of friends since childhood. They have promised each other to attend the same high school and university. I hope you can take special care of those two kids."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Wanxin also chimed in, "Xiao Chen has been stubborn since he was young, set on doing whatever he commits to. He and Han Han have planned to go to the same high school and university. Even if Han Han underperforms and only manages to go to an ordinary school, that child will certainly follow, so please, teachers, take care of them."
Principal Chen, being a cunning man, understood the implications and immediately smiled at the teachers, "As teachers of the class, you all must pay extra attention to these two children and ensure they don't fall behind in their studies."
After speaking, he proactively approached Shen Jianye and his wife for a friendly chat, inquiring about Shen Qinghan's situation.
Seeing this, the surrounding teachers also started conversing with Shen Jianye and Xu Meng.
Shen Jianye and Xu Meng felt honored and looked over to Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin, grateful for their friends' favor.
...
On the school sports field.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan sat on the grass.
The two enjoyed the tranquility of the moment, watching students come and go.
Soon, they too would become students at this school and spend three years of junior high here.
"Xiao Chen, look over there, there's a badminton court! Luckily, my dad has a pair of rackets in the car. Shall we go play badminton?"
"Sure."
The two quickly agreed, and immediately went back to the principal's office to get the car keys from Shen Jianye, and then took the badminton rackets from the car.
Next, they arrived at the badminton court.
"Xiao Chen, we are so lucky, just one court left, and we snagged it!" Shen Qinghan said excitedly.
Seeing her so overjoyed, Lin Zichen couldn't help feeling a bit envious.
This girl is so easily satisfied; such a little good thing can make her ecstatic.
"Xiao Chen, watch my Fairy Curving Ball!"
"Xiao Chen, I have another trick, the Magical Girl Deception Ball!"
"Xiao Chen, don't be too smug, you definitely won't be able to return my Celestial Scatter Ball!"
On the court, Shen Qinghan was like a child who never grew up, shouting various childish moves continuously, her delicate face full of brilliant smiles.
Watching Shen Qinghan acting so childishly, Lin Zichen was amused and found her inexplicably adorable.
While they were having a great time, two older boys who couldn't find an empty court to play badminton silently walked into their court.
Without saying anything, these two boys started playing their own game of badminton, completely ignoring Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan as if they were air.
"What are you doing? We were already playing here!"
Shen Qinghan looked at them with dissatisfaction.
However, those two boys didn't take her seriously at all.
Especially the crew-cut boy on the same side as her, who directly retorted:
"If you don't like it, go cool off elsewhere."
This was an outright displacement, particularly common in elementary and middle schools.
Some of the older students, often exploiting their age and size, liked to displace younger students from courts when they wanted to play basketball, badminton, or table tennis and couldn't find an empty court themselves.
In his past life as a student, Lin Zichen had seen this type of misconduct frequently.
Back then, powerless to stop it, he could only choose to look the other way or, when it happened to him, to swallow his pride.
But, times had changed.
It was time to rectify the regrets of his younger years.
Thinking this, Lin Zichen waited for the right moment. When the crew-cut boy on the opposite side hit the shuttlecock toward him, he quickly stepped forward and smashed it out of the court with a swift hit!
He held back, using less than ten percent of his strength.
Yet, the shuttlecock flew dozens of meters away, floating gently to the ground after a long while.
Seeing this exaggerated scene, the two court-crashing boys were utterly dumbfounded.
Lin Zichen, holding his racket, asked them expressionlessly, "Still want to play?"
Startled by his voice, both boys trembled and looked at Lin Zichen as if he were a monster, then quickly left without a word.
Lin Zichen picked up his shuttlecock, smiled gently at Shen Qinghan across the court, and said:
"Qinghan, let's continue."
"Oh, oh yes, let's continue."
Shen Qinghan, having recovered from her shock, picked up her racket and resumed playing badminton with Lin Zichen.
She, too, had been startled by the scene.
But, recalling how Lin Zichen, even as a second grader, had once grievously injured two adults in an alley, she quickly found it quite plausible.
...
PS: Setting out the bowl, asking for Monthly Passes and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 17 - 17: 17. Junior High School Sports Meeting
chapters.content:
As you grow up, time seems to move faster.
In the blink of an eye,
half a year had passed.
Lin Zichen felt as if he had just come to Shanhai High School to complete his enrollment yesterday, but before he knew it, the second term of seventh grade had arrived.
For him, life in middle school was not much different from that in elementary school or kindergarten.
Shen Qinghan was still his deskmate.
He continued to openly read his own books during class.
After school, he would secretly exercise his body intensely without his parents' knowledge.
The only difference was that after getting a cell phone, he often browsed various instructional videos online when he was bored at night, learning a myriad of new skills to empower himself.
Cooking, photography, driving, swimming, wilderness survival, and all sorts of sports - if it was available online and seemed somewhat useful, he would learn it.
After all, with the "Divine Human Wisdom Root" enhancing him, he learned everything quickly, so he had to make good use of it and not waste time.
During that time, in order to light up the title "Junior Middle School King" in seventh grade, Lin Zichen took the initiative to show himself off at school.
In the past term, he had been first in the entire school in every exam, without exception.
And he found time to participate in various national middle school competitions.
These included competitions in mathematics, physics, chemistry, and computer programming among others.
He won awards in every competition he participated in.
Whether it was gold, silver, bronze medals, or first, second, third prizes, or even precisely first, second, third places, he had won them all.
Actually, if he wanted to, he could have won gold medals, first prizes, first places in everything.
But if he did that, he wouldn't just be the local genius; he would be a national sensation.
Then, with all the attention pouring in, his peaceful life would inevitably be disrupted, and he would no longer be able to quietly continue his evolution.
This was not the life he wanted.
The reason he was so enthusiastic about exhibiting himself now was purely to light up the "Junior Middle School King" title as soon as possible.
Therefore, it sufficed to keep himself at the top of the school.
There was no need to go beyond that.
...
Today,
after Lin Zichen left home and had just arrived at school and entered the classroom, the homeroom teacher came to him, saying the school wanted him to hold a study sharing session in the afternoon.
In the past term, his performance had been so astounding that both the teachers and students in the school were curious about his study methods.
The leadership had wanted him to hold this study sharing session for a while now.
"Okay, I got it," Lin Zichen nodded, then lowered his head to continue reading his book.
Seeing his response, the homeroom teacher did not disturb him further.
However, his deskmate, Shen Qinghan, chuckled, prodding him and said, "Xiao Chen, you're going to be the star of the show again this afternoon, aren't you excited?"
"It's okay," Lin Zichen smiled and replied.
In the beginning, he quite enjoyed the spotlight, feeling like he was the chosen one.
But as it happened more and more, it gradually lost its appeal.
"You may think it's just okay, but your little fangirls won't see it that way. By the afternoon, the school auditorium is sure to be filled with them, and I won't even get a place to sit," said Shen Qinghan, dreadfully thinking about it.
Because Lin Zichen was handsome and had such excellent academic performance, having been at Shanhai High School for just half a year, he had already captivated countless young fangirls.
From seventh to ninth grade, there were many girls who admired him.
In just half a year, he had received hundreds of love letters.
"Don't worry, I'll ask the principal to reserve a front-row seat for you," Lin Zichen said carelessly to Shen Qinghan while he continued reading his book.
Upon hearing this, Shen Qinghan immediately felt delighted.
The two did not chat for long and soon busied themselves with their own tasks.
Lin Zichen silently read his book.
Shen Qinghan worked hard on test papers, striving to improve her academic scores.
The Honors class curriculum was too advanced for her.
Not only were there many subjects, but the questions were also difficult, making it a struggle for her to keep up.
In order to keep up with the class's teaching schedule, she could only spend more time studying, even using the breaks between classes to stay in her seat and practice problems.
"Xiao Chen, I don't know how to do this problem, and I can't even understand the answer, teach me," she said.
Shen Qinghan picked up a physics test paper and placed it in front of Lin Zichen, pointing with her pen at the last multiple-choice question about the analysis of forces on an object.
Lin Zichen quickly glanced at the question and soon moved over to sit next to Shen Qinghan with his paper and pen, shoulder to shoulder, and taught her how to solve it.
Seeing the two of them sitting so close together, the girls in the class showed expressions of envy on their faces, extremely envious of the close relationship Shen Qinghan had with Lin Zichen.
...
Time flew by.
The moment for the afternoon study sharing session arrived in the blink of an eye.
When Lin Zichen arrived at the lecture hall, he found it was just as Shen Qinghan had said—filled with his little fangirls.
But at the moment, what he cared about wasn't these fangirls, but the ten students sitting in the front row.
He remembered the faces of these ten students, who often appeared on the school's honor roll, the top academic achievers in their junior year.
To this, he was genuinely surprised; he hadn't expected even the junior year's top students to come to his study sharing session.
Junior year achievers attending a study session led by a freshman, if spoken aloud, would hardly be believed by anyone.
"It seems I've already become the king of studying within the school. Next, as long as I dominate in sports, I should be able to unlock the title of 'Junior High Tyrant,'" he thought.
Thinking this, Lin Zichen became excited inside, eager to show off his skills at the school sports event next month.
Soon, the study sharing session began.
The ten top students in the front row all listened intently, their ears perked up, fearing they would miss any detail.
Shen Qinghan, who was also sitting in the front row, was taking notes with a focused expression on her face.
The girls sitting further back, seeing how Shen Qinghan, an average student, was able to sit in the front row, were very envious of her being Lin Zichen's childhood friend and receiving special treatment from him.
...
One month later.
Shanhai High School was hosting its 70th Annual Sports Day.
The scheduling was strange.
It was set in April of the following semester, not in December of the previous semester.
Moreover, it was not celebrated with much pomp, lasting only one day.
It was evident that Shanhai High School did not place much emphasis on the Sports Day.
But even so, Lin Zichen still felt incredibly excited.
Because as long as he dominated the events today, it was highly likely he would unlock the title of 'Junior High Tyrant,' complete the achievement of 'Dominating Nine Years of Compulsory Education,' and thus gain the Biometric Attribute of 'Survival of the Fittest.'
"Participants who have signed up for the events, please go to your respective venues to check in; failure to do so within the time limit will be taken as forfeiture by default!"
A physical education teacher, serving as the chief referee, stood in the middle of the field and shouted through a megaphone.
Upon hearing this, Lin Zichen immediately went to check in.
He had signed up for individual events, namely the 100-meter sprint representing speed, the running long jump representing agility, and shot put representing strength.
"Zi Chen, you have to win the gold medal!" a junior shouted.
"Zi Chen, I will be waiting for you at the finish line when you run the 100 meters!" another junior exclaimed.
"Zi Chen, go for it!"
"..."
While Lin Zichen was in line to check in, several junior girls standing nearby shouted out to him with smiling faces.
Hearing their voices, he responded with a polite smile.
The juniors who saw his smile suddenly covered their mouths and let out a burst of giddy screams.
A boy standing behind Lin Zichen saw this and felt a sour twinge of jealousy in his heart.
He was a junior and a member of the school's Martial Arts Team with exceptional athletic talent, often representing the school in competitions.
Ordinarily, he looked down upon the school sports events as juvenile play.
But upon learning that Lin Zichen was participating, he specifically signed up to compete, aiming to take Lin Zichen down a notch.
He couldn't accept that the girl he secretly liked had become one of Lin Zichen's fangirls.
"Heh, I might not be as handsome as you, nor do I get grades as good as you, but would my athletic talent be any less? Just wait and see how I'll ride on your head and snatch first place!" the boy thought, looking at Lin Zichen ahead of him and impatient to thoroughly trounce him on the field.
...
PS: Asking for your votes—Monthly Pass and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - 18: 18. Dominate nine years of compulsory education
chapters.content:
It wasn't long before all the contestants had signed in.
A PE teacher in charge began organizing the opening ceremony for each class.
During this time, the athletes warmed up in the middle of the field.
"Xiao Chen, I bought you a sports drink. They say drinking this can improve your performance. Do you want some?"
Shen Qinghan walked up to Lin Zichen, who was stretching his tendons, and handed over the can with a bull printed on it.
Lin Zichen felt that it wasn't very useful, and he didn't need external help to improve his performance, but because Shen Qinghan bought it, he didn't think twice before taking a sip.
"How does it feel, Xiao Chen?"
"It seems to have some effect; I feel a bit more spirited."
Lin Zichen told a white lie on the spot.
After hearing this, Shen Qinghan smiled and made a cheering gesture, saying, "Xiao Chen, I'll be waiting for you to come back with three gold medals for a photo together."
"I will," Lin Zichen confidently replied.
The Martial Arts Team boy standing nearby laughed inwardly at his confidence in winning three gold medals.
...
About half an hour later.
The school sports meet's opening ceremony finally concluded.
The competition officially began!
The first event Lin Zichen signed up for was shot put, followed by the high jump, and finally the highlight event, the 100-meter dash.
"Zi Chen, go for the first place! Your senior believes in you!"
As Lin Zichen queued up for the shot put, a girl in the crowd to his left waved at him.
Lin Zichen turned with a smile, only politely acknowledging her, nothing more.
The Martial Arts Team boy in front of Lin Zichen felt utterly tormented by the scene, internally begging for the competition to start quickly.
Because the girl cheering for Lin Zichen was the one he had a secret crush on.
Soon, it was the Martial Arts Team boy's turn to throw the shot put.
He picked up the shot and with a fierce twist, flung it from his hand.
After a moment, the judge's voice echoed from the front.
"15.67 meters!"
As soon as the distance was announced, the spectators all "wow"ed, shocked by the result.
Lin Zichen, queuing behind, raised an eyebrow, surprised that a middle schooler could throw the shot put so far.
15.67 meters was a distance that could qualify one as a first-tier athlete in his previous life.
At the end of the day, the world was different.
People in this world had far greater physical prowess than those in his past life.
Leaving the white line, the Martial Arts Team boy looked back at Lin Zichen with an air of self-satisfaction.
Lin Zichen felt somewhat baffled, unable to understand why the boy felt the need to look back at him with such a proud expression.
"Xiao Chen, go for the gold!"
Not far to the side, Shen Qinghan clenched her delicate fists, cheering Lin Zichen on.
Lin Zichen also smiled and returned a supportive gesture before walking to the white line, casually pushing the shot put forward.
As a result, the shot put flew out as if launched from a cannon, covering a great distance instantly!
The PE teacher responsible for recording the distances couldn't hide his astonishment at the sight.
After snapping out of it, he hurriedly grabbed the tape measure to find out how far it had been thrown.
"20.12 meters!"
The moment this number was called out, a huge gasp of surprise erupted from the crowd.
Everyone's face was filled with shock.
Especially the Martial Arts Team boy, who was so stunned that his mouth hung open wide enough to swallow the shot put, his face filled with disbelief.
How can this be possible!
How could he throw it 20 meters?!
He's just a freshman in junior high!
I must be dreaming!
Thinking this, a boy from the Martial Arts Team raised his hand and slapped his own face, it hurt a lot, it was reality!
The people nearby looked baffled, not understanding why he would slap himself for no reason.
"Xiao Chen, you're so awesome!"
Shen Qinghan, holding her phone that had just captured a few photos, excitedly ran towards Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen touched her head and smiled, "I've already gotten one gold medal, two more to go, you just wait to take pictures for me after the sports meeting is over."
...
In the following time.
Lin Zichen participated in the running long jump and the 100-meter sprint one after another.
As expected, he took first place without any suspense in all of them, smoothly collecting three gold medals.
The boy from the Martial Arts Team, who was previously filled with confidence to outperform him, ended up with a life full of doubts, getting three silver medals, and was completely dumbfounded.
"Zi Chen, junior, you're too amazing, all gold medals, your senior sister admires you so much!"
"Zi Chen, junior, I bought you some water!"
"Zi Chen, junior! Drink mine! Drink mine! I bought you a sports drink that can help you recover your strength quickly!"
Lin Zichen had just gotten off the stadium stage with three gold medals when he was surrounded by several enthusiastic senior sisters.
They formed a tight circle around him, making it impossible for him to walk away.
Shen Qinghan, holding a sports drink she had just bought, stood on the outside trying to hand it to him but couldn't reach.
Seeing this, Lin Zichen in the middle had no choice but to say to the senior sisters surrounding him:
"Thanks for the kind thoughts, senior sisters, I've brought my own water, I'll just drink that."
After saying this, he squeezed out from the group and walked over to Shen Qinghan to take the sports drink she was offering, unscrewed the cap, and began to drink deeply.
"Xiao Chen, you're so popular at school, even the ninth-grade senior sisters have become your little fangirls," Shen Qinghan said enviously.
Lin Zichen screwed the cap back on and chuckled, "But I don't need so many little fangirls, having you as my little fangirl is enough for me."
"I'm not your little fangirl, I'm your childhood friend, okay?" Shen Qinghan pouted her rosy lips, displaying her dissatisfaction.
Lin Zichen just laughed and didn't say anything.
The girls around them all looked on with envy at this scene.
They were all so envious of Shen Qinghan.
An ordinary girl, yet she had a childhood friend who was not only handsome but also good at studying and had great athletic abilities. It looked just like a fairy tale of Cinderella and the Prince.
Shen Qinghan, feeling the envious gazes from the girls around her, felt delighted inside. Having Lin Zichen as her envy-evoking childhood friend made her feel like she owned the whole world.
After finishing the drink in a moment.
The two took a lot of nice photos together.
When they were satisfied with the pictures, they walked back to the classroom together, packed up their things, and rode home on a bike.
Because her home was a bit far from the school, Zhang Wanxin specially bought Lin Zichen a bicycle to make it convenient for him to ride to and from school with Shen Qinghan.
On the way back to the classroom.
Lin Zichen suddenly remembered something and immediately sent his thoughts into the void.
Right after that, he finally saw the message he had been eagerly awaiting.
[Your academic and athletic achievements have utterly outclassed everyone in the school, making all the students pale in comparison, successfully unlocking the title—Junior High Tyrant]
[Kindergarten Kid King title, Elementary School Boss title, Junior High Tyrant title all unlocked, dominating the nine years of compulsory education, achievement reached]
[Biometric Attribute acquired: Survival of the Fittest]
...
PS: I'm begging, please give me your monthly and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - 19: 19. The Origin of Life
chapters.content:
[Survival of the Fittest: Your life essence reigns supreme over all, capable of devouring the life essence of other beings to promote your own evolution]
The moment Lin Zichen saw this text, the first thought that surfaced in his mind was: ——There are ranks and grades within life itself.
It felt like a return to the primitive natural world.
Survival of the fittest, only the adapted survive.
However, he didn't dwell on this thought for long and quickly focused his mind on the words "life essence".
Life essence?
What did it refer to?
Suddenly, Lin Zichen remembered the animal teeth that the white-haired girl had given to him and Shen Qinghan. He recalled that when he had studied the teeth before, he had found they contained a vibrant life force.
So, he turned to Shen Qinghan, who was walking beside him humming a tune, and asked,
"Han Han, can you take down your beast tooth and let me take a look?"
"Why do you suddenly want to see the beast tooth?"
Shen Qinghan obediently took off the beast tooth and handed it to him, asking with some confusion.
Lin Zichen made up a reason on the spot, "I feel the material of this beast tooth is quite good, I was wondering if it could be made into jewelry for you."
"Ah?" Shen Qinghan was a bit stunned by the comment and then said with a troubled face, "Zi Chen, this is a gift from Bai Xue to us, isn't it inappropriate to just turn it into something else without permission?"
"That's true, we won't modify it then," Lin Zichen said nonchalantly, his attention fully on the beast tooth in his hand, feeling for the vibrant life force within it.
The moment he felt the life force, the palm of his hand holding the beast tooth suddenly warmed, and in the next moment, the vitality of the beast tooth surged into him through his palm.
At the same time, several lines of text appeared in the void.
[You have devoured a strand of the "Abyssal Giant Butterfly's" life essence]
[Abyssal Giant Butterfly Album: 1%]
[When the album progress bar reaches 100%, you can evolve certain attributes or skills of the corresponding exotic beast]
Could this be a butterfly's tooth?
Lin Zichen finished reading the text and looked down at the beast tooth in his hand as thick as his little finger, feeling quite amazed and incredulous.
It could only be said that the exotic beasts on this mutated Earth were all strange creatures that couldn't be understood with past knowledge.
Soon, Lin Zichen's thoughts returned to [Survival of the Fittest].
In plain terms, this trait meant that he now had the ability to devour other living beings to become stronger.
This gave him a lot of ideas.
For animals like ants, mosquitoes, flies, cockroaches, which are omnipresent, could he also devour their life essence and thereby acquire their attributes or skills?
For instance...the cockroach's tenacity for life?
He would need to find some small animals to test the [Survival of the Fittest] trait after getting back home.
"Xiao Chen, you see this beast tooth every day, don't you? Why are you so engrossed in it all of a sudden?"
Seeing Lin Zichen standing still, staring at the beast tooth in his hand without moving for a long time, Shen Qinghan was puzzled.
Lin Zichen, hearing this, pulled his mind back from the void but didn't elaborate much. He casually brushed off her inquiry and returned the beast tooth to Shen Qinghan before going back to the classroom with her.
Though all the vitality in the beast tooth had been drained, it was different from flesh and blood; it wouldn't decay and could still be preserved for a long time.
...
It wasn't long before they got back to the classroom.
As soon as he entered, Lin Zichen was shocked by the state of his drawer.
The previously rather empty drawer was now filled to the brim with love letters, so full that not a sliver of space could be seen.
Without having to think about it, it must have been from a girl who has a secret crush on him. Too shy to give him the love letters in person, she took the opportunity when he wasn't in the classroom to stuff a pile of love letters she had accumulated over time into his drawer.
After all, this wasn't the first time he had encountered such a situation.
"So many love letters, how should I deal with these?"
Looking at the love letters in the drawer, Lin Zichen felt quite troubled.
At that moment, Shen Qinghan handed him another love letter, almost taking pleasure in his misfortune, "Earlier on the sports field, the study monitor from the class next door asked me to give this to you. She was too embarrassed to find you."
Another one... Lin Zichen took the love letter from Shen Qinghan and felt even more troubled.
He sighed to himself and began to clear out all the love letters from the drawer.
During the process, he glanced at the handwriting on the covers and was somewhat surprised to find that it wasn't just love letters from one person, but as many as over a dozen people mixed together.
"These girls have quite good qualities, not throwing away their competitors' love letters."
Lin Zichen laughed wryly through his frustration.
He then neatly stacked all the love letters in his hand, intending to find a secluded spot to dispose of them.
Seeing the situation, Shen Qinghan immediately intervened, "Xiao Chen, don't throw those love letters away. If the girls who wrote them found out, how heartbroken would they be? If you don't want them, I can keep them for you. Whenever you want to take a look, you can always come and get them from me."
After saying that, she took all the love letters from Lin Zichen's hands and stuffed them into her little backpack.
Lin Zichen was happy to let her do so, since it saved him the trouble.
Just at that moment, he suddenly remembered that he had a beast tooth given to him by a girl with white hair in his backpack and casually swallowed it.
[You have consumed a strand of the "Abyssal Giant Butterfly's" life essence]
[Abyssal Giant Butterfly Collection: 2%]
Now that he knew the name of this Exotic Beast, he wondered whether he could find any information related to it online?
Well, let's have a look.
Thinking this, Lin Zichen immediately took out his phone and searched for the words "Abyssal Giant Butterfly."
Back in elementary school, he had once taken a photo of the tooth of an Abyssal Giant Butterfly and uploaded it to the big data image recognition online, but it was to no avail.
Now, knowing the specific name, he should have a good chance to find related information.
However, the subsequent results disappointed Lin Zichen.
There was no information about the "Abyssal Giant Butterfly" online, confirming that it was an unknown Exotic Beast not yet discovered and recorded by humans.
So much for that, the Abyssal Giant Butterfly collection could be sentenced to death. With no related information available, there was no way to fill up its progress bar.
Unless he could meet the mother of the white-haired girl and get information about the Abyssal Giant Butterfly from her.
…
After leaving the classroom.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan went together to the school's bike shed and pushed out a brand-new bicycle.
This bike had been purchased half a year ago, but it still looked as new.
That's mainly because Qinghan cherished it, cleaning it every other day.
Soon, both of them were pushing the bike toward the school's gate.
While passing by the school's snack bar, Shen Qinghan suddenly said she wanted a lollipop, so Lin Zichen bought one for her.
"Here, eat it. You're already so grown up and still want someone to feed you."
Lin Zichen unwrapped the lollipop and held it up to Shen Qinghan's mouth.
Shen Qinghan, who was already used to such closeness, took the lollipop in her mouth. After tasting the sweetness, she smiled with her beautiful eyes curving and said:
"I can't help it, just that it feels sweeter when you feed it to me."
"It's all psychological."
While saying so, Lin Zichen saw Shen Qinghan's cheeks bulging with the lollipop, and he couldn't resist poking her cheek.
Shen Qinghan took out the lollipop and pouted her glossy lips in discontent, "Don't poke my face."
"But your face is so soft, it feels good to poke," Lin Zichen said with a smile.
"If it feels good, then you can pinch or rub it, just don't poke. Poking doesn't feel good."
"Okay, I'll pinch from now on."
"No, better to rub, that's comfy."
"…"
The two of them teased each other a bit more and continued pushing the bike towards the school entrance.
When they passed the school path by the playground.
Lin Zichen saw members of the school's Martial Arts Team exercising on the field and noticed a familiar face among them.
It was none other than the unlucky guy who had tearfully won three silver medals following him during the school's sports meet.
At the moment, this unfortunate soul was sprinting desperately on the grass field with a strip of cloth tied around his waist, which was connected to a tire lying flat on the ground by a rope to increase friction.
This was a common training method used to enhance the explosive power of leg muscles.
"Xiao Chen, that boy on the grass is training so hard. Has he been motivated by you from the sports meet?" Shen Qinghan whispered with the lollipop in her mouth.
Lin Zichen: "Could be."
Just as he spoke, the coach of the Martial Arts Team, who was there encouraging the members to train, turned to look in his direction.
Then, he directly walked over.
Shen Qinghan panicked, speaking nervously, "Oh no, Xiao Chen, were we speaking too loud just now? Did he hear us?"
"It's fine; we didn't say anything bad anyway," Lin Zichen reassured the timid Shen Qinghan.
…
PS: Begging for monthly and recommendation votes!

chapters.title: Chapter 20 - 20: 20. Research the attributes of [Survival of the Fittest]
chapters.content:
However, after just a moment, the coach of the Martial Arts Team walked up to them and stopped.
Yet, contrary to expectations, he was not there to start trouble, but rather to invite Lin Zichen to join the Martial Arts Team.
"Zi Chen, I am Coach Guo from the school's Martial Arts Team. I witnessed your astonishing performance at the school's sports meet today, and I was deeply impressed," he said.
"In all the years I have been at Shanhai High School, I have never seen a student with such good academic performance and yet such extraordinary athletic abilities."
"I personally believe that your talent in sports is definitely more exceptional than your talent in academics."
"Therefore, I would like to invite you to join the school's Martial Arts Team."
"Of course, this invitation may seem a bit sudden, and you can learn more about the Martial Arts Team first before making a decision."
"Room C of the school gym is our Martial Arts Team's headquarters, and you can come over to get to know us anytime tomorrow or whenever you're free," he added.
Guo Xiangyuan finished his piece without giving Lin Zichen a chance to interject.
He truly believed that Lin Zichen's athletic talent far surpassed his academic talent.
After all, as a study prodigy who always came first in exams, he would surely spend most of his time on academics, with little time to exercise his body.
Despite that, Lin Zichen was able to dominate over the members of the Martial Arts Team at the school sports meet and win three gold medals.
Without a doubt, this was a rising star in the future martial arts world.
If Lin Zichen did not choose the path of martial arts, it would be an atrocity that provoked the wrath of both gods and men!
Watching the coach of the Martial Arts Team, who came up and spoke non-stop like a salesperson, Lin Zichen frowned slightly, not having a great impression of him.
So, as soon as he finished talking, Lin Zichen immediately responded with a polite smile, "We'll see. I need to go home now, goodbye Coach Guo."
After saying that, Lin Zichen pushed his bicycle and left with Shen Qinghan.
Once they were out of the school gates, he hopped onto his bicycle and said to the Shen Qinghan beside him:
"Han Han, get on."
"Xiao Chen, how about I give you a ride home today?" Shen Qinghan asked, holding a lollipop and hopping around the front of the bicycle, looking eager to try.
Upon hearing this, Lin Zichen adamantly refused:
"Forget it, you almost fell into a ditch last time you rode alone, let alone with me on it. It's more likely that you'll kill me."
"But that was just an accident."
"Give it up. With those thin legs of yours, you certainly can't pedal a bicycle carrying another person."
"Alright, I'll listen to you then."
Shen Qinghan wasn't stubborn and obediently went back to the rear seat of the bike, wrapping her arms around Lin Zichen's waist with practiced ease.
Once Lin Zichen saw she was secured, he started pedaling smoothly and took off.
He didn't seem to use much force, but the bike was not slow at all, quickly covering a distance of over a hundred meters.
Lin Zichen's cycling skills were excellent, comparable to a professional cyclist, as he weaved delicately through the bustling streets and alleys without causing a single pedestrian to curse at him.
Sitting at the back, Shen Qinghan wrapped her arms around Lin Zichen's waist, the lollipop still in her mouth, feeling the breeze in her face and a sense of exhilaration.
Many of the female students from Shanhai High School walking by the roadside looked enviously at Shen Qinghan as they saw her seated at the back of Lin Zichen's bicycle.
Shen Qinghan had lost count of how many times she had been the object of envy among girls her age.
Every time she felt envied, her heart swelled with joy.
And as she reveled in the feeling, she let out an involuntary, giddy laugh.
"Why are you suddenly laughing like a fool?"
"It's nothing."
"The green light ahead is about to change, I'm going to sprint, hold on tight."
"Xiao Chen, I'm holding tight, go faster, the green light is about to end!"
"Then I'm going for it!"
"Go! Fly, my little witch! Faster!"
With the lollipop in her mouth making her words unclear, Shen Qinghan urged him to pick up the pace, her bangs fluttering high in the breeze, her face beaming with excitement.
Lin Zichen, who was responsible for pedaling, was furiously pushing the pedals at the front, afraid of missing the soon-to-fade green light at the upcoming intersection.
...
```
He stopped at the front door of his home.
Lin Zichen bade Shen Qinghan farewell before pushing his bicycle into the house.
As soon as he entered, Zhang Wanxin greeted him with a face full of enthusiasm, asking with a beaming smile,
"Xiao Chen, how did the school sports meet go today? Did you get all gold medals?"
"Yeah, I won three gold medals."
Lin Zichen took off his backpack, unzipped it, and took out three gold medals to hand to Zhang Wanxin.
Zhang Wanxin was overjoyed, her eyes squinting into slits as she spoke with exuberant joy,
"I knew it, my Xiao Chen is a genius, talented both in literature and martial arts!"
Having said that, she turned to look at Lin Yansheng, who was sitting on the sofa absorbed in watching a soccer match, and shouted at him with some dissatisfaction,
"Mr. Lin, your son won three gold medals at the school sports meeting. Aren't you going to come over and praise your son? What are you still watching the match for!"
"Eh, I'm coming, I'm coming!"
Lin Yansheng came over with a chuckling jog.
Afterward, the family of three each wore a gold medal and took a joyful family photo in the house.
It was mainly Zhang Wanxin's idea; she wanted to show off her son on her Moments.
...
After dinner,
Lin Zichen went up to the vegetable-filled rooftop to hunt for mosquitoes.
He wanted to test the effect of the "Survival of the Fittest" property to see if he could absorb the mosquitoes' Life Origin and thereby gain their attributes or abilities.
However, after killing more than 20 mosquitoes, there was no emergence of the anticipated text information in the void.
It seemed that mosquitoes did not possess a Life Origin.
Or rather... it was so negligible as to be insignificant.
In the interest of thoroughness, he stopped targeting mosquitoes and returned to the house to hunt cockroaches.
After more than two hours, he had killed over ten cockroaches.
But the result was the same; there was no Life Origin to absorb.
"Could it be that ordinary creatures don't work, and Exotic Beasts are required?"
Lin Zichen thought of this and felt it was almost certainly the case.
Perhaps only the powerful beings like the Exotic Beasts had enough Life Origin in them to be absorbed.
For insects like mosquitoes and cockroaches dwelling at the bottom of the food chain, the Life Origin they contained was likely so minuscule it was virtually negligible.
Otherwise, it would be hard to explain the results of the experiments.
After all, the annotation for "Survival of the Fittest" mentioned living beings, not specifically Exotic Beasts.
Having realized this, Lin Zichen decided to head to the mall.
In this world, malls sold products related to the Exotic Beasts.
Although the prices were astronomical and he couldn't afford them,
that didn't stop Lin Zichen from wanting to look and verify his own guesses.
Once he had this idea,
Lin Zichen went downstairs to find Zhang Wanxin, made up an excuse that he needed to buy something, and successfully got permission to go out.
"Xiao Chen, where are you heading?"
Just as he was pushing his bicycle out of the house, Lin Zichen heard a shout from the balcony of the neighboring house.
He looked up to see Shen Qinghan leaning out from her balcony to catch the breeze.
"I'm going to the mall to buy some stuff!"
"I want to go, too. Wait for me, I'll tell my parents and be right there!"
After dropping that line, Shen Qinghan quickly left the balcony and went back inside to inform Shen Jianye and Xu Meng that she was going out with Lin Zichen.
