chapters.title: Chapter 21 - 21: 21. Ghost Squid
chapters.content:
It wasn't long before Shen Qinghan hurried down from upstairs, afraid to keep Lin Zichen waiting too long downstairs.
"Why did you come out in your pajamas?"
"I came down in such a hurry that I forgot to change."
"Then go back and change."
"I'm too lazy to go back. Let's hurry to the mall to shop. My dad just gave me 200 yuan, now I'm a little rich lady. Whatever you want to buy later, it's on me!"
Shen Qinghan skillfully sat on the rear seat of Lin Zichen's bicycle, waving two crisp hundred-yuan notes in front of him, her delicate face radiating triumph.
Lin Zichen felt the 1,000 yuan in his pocket but didn't want to burst her bubble, so he smiled and said:
"Okay, tonight Shen miss will pick up the tab."
"Stop talking, let's get going. Otherwise, we won't have much time to shop if it gets too late, and my parents will definitely call to urge me to come home early."
"Then hold on tight."
"I'm holding on tight!"
Shen Qinghan said with a smile, wrapping her arms around Lin Zichen's waist.
Lin Zichen didn't waste words, he just pedaled hard, and in the next moment, the bike's speed soared.
...
Hua Mao New World, first-floor main entrance.
Lin Zichen found a spot to park his bicycle, and quickly he and Shen Qinghan made their way to the top floor of the mall.
If it were daytime, he would first take Shen Qinghan for a stroll in the regular commercial district below to eat, drink, and have fun.
But it was too late now, and he needed to rush to the Exotic Beast Commercial District at the very top to touch Exotic Beast Meat and verify his speculation.
"Xiao Chen, what do you want to buy? Why did you run up here?"
In the Exotic Beast Commercial District at the top, Shen Qinghan was somewhat bewildered by the dazzling array of Exotic Beast products in front of her.
A glance over the goods revealed that the prices of the merchandise were exorbitant, with each item pricier than the last. Her 200 yuan was simply not substantial enough to make any purchases.
Lin Zichen honestly said, "Actually, I didn't really want to buy anything. I just wanted to come here to take a closer look at Exotic Beast Meat."
Shen Qinghan nodded, showing she understood.
Lin Zichen had always been fascinated by Exotic Beasts since he was a child, so it was normal for him to want to see what Exotic Beast Meat looked like up close.
"Then let's hurry and look around. I'm quite curious about Exotic Beasts, too."
Shen Qinghan, who had often read books about Exotic Beasts with Lin Zichen when she was younger, and who had accidentally wet several of his books, still remembered those moments vividly to this day.
Soon, the two of them began to browse through the Exotic Beast merchandise area.
Besides Exotic Beast Meat, there were many other derivative products related to Exotic Beasts.
There were jewelry pieces made from Exotic Beast Scales and Armor.
There were figurines modeled after the appearance of Exotic Beasts.
There were specimens of small Exotic Beasts and so on.
Lin Zichen wasn't interested in these items. He just accompanied Shen Qinghan for a quick look around before heading straight to the section selling Exotic Beast Meat.
He looked at various pieces of Exotic Beast Meat and found that all of it had been cut and processed in such a way that it was impossible to identify the original Exotic Beast.
Moreover, crucially, all of it was wrapped in transparent cling film, sealed airtight, and therefore untouchable; he couldn't test the swallowing effect of his power "Survival of the Fittest."
He persisted and carefully made his way around the area.
Finally, in a corner, he found some Exotic Beast Meat that could be touched.
It was freshly butchered meat with a staff member nearby, packing and portioning it.
"Han Han, wait here for me a sec," he said.
"What are you going to do?"
"I'm going to touch the Exotic Beast Meat over there."
```
"Ah?"
Shen Qinghan was a bit confused.
Lin Zichen didn't explain much to her and, taking advantage of the packaging staff's inattention, quietly moved closer from the staff's blind spot.
Next, he reached out to touch the piece of fresh Exotic Beast Meat closest to him.
The moment he touched it, Lin Zichen felt the vitality contained within the Exotic Beast Meat.
It was extremely vigorous, rich, and powerful!
Instinctively, Lin Zichen wanted to devour all of the life essence within the Exotic Beast Meat, leaving nothing behind.
No, that's not right, he couldn't do that!
If the meat lost its vitality, it would probably spoil.
If he wanted it, he would need to buy it with his own money...
Lin Zichen's rationality overcame his instinct, and he quickly came to his senses, refraining from the improper act of stealing the vitality from the Exotic Beast Meat.
Although he could have carried out the act discreetly, and there was a high probability it wouldn't have been discovered if he did it just once,
but once he started down that path, he couldn't imagine what kind of person he would become later on.
If not unexpected, there was a high probability he would turn into a desperado who likes toget by without effort, deceive, and indulge in robbery and plunder.
It's acceptable not to be a good person, but he must not become a bad person, at least he mustn't discard his character.
Thinking this way, Lin Zichen quickly returned to where Shen Qinghan was standing.
Seeing him return, Shen Qinghan immediately asked with curiosity, "Zi Chen, what does the Exotic Beast Meat feel like to touch? Is it any different from regular meat?"
"It doesn't feel much different; if I have to say there's a difference, it just seems a bit fresher," Lin Zichen answered nonchalantly.
At this moment, he had confirmed the guess in his heart, that indeed only Exotic Beast Meat had sufficient life essence for him to devour.
With that in mind, he would have to find a way to make money to buy Exotic Beast Meat to devour in the future.
Without giving it much more thought, Lin Zichen continued to wander around the area with Shen Qinghan.
Looking here and there, they found everything to be very novel.
Aside from a few low-priced derivative products, most of the goods related to Exotic Beasts were extremely expensive luxury items, beyond the reach of ordinary families.
It was hard not to feel awed by seeing so many of them at once.
He felt that they had browsed enough.
His horizons had been sufficiently widened.
Lin Zichen stopped in front of a counter selling Exotic Beast Meat, pointed to a type known as "Phantom Squid Meat" inside the counter, and said to the female clerk,
"Hello, I'd like to buy a pound of this meat."
Having browsed for so long, Phantom Squid Meat was the cheapest Exotic Beast Meat he had seen, and the only one he could afford.
The price was 998 per pound.
The second-cheapest kind of Exotic Beast Meat cost 2000 per pound.
With such a significant price difference, there was no need to consider which one to choose.
"You want to buy this? Where are your parents, are you alone?"
The female clerk, looking at Lin Zichen in his Shanhai High School uniform, was full of suspicion, not understanding how a middle school student could come here to buy Exotic Beast Meat.
Lin Zichen took out 1000 yuan from his pocket, placed it on the counter, and calmly said, "Yes, just me alone, I would like to buy a pound of Phantom Squid Meat."
"That won't work, you're too young, you can't buy it," the female clerk refused to sell to Lin Zichen.
After all, the amount was too large, and selling it to a minor was very risky, as the parents would most likely come after the fact to settle the account.
Lin Zichen knew the clerk's concerns, so he could only make a video call to Zhang Wanxin, seeking her consent to buy the Phantom Squid Meat in front of the female clerk.

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - 22: 22. Heretical Sect Traitor
chapters.content:
"Mom, I want to spend 998 yuan on half a kilo of Phantom Squid Meat—it's Exotic Beast Meat," Xiao Chen said.
"No problem, if you want to buy it, go ahead. Once you bring it back, I'll cook it for you," Zhang Wanxin cheerfully agreed without a second thought, assuming Lin Zichen just wanted to eat the Phantom Squid Meat.
Though spending 1000 yuan per half kilo on meat was a bit extravagant for their ordinary family.
But since her son had always been sensible, never wasting a penny, she definitely had to agree now that he rarely wanted to buy something.
After a brief chat, Lin Zichen quickly ended the video call.
Right after that, he saw that Zhang Wanxin had transferred 2000 yuan to him on WeChat, along with a text message telling him to buy a bit more and invite Han Han's family over for a meal.
Lin Zichen replied with a "Thanks, Mom," then looked at the sales clerk in front of him and said, "My mom has agreed to the purchase, please pack up three kilos of Phantom Squid Meat for me."
"Sure thing, I'll get it packed up right away," the saleswoman said with an enthusiastic smile.
A moment later.
Lin Zichen paid 2994 yuan and left, carrying the three kilos of packaged Phantom Squid Meat.
On the way, Shen Qinghan couldn't help asking, "Didn't you say you were just coming to have a look at the Exotic Beast Meat? Why did you suddenly buy it?"
"Because I wanted to buy it for you to eat."
"I don't believe that, it's obviously you who wants to eat it," Shen Qinghan said, before sighing, "This Exotic Beast Meat is 998 yuan per half kilo, so expensive, and who knows how it tastes."
Lin Zichen didn't say anything more, he was just feeling a headache over whether or not to consume the Phantom Squid Meat.
Originally, he wanted to secretly buy some Phantom Squid Meat to consume, but as a minor, he couldn't make the purchase without parental consent.
Now that his family knew he had bought Phantom Squid Meat, they were all waiting for him to bring it back home to eat—how was he supposed to consume it now?
The meat wasn't like teeth, if the Life Origin within it were consumed, it would likely rot away.
"Seems like I can only consume a little bit for now. I'll have to find a proxy to help me buy Exotic Beast Meat in the future," he decided.
Lin Zichen quietly reached into the bag to touch and consume a small portion of the Phantom Squid Meat.
It wasn't much, just a small piece weighing about 50 grams.
[You have consumed a trace of the "Phantom Squid's" Life Origin.]
[Phantom Squid compendium: 0.1%.]
Consuming 50 grams of meat had given him a compendium progress of 0.1%.
By that calculation, he would need to consume 100 kilos of meat to fill the compendium's progress bar to 100%.
And the price of Phantom Squid Meat was just 998 yuan per half kilo.
That meant spending roughly 100,000 yuan would enable him to unlock the Phantom Squid compendium.
The amount wasn't prohibitively expensive.
Lin Zichen decided that he would buy and consume Phantom Squid Meat from now on.
About the Phantom Squid, this Exotic Beast, he had read about them in books when he was very young.
He knew that they were common low-level Exotic Beasts that mainly lived thousands of meters deep underwater, occasionally swimming to shallow areas to hunt.
They had a special ability that allowed them to dissolve and disappear into the water in an instant, appearing ghost-like, which is why they were named Phantom Squids.
Moreover, because they were weak in shallow waters and plentiful in numbers, making them easy to capture, they gradually became a food source for humans and circulated in the various Exotic Beast markets.
"Instantly dissolving and disappearing into the water? I hope I'll gain that ability after unlocking the compendium," Lin Zichen thought to himself.
With that thought, he took out the piece of meat whose Life Origin he had consumed, intending to find a trash can to throw it away.
After all, with no Life Origin left, the meat was definitely spoiled, and it needed to be discarded.
However, upon inspecting the piece of meat he took out, he was surprised to find that it hadn't rotted!
He couldn't tell if it was just psychological, but it seemed less fresh to look at.
But that didn't affect its edibility.
Lin Zichen was a bit stunned.
How could the meat not have spoiled, even though its Life Origin had been consumed?
What exactly was Life Origin?
Could it be genes?
Or rather, are genes a type of Life Origin?
After all, the term "origin" seems to encompass a broad range.
Lin Zichen couldn't figure it out, so he decided to look for answers on the internet.
Taking out his phone, he opened the browser and searched for "Life Origin" with a hint of expectation.
But he found nothing.
There was no such term as Life Origin.
Forget it, no need to fixate on it, it's enough to know that the meat won't spoil after being devoured by Life Origin.
Soon, Lin Zichen devoured the remaining Phantom Squid Meat.
He raised the completion progress of the album to 3%.
After finishing these tasks, he took Shen Qinghan downstairs to stroll around the ordinary commercial district.
Shen Qinghan spotted a claw crane machine, really liked the stuffed animals inside, and without giving it a second thought, she went to play.
She was both unskilled and keen to play; in just a moment, she had spent 20 yuan and hadn't managed to grab a single stuffed animal.
Lin Zichen just couldn't stand by and watch, so he had to step in to help her.
After just three attempts, he had a perfect record and grabbed her three of her favorite stuffed animals.
Time flew by, and before they knew it, it was already 10 p.m.
Since they had classes the next day, the two didn't stay in the mall for long and quickly left the mall to ride home.
"Xiao Chen, the night breeze feels so comfortable," she said.
"Indeed, it's comfortable," he replied.
"I really love the three stuffed animals you helped me win," she said.
"I'm glad you like them," he replied.
"Xiao Chen, I can't wait to taste the Phantom Squid Meat. I've never eaten Exotic Beast Meat in my whole life," she said.
"..."
On the way home, the two casually chatted, with one speaking intermittently.
Most of the conversation was Shen Qinghan talking, with Lin Zichen responding.
They could have continued chatting like this.
That is until they passed by a park, where a sudden commotion interrupted them.
"Put the knife down!"
"To hell with that! To hell with all of you! You deluded fools, if humanity is doomed in the future, all you stubborn people will be the traitors!"
"I repeat, put the knife down now!"
"Being human won't save Earthlings! Being human won't save Earth, do you understand!!!"
The shouting that came through was hysterical.
Frowning at the noise, Lin Zichen wondered if there was a Heretical Sect traitor causing trouble inside the park?
Curiosity piqued, he immediately sped up to get a closer look.
As they passed the source of the noise, he glanced over from a distance.
And the next second, he saw an unexpected acquaintance.
It was Teacher Strawberry, the intelligence development teacher from Rainbow Kindergarten back in the day.
Right now, Teacher Strawberry was being held at knife-point by a deranged man, her neck already seeping blood, the situation extremely urgent.
Yet the few public security officers at the scene were still verbally trying to persuade or warn the man, with no real action being taken.
Seeing Teacher Strawberry's face grow paler and the blood on her neck seep more profusely, Lin Zichen knew he needed to do something within his power. He immediately stopped the bike, got off, picked up a stone from the ground.
His eyes narrowed, he aimed at the knife-wielding hand of the assailant and fiercely threw the stone!

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - 23: 23. Rat People
chapters.content:
"Ah Bing, aren't you ready yet? That Heretic Believer is getting more and more agitated, and the hostage's neck is starting to bleed. The situation is quite critical."
"Captain, that person is very professional, hiding his body well. I can't aim, so I don't have any chance for a sniper shot."
"Chen Yan, have you identified the Heretic Believer's identity yet? Contact his family as soon as possible and have them come to the scene to persuade him."
"Captain, the other side is an orphan."
"..."
Listening to the reports from the two team members, the captain of the tactical unit looked deeply worried.
He really wanted to rush in and rescue the woman being held, but he couldn't see any opportunity to intervene.
The Heretic Believer was crouched in a corner, using the hostage to shield his body, only exposing the knife at the hostage's throat, without showing any vulnerabilities.
"Captain, why don't we try using the sleep gas?"
A team member suggested quietly.
The captain of the tactical unit shook his head: "It's useless. The sleep gas is too obvious, and it could enrage the criminal before it takes effect, leading them to extreme actions."
Just when everyone felt helpless,
Suddenly!
A sharp whooshing sound erupted!
"Buzz!"
The next instant, a stone the size of an egg, moving at a speed invisible to the naked eye, flew from in front of the captain of the tactical unit and struck the Heretic Believer's hand precisely.
"Ah——!"
The Heretic Believer screamed in pain.
The stone had hit his knife-holding hand.
Moreover, the angle it struck at was extremely tricky, and the strong impact force caused his knife-wielding hand to turn outwards, moving the knife away from the hostage's neck and quickly slipping from his grasp to the ground.
At the same time, Teacher Strawberry, the hostage, finally managed to escape, her strong desire to survive making her desperately run toward the tactical officers.
The officers reacted quickly, one stepped forward to meet Teacher Strawberry, while the others rushed forward to subdue the Heretic Believer.
From start to finish, the officers had no idea what had just happened; they only knew that the Heretic Believer suddenly clutched his hand and screamed, and then the hostage had escaped from danger on her own.
Only Shen Qinghan, who had witnessed everything, was so shocked that she opened her mouth wide in astonishment.
"Xiao Chen, you..."
"Let's go, we'll talk later."
Lin Zichen had no intention of staying longer. Seeing that Teacher Strawberry was safe, he sat back on his bicycle to take Shen Qinghan away.
However, before he could ride off, the captain of the tactical unit ran over and blocked his path, panting as he said:
"Student, wait a moment, don't rush off. Was it you who threw the stone just now?"
As he spoke, the captain of the tactical unit placed a stone he was holding in front of Lin Zichen.
The Heretic Believer's hand was injured, and there was a blood-stained stone not far from his feet. Combining that with the direction from which the stone had been thrown, the captain of the tactical unit guessed that it was Lin Zichen who had thrown it.
Although the incident was hard to believe, there indeed was no more reasonable explanation at the moment.
"It wasn't me who threw it."
Lin Zichen, wanting to avoid further complications, dropped this remark indifferently.
Then, swerving his handlebars, he rode past the captain of the tactical unit and left.
The captain of the tactical unit was stunned for a moment. As he collected himself, he watched Lin Zichen's retreating figure and shouted:
"Student!"
"Student, stop a moment!"
"Student, what you did was good; why won't you admit it?!"
No matter how loudly the captain of the tactical unit called, Lin Zichen showed no sign of stopping; his figure quickly disappeared around a corner.
"This is so strange. Why would someone not admit to doing a good deed?"
The captain of the tactical unit was completely baffled.
Nevertheless, he didn't think too much about it. He planned to return tomorrow to review the security footage and confirm whether it was indeed Lin Zichen who had intervened and how.
Just then, Lin Zichen returned with Shen Qinghan and asked, "I just remembered something, is there a reward for acts of bravery?"
"Uh, yes, there is."
"That's right, I was the one who threw it, and my fingerprints are on the stone. You can take me back to compare them."
Security Chief: "..."
This change of attitude was so abrupt that it left the Security Chief at a loss for words.
Lin Zichen didn't want to act like this, but in order to start the Ghost Squid Album sooner, he had to think of every possible way to save money, bowing down for the proverbial five bushels of rice.
Security Chief: "Well then, later you come to the security station to simply make a written record and compare fingerprints. Once everything checks out, I'll apply for your bravery reward."
"Sure, no problem."
Lin Zichen readily agreed.
Hearing this, Shen Qinghan in the backseat immediately took out her phone and called home, saying she would be back later.
Meanwhile, the Security Chief returned to the park to handle the aftermath, and to bring the subdued Heretic Believer back to the station.
"By the way, Xiao Chen, I'm not sure how Teacher Strawberry is doing now; let's go check on her."
As soon as Shen Qinghan finished her call, she suggested to Lin Zichen in front of her.
Lin Zichen: "Okay."
Having reached an agreement, they parked their bicycle to the side and walked together toward the security vehicle in the park.
Teacher Strawberry had been rescued and was immediately brought into the security vehicle to treat her neck wound; she was probably resting inside the vehicle now.
Just as they were nearing the security vehicle.
Not far to the side, the handcuffed Heretic Believer suddenly started to utter a painful "heh-heh" sound.
Suddenly, his face began to crack, revealing shocking bloodstains.
The bloodstains split longer and wider until they formed eyes, evenly distributed on both sides of his face.
Including the original eyes, there were exactly eight.
The officer in charge of escorting the Heretic Believer spotted the problem, immediately drew his gun and loaded it, while shouting nervously to the Security Chief:
"Chief, there's been a mutation, the Heretic Believer is showing signs of turning into a Giant Mutant Rat!"
As soon as the words were out, the symptom-exhibiting Heretic Believer suddenly gained immense strength, broke the handcuffs with a snap, and turned around to lunge at the officer, biting ferociously.
Luckily, the officer was on guard and reacted swiftly, managing to dodge by side-stepping.
Giant Mutant Rat?!
Lin Zichen first heard these words, and then saw the eight eyes on the Heretic Believer's face. Without a second thought, he grabbed Shen Qinghan beside him and turned to sprint out of the park.
He didn't know exactly what was happening, but making distance from the scene was definitely the right move.
Shen Qinghan was still a bit dazed, but having often been carried by Lin Zichen like this as a child, she just obediently wrapped her arms around his neck, pressing her face against him to make it easier for him to carry her.
"Shoot, shoot now!"
Lin Zichen had barely started running when the Security Chief, already anxious, shouted loudly to several officers.
Suddenly, a deafening series of gunshots erupted, exceptionally jarring through the quiet of the night.
"Bang!"
"Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!"
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
"..."
By this time, Lin Zichen had already carried Shen Qinghan out of the park and they both hopped onto their bicycle, pedaling hard to get far from the dangerous area behind them.
However, whether it was because he pedaled too hard or for some other reason, just less than 20 meters out, the chain of the bicycle suddenly snapped with a "crack".
It wasn't just a slipped chain but a complete break, beyond repair.
"Damn!" Lin Zichen rarely cursed.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - 24: 24, Female Mechanically Modified Human
chapters.content:
In the park.
Several public security officers quickly drew their guns and unleashed a volley of gunfire at the Heretic Believer, each shot aimed at the heart and head.
Within moments, the Heretic Believer, in the midst of transforming into a Giant Mutant Rat, was riddled with bullets.
However, the bullet-riddled body of the Heretic Believer collapsed and didn't rise, yet the body kept mutating.
After several more sniper shots, which obliterated the head, the mutation still persisted.
"Jiangbei West Road, Citizen's Park, there's a Heretic Believer transforming into a Giant Mutant Rat, regular firearms are ineffective at inflicting fatal damage!"
"Preliminary judgment indicates integration with Rat King genes!"
"We are powerless to respond, requesting the deployment of Mechanically Modified Humans for support!"
Seeing that they were unable to deal with the situation, the captain of the public security team immediately contacted the city's public security headquarters to request support from Mechanically Modified Humans.
"Captain, he's getting up!" yelled a public security officer.
The Heretic Believer who had just been lying motionless on the ground was now somehow standing up.
More and more features of the Giant Mutant Rat appeared on the body: long, thin whiskers, a pointed snout, and a face covered with rat fur, turning into a walking rat-person.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
"Hold him off!"
"Open fire and hold the beast off!"
"Just need to stall for 2 minutes, and Mechanically Modified Human support will arrive!"
"Stop it, don't let it leave the park!"
"Bang! Bang! Bang…"
Under the command of the public security team captain, several public security officers retreated while firing, suppressing with gunfire to prevent the rat-person from leaving the park.
…
Outside the park.
Having heard what the captain of the public security team in the park said, Lin Zichen immediately abandoned the car and, grabbing Shen Qinghan from the back seat, started sprinting at full speed.
The situation had escalated far beyond his expectations, and he urgently needed to escape the area.
[You are sprinting at full speed with a load, Qi-Blood +4, Speed Endurance +2, Body Coordination +2, Running Speed +2, Running Technique +2]
[You have sprinted 1000 meters at full speed with a load, Qi-Blood +400, Speed Endurance +200, Body Coordination +200, Running Speed +200, Running Technique +200]
In just over a minute.
Lin Zichen had carried Shen Qinghan over a thousand meters away, thoroughly distancing himself from the dangerous park.
Although it was only 1000 meters, the intensity was extremely high, and he was left gasping for air with his hands propped on his knees.
Seeing this, Shen Qinghan immediately ran into the nearby convenience store, bought a sports drink, and came back with it unscrewed for him to take a sip and catch his breath.
Lin Zichen took the drink from her hand but didn't drink it right away, still panting heavily.
His breath was still ragged, and he couldn't drink anything down yet.
"Ah, shoot, Xiao Chen, I forgot to take the Phantom Squid Meat from the basket!"
Shen Qinghan suddenly remembered this and immediately showed a look of urgency on her face.
Upon hearing this, Lin Zichen felt a pang of loss.
His first reaction was to go back and get it, but his rationality quickly stopped him from making that foolish move.
The park was still dangerous at the moment, and it would be risky to go back so recklessly.
He would have to wait and see.
Only if his own safety was assured would he decide whether to go back for the Phantom Squid Meat.
Just then, a thunderous roar suddenly came from the sky.
It sounded like a high-displacement motorcycle racing past at full throttle, shaking one's eardrums and causing discomfort.
Lin Zichen looked up toward the noise.
It was the Mechanically Modified Humans!
But it was just a fleeting glimpse; they flew hundreds of meters past in an instant, their appearances impossible to catch.
Yet it wasn't hard to guess that it was the reinforcements the public security team captain had just requested.
With the Mechanically Modified Humans taking charge, safety should be secured.
With that thought, Lin Zichen decided to go back and retrieve the Phantom Squid Meat.
He then turned to Shen Qinghan beside him and said,
"Wait here for me. I'm going back to the park to get the Phantom Squid Meat. I'll be back soon."
"I'm coming too!"
"I'll be faster on my own."
"Alright, then. Be careful on your way, and come back quickly."
"Mhm."
Without saying much else, Lin Zichen quickly turned and ran towards the park.
Since he wasn't carrying Shen Qinghan this time, he arrived back at the park's outskirts in less than a minute.
At that moment, the park was filled with a vast amount of purple-blue smoke, and one could hear the sounds of intense fighting coming from inside.
Lin Zichen ignored all this, hurried to his bicycle, stopped in front of it, and took out the Phantom Squid Meat from the basket.
As soon as he got hold of it, he detected a faint stench of rot.
He sniffed, and the smell seemed to be emanating from the bag holding the Phantom Squid Meat.
A bad premonition immediately struck Lin Zichen.
With a sense of trepidation, he opened the bag to inspect the Phantom Squid Meat inside.
To his dismay, he found that the meat had spoiled and was showing obvious signs of decay.
It was over!
The meat, after the Life Origin had been consumed, did not cease to spoil or rot—there was just a delay!
What was he to do now?
How would he explain this to his parents when he got back?
Lin Zichen was very troubled.
Meanwhile, even heavier sounds of fighting erupted from the park.
Alongside it rose a shrill scream, resembling that of a rat, yet also human.
The next moment, from within the dense purple-blue smoke, a slender figure shot up into the sky, suspended high above the ground by a powerful reverse airflow propulsion device.
Lin Zichen looked up to see a female Mechanically Modified Human hovering in the sky.
Her chest was flat, made of pure alloy, with a circular glowing area in the middle that looked like an energy pump.
In terms of the alloy alone, she seemed stronger than the male Mechanically Modified Human he had encountered in an alleyway during elementary school.
Suddenly, an extremely dazzling light burst from the energy pump on the female Mechanically Modified Human's chest.
The next moment!
A terrifying beam of energy shot out from the energy pump, violently blasting toward the ground below!
Immediately afterward, a "boom" resounded!
The park, formerly shrouded in darkness, became illuminated for the most part in an instant.
After a brief moment, the light dissipated.
The park, which had been abuzz with noise, was now completely silent.
All that was left was a faint smell of charring.
Lin Zichen stood rooted to the spot, stunned by the scene before him.
This female Mechanically Modified Human, she could actually fire a laser cannon?
In a small prefecture-level city like Shanhai City, was there truly such an advanced Mechanically Modified Human?
The power of that laser cannon blast seemed terrifying.
It was hard to imagine how far biological flesh and blood had to evolve to be able to withstand the damage from that laser blast... Lin Zichen fell into contemplation.
Elsewhere, the chest of the female Mechanically Modified Human high above was smoking, the area around it blackened.
It was clear just how scorching the energy beam that had been emitted from that spot had been.
After confirming that the Rat creature below had perished, the female Mechanically Modified Human did not linger any longer and flew away.
Lin Zichen watched her departure, his mind filled with a myriad of thoughts.
He possessed a physical condition far superior to his peers only because he trained his body diligently every day.
Yet Mechanically Modified Humans didn't have to do a thing; with powerful alloy equipment installed, they could have incredible destructive power.
This rapid acquisition of power was indeed enviable.
As Lin Zichen pondered these things, the captain of the security team and others emerged not far away, jogging towards the park to clear the area.
Seeing this, Lin Zichen hesitated for a moment before following them inside.
He wanted to see just how much damage that laser cannon blast from the female Mechanically Modified Human had caused.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 25 - 25: Giant Rat Manual
chapters.content:
On the way into the park.
Lin Zichen felt that the rotten meat he was carrying was becoming a nuisance, so he opened the bag and threw the meat into a bush by the roadside.
This rotten Phantom Squid Meat was emitting an increasingly heavy and pungent smell. Just smelling it was enough to make one feel nauseous, and there was no need to keep it any longer.
It could only be used as waste, given back to nature that nurtured everything, to feed the scavengers of the natural world.
As for how to explain it to his parents when he got home, he would just say that he encountered some Heretic Believers causing trouble and accidentally lost the meat in the chaos.
Moreover, to avoid unnecessary trouble in the future, he would need to find someone to help purchase Exotic Beast Meat...
While thinking, Lin Zichen had already followed the security team into the park.
At a glance, there was still a purplish-blue smoke lingering in the air, but it had mostly dissipated, barely revealing large patches of scorched earth still smoking.
Moving a bit closer, he could see a pit with a radius of about one meter at the center.
Moving even closer to inspect the pit, what caught his eye was a completely charred corpse.
It was that Heretic Believer who had transformed from the Giant Mutant Rat.
Lin Zichen was somewhat surprised.
Such a powerful laser cannon had not completely obliterated this rat person, but only turned him into a charred body?
It seemed, Genetic Fusion was still powerful.
"Unauthorized personnel do not come near; please leave this area quickly, young man!"
At the edge of the pit, a security officer saw Lin Zichen standing nearby and immediately urged him away.
No sooner had he spoken than the security team's captain said, "Let him stay. We'll need to take him back to the station to give a statement anyway."
"A statement?"
The security officer was a bit confused, not understanding why Lin Zichen needed to go back to the station to make a statement.
He was unaware that the hostages had escaped from the Heretic Believers thanks to Lin Zichen's covert actions.
Just then, Lin Zichen's phone rang; it was a call from Shen Qinghan.
As soon as the call was answered, Shen Qinghan's voice full of concern came through.
"Xiao Chen, it's been over ten minutes, is there something wrong on your way back?"
"No worries, the rat person has been taken care of by the Mechanically Modified Human. I stayed to check out the scene; just sit at the convenience store, I'll be back soon."
"Should I come look for you?"
"No, it doesn't feel safe. I'm coming to pick you up now, wait for me, I'll be there soon."
Lin Zichen quickly hung up the phone and ran to meet Shen Qinghan.
In a short while, he had brought Shen Qinghan to the park.
Shen Qinghan looked at the scorched ground before her, her face full of astonishment.
She could hardly imagine what had just happened here to cause such a transformation.
By then, the security team had already removed the body from the pit, placing it on a stretcher and loading it into the trunk of the security vehicle.
Luckily, the trunk of the security vehicle was often used for various large tools and was designed large enough, or else it would not have been possible to fit the stretcher.
Lin Zichen looked at the fully charred body, recalling that when the captain had previously requested backup, he seemed to mention something about the Rat King gene.
It was said that this charred Heretic Believer likely had the Rat King gene fused within him.
And the Rat King gene was definitely a type of Exotic Beast Gene.
So... could I absorb the Rat King gene from the body?
Suddenly, Lin Zichen thought of this possibility.
He thought it might be feasible and decided to find an opportunity to touch the body when he got off at the station to test his theory.
Soon, everything at the scene was handled.
The captain of the security team looked at Lin Zichen and asked, "We are heading back to the security station now. Do you two know where it is, can you come there on your own bikes?"
"Our bike chain broke, so we can't ride."
"In that case, ride the security vehicle back with us."
"Can you also take our bikes with us?"
"Sure, bring it over here."
"Thank you."
After a brief exchange, Lin Zichen went outside to push the broken bike over.
Since there was no space left in the trunk, a tall security officer helped tie the bike to the roof using ropes.
Afterward, everyone boarded the vehicle and headed to the security station.
In the vehicle, Lin Zichen did not see Teacher Strawberry; he assumed she had already been taken to the hospital by the security personnel to treat her injuries.
En route, because both Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan were minors, the captain had them notify their parents to come to the security station.
Both of them called their parents to inform them.
…
About ten minutes passed.
The car finally arrived at the security station.
After getting out, Lin Zichen took the initiative to go to the back of the car to help lift out the body of the Heretic Believer.
Taking advantage of the moment the security officers were not paying attention, he suppressed his nausea and reached out to touch the body, wondering if he could devour the Rat King Gene inside.
To his surprise, he found that he indeed could devour it!
Genes are a sort of Life Origin, or rather, they represent one form of Life Origin!
Without a second thought, he decisively chose to devour it.
[You have devoured a trace of the "Giant Mutant Rat's" Life Origin]
[Giant Mutant Rat Manual: 5%]
5%? That much?
Looking at the progress bar behind the manual, Lin Zichen felt somewhat surprised.
However, more than the progress bar, he was concerned about what abilities he could gain after unlocking the Giant Mutant Rat's manual.
After careful thought, besides having eight eyes and being rather tough-skinned and fleshed, the Giant Mutant Rat didn't seem to have any other remarkable abilities.
Of course, it might also be due to humans' insufficient knowledge about the Giant Mutant Rat.
After all, the Giant Mutant Rat had only recently appeared in human society and still carried a lot of unknowns.
"Forget it, there's no use thinking about it. Once the manual's progress bar is full, I'll know everything there is to know."
Thinking this, Lin Zichen specifically glanced at the body on the stretcher.
Seeing no apparent changes, it seemed that losing the Rat King Gene hadn't caused any impact.
Of course, it might also be like the previous Phantom Squid Meat, having some delay.
...
In the time that followed,
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan sat together for the report.
The security team captain was very interested in Lin Zichen's heroic act, wanting to know how he managed to injure the Heretic Believer with a stone.
After all, the distance was quite long, and the visibility at night wasn't very good.
Under such conditions, to precisely hit the Heretic Believer's knife-wielding hand with a stone was not something a middle schooler should be able to do.
Not wanting to reveal too much of his abilities, Lin Zichen recited his well-prepared explanation, claiming he had used a slingshot.
"Where is that slingshot?"
The security team captain did not believe him and asked Lin Zichen this question.
Lin Zichen, without even so much as blinking and maintaining a calm face, replied, "I accidentally lost it while escaping the scene."
"Are you sure?"
"I'm very sure,"
Lin Zichen responded without hesitation.
The security team captain nodded, not asking further.
Soon, the report was completed.
At that time, the parents of Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan had also arrived at the security station.
The faces of both sets of parents were filled with anxiety; they had not expected that their children, just by going out in the evening, would encounter trouble with the Heretic Believers.
Fortunately, the outcome was fortunate, and neither child suffered any harm.
Otherwise, the parents would not have been able to bear it.
Lin Zichen spoke briefly with his parents, then looked at the security team captain and asked:
"Hello, I wanted to ask when I can apply for the reward for my act of bravery?"
"Do a fingerprint comparison now, and once the results are confirmed as accurate, I can apply for your reward in the system,"
the security team captain answered.
After understanding the process, Lin Zichen followed a young security officer to do the fingerprint comparison.
Seeing this scene, both sets of parents were somewhat dumbfounded.
Reward for bravery?
What is that?
Both sets of parents only knew that their children had encountered trouble with the Heretic Believers and were unaware that Lin Zichen had acted bravely to save someone.
Not until they asked the security team captain and reviewed the report did they understand the full story.
"Your son is truly remarkable, having the courage and composure to face a crisis at such a young age, a real little hero,"
a passing female security officer commented.
Zhang Wanxin merely smiled politely in response, feeling no joy in her heart.
She didn't want Lin Zichen to be a hero; she just wanted him to grow up safely.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - 26: 26. Bizarre Giant Rat
chapters.content:
```
After completing the fingerprint comparison and applying for the reward.
The parents of both families noticed it was getting late, so they didn't linger at the police station and wanted to take the two kids home.
While passing by the office door, Lin Zichen, with his exceptional hearing, keenly picked up some of the conversations inside.
They were talking about the Heretic Believers and the giant mutant rats.
"The Rat God Cult has become increasingly active lately, seducing those who are dissatisfied with society and filled with resentment to join them."
"I've heard that members of the Rat God Cult have even infiltrated certain universities to lure those cultural students who can't undergo Genetic Fusion through official channels."
"The Heretic Believer shot dead tonight was once a cultural student at Guangyan University. Because his body did not meet the standards for Genetic Fusion but he longed to become a Genetic Integrator, he was then beguiled by the members of the Rat God Cult."
"What a bunch of rat droppings, those culprits will all be rounded up sooner or later!"
"Rounding up the culprits is useless, it treats the symptoms not the root cause. We need to take down that self-proclaimed Rat King."
"..."
The Rat God Cult?
Lin Zichen was hearing this term for the first time and immediately took out his phone to look it up.
He then learned that it was a heretical sect that worshipped a giant mutant rat as a god.
Their headquarters were in Shanhai City, and most of its members were social outcasts. Their activities had been ramping up over the past few years.
It was suspected that the Rat King wished to evolve into an Advanced-level Creature and needed its followers to collect a vast amount of evolutionary resources for it.
All this was officially disclosed information.
"Worship a rat as a god?"
Lin Zichen shook his head, didn't search any further, and tucked his phone back into his pocket.
He walked out of the police station and went to where their car was parked.
Shen Qinghan, as usual, got into Lin Yansheng's car, wanting to sit in the back seat with Lin Zichen.
Shen Jianye watched this scene unfold and couldn't help but smile bitterly, "Sigh, our daughter seems almost like she belongs to the Lin family."
Xu Meng said with a calm expression, "It's actually a blessing for Han Han to be close with the Lin family. Why are you sighing over it?"
"That's true." Shen Jianye smiled and quickly got into the car with Xu Meng.
In the other car, Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan were chatting off and on.
Most of the conversation consisted of Shen Qinghan talking while Lin Zichen responded.
"Zi Chen, I wonder how Strawberry Teacher is doing now. When I saw her, her neck was bleeding. She should be okay, right?"
"It didn't look too serious. A simple bandage should be enough, she'll be fine."
"Zi Chen, the face of the Heretic Believer that mutated earlier suddenly grew eight eyes. It was really scary."
"Mutation is like that."
Lin Zichen replied casually.
While chatting, Shen Qinghan, who had been talking nonstop, suddenly fell silent. She didn't fiddle with her phone either, just sat there tightly pressing her straight legs together, seamless, with an off-looking expression on her face.
Lin Zichen noticed her odd behavior and subconsciously glanced at her lower half, realizing it was bulging like when she was little.
But he knew it was probably not a diaper anymore, but another type of water-absorbing pad.
Having realized this, he silently turned his head to one side, looking out the car window to avoid making Shen Qinghan uncomfortable.
Shen Qinghan realized that Lin Zichen had noticed and kept her head down with her lips tightly pursed, not saying a word.
Just like that, the car's atmosphere suddenly grew quiet.
Hm?
Suddenly, Lin Zichen's eyes widened.
He saw a fat rat, as big as a cat, zip past from the side of the road and quickly climb into the second floor of the police station through the drain.
How could there be such a huge rat?
Could it be a giant mutant rat?
Lin Zichen's nerves instantly tensed up.
```
But soon, he relaxed, feeling that he was just overthinking it.
This was the south, not the north, where it's quite normal for rats to grow as big as cats; there was nothing strange about it.
"It seems I've been too tense lately; I really need to relax when I get home..."
Lin Zichen thought to himself.
...
After the car arrived home.
Shen Qinghan dropped a "see you tomorrow" and awkwardly got out of the car and left.
Zhang Wanxin was somewhat puzzled, "What's with Han Han today? She usually loves to stick around and chat with you for a while longer, doesn't she? Why was she so quiet in the car just now, and the moment we stopped, she got out and left?"
"She looked really tired just now, probably sleepy and not in the mood to talk," Lin Zichen explained.
Zhang Wanxin nodded and didn't dwell on it.
Soon, the family of three got out of the car and entered the house.
As soon as they entered, Zhang Wanxin solemnly advised Lin Zichen, "Xiao Chen, if you ever encounter something like tonight again, your mom wants you to prioritize your safety. You must know your limits and not act recklessly."
"Mom, I understand, I will," Lin Zichen obediently nodded.
Zhang Wanxin's worry eased slightly when she saw him willing to listen.
Afterward, something occurred to her, and she asked,
"Right, didn't you buy three pounds of Phantom Squid Meat? Where is the meat? I didn't see it in the bike's basket, and you are not carrying it either."
"Mom, don't be mad when I tell you this; when we ran into the Heretic Believer's mutation earlier, Han Han and I rushed out so quickly that I accidentally lost the meat..." Lin Zichen hesitated before speaking.
Upon hearing this, Zhang Wanxin's eyes widened.
She felt terrible about the loss but restrained herself from showing it in front of Lin Zichen; instead, she consoled him,
"It's okay, if it's lost then it's lost. After all, we encountered a Heretic Believer causing trouble. It's a lucky misfortune that no one was hurt—and not to mention you bravely saved someone else. You are mom's pride."
"While it hasn't been lost for long, why don't I drive there and look along the way?" Lin Yansheng suggested.
Zhang Wanxin immediately objected: "No, it's too dangerous there, especially after the Heretic Believer incident just happened."
"That's true," Lin Yansheng nodded.
Lin Zichen didn't speak, silently thinking to himself that he would have to enter more competitions in the future. Once he had saved enough prize money, he would buy three pounds of Phantom Squid Meat to honor his parents.
...
At the Public Security Office, in the captain's office.
The security team captain, looking at the statement in his hand, couldn't help but laugh.
Shot with a slingshot?
Who uses a slingshot with stones as big as chicken eggs? And can they even shoot them out?
It's undoubtedly thrown by hand!
Does he not realize what I do for a living, thinking he can fool me, a student?
The security team captain lit a cigarette, took a deep drag and exhaled, his thoughts lingering amidst the spreading smoke.
That said, how on earth did a middle school student manage to throw stones with such force?
No, I must check the surveillance footage tomorrow morning to see what happened.
Thinking this, he put the statement back into its dedicated filing box, locked it, and prepared to leave work for home.
Just then, he noticed a large mouse on the windowsill, as big as a cat.
He was a bit surprised, "Where did this mouse come from, and why is it so big?"
The mouse outside the window didn't run away at the sound of his voice and just sat quietly on the windowsill, its eyes staring deeply at the security team captain.
..…

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - 27: 27. Join the Martial Arts Team
chapters.content:
Shanhai High School.
In a seventh-grade classroom.
Lin Zichen was attending class but he wasn't paying attention or looking at his book; his mind was full of thoughts about what happened yesterday.
Thinking about the Rat God Cult, he felt it was a security risk and that he'd need to be more careful in the future.
Thinking about the laser cannon of the mechanically modified woman, he realized he was still very weak. However, luckily he was young and had attributes like Use It or Lose It, Divine Human Wisdom Root, and Survival of the Fittest boosting him, so his growth potential was greater than anyone else's.
Thinking about the Phantom Squid atlas, he considered how to earn money to fill up the progress bar and then unlock some of the Phantom Squid's abilities by opening the atlas.
The school's scholarship?
The prize money from various student competitions?
What else?
Are there other sources of income?
Phantom Squid meat is too expensive; earning just this little each year, how many years would it take to fill up the progress bar?
He had to find ways to increase his income.
Become a star student influencer?
No, that was too conspicuous.
Start a technical side hustle?
That didn't seem right either; he was already busy enough, having to study and train; there simply wasn't any spare time.
Was there anything that could make money without interfering with his studies and training?
Forget it, three cobblers add up to one Zhuge Liang; he'd ask the well-informed netizens for advice.
Thinking this, Lin Zichen took out his phone and posted on a forum.
[Seeking advice: How can a middle school student quickly make a hundred thousand without affecting their studies?]
Perhaps because the title was so eye-catching, it soon attracted many netizens to enthusiastically comment.
First comment: You can have everything in your dreams.
Second comment: I suggest studying criminal law.
Third comment: You could join the school's Martial Arts Team to compete. I have a friend who earned nearly 300,000 in prizes over six years of middle and high school; I'm so jealous.
300,000 in prize money?
That much?
Lin Zichen was a bit surprised; he immediately exited the forum and opened a web browser, searching for information about martial arts competitions.
He searched for local competitions in Shanhai City.
After briefly browsing the results, he learned that during each school break, the city hosted various martial arts exchange competitions.
These were mainly for middle and high school students.
He searched for specific competition details and found that the forum user hadn't exaggerated; the prize money was indeed quite generous.
There was a city-wide middle school league competition where the first-place school could win as much as 50,000 Yuan.
The money was divided here and there, but the core players could still pocket several thousand Yuan at least.
For middle schoolers, this was already a substantial amount.
The key was that the duration of these competitions was short, lasting only three days to a week at most.
Earning a few thousand in just a few days was almost like stuffing money into a sack.
Most importantly, practicing martial arts could strengthen his body, so he could earn money and evolve simultaneously.
"The school does have a Martial Arts Team; I should check it out after school." Lin Zichen thought to himself.
...
It wasn't long after.
As the bell signaling the end of class rang, the morning classes finally came to an end.
The students in the classroom quickly left for the cafeteria to have lunch as soon as class ended.
Some who lived nearby went home to eat.
Others who had signed up for day-care classes nearby went there to eat.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan were somewhat special; both brought lunch from home and just needed to heat it in the microwave in the teacher's office.
This was one of the privileges Lin Zichen had earned for the school through numerous honors.
As his closest childhood friend, Shen Qinghan was fortunate enough to share this privilege.
"Zi Chen, try this, it's super tasty."
Shen Qinghan put a slice of egg roll into Lin Zichen's lunchbox. Her expression was quite natural, clearly not dwelling on the embarrassing incident that had happened in the car yesterday.
Lin Zichen tasted the egg roll and nodded, "It really is tasty."
"Guess who made it?"
"Guess if I will guess?"
"Stop playing word games, just give it a guess!"
"You made it."
"You guessed right!" Shen Qinghan's smile bloomed like a flower.
Then, resting her chin in her hand, she looked at Lin Zichen with moist, gleaming eyes and asked:
"Zi Chen, I've started learning to cook with mom, how about I cook for you every day from now on?"
"Sure."
Lin Zichen smiled and replied.
...
Soon, the two of them finished their lunch.
When he went out to wash his lunchbox, Lin Zichen encountered the coach of the Martial Arts Team in the corridor outside the classroom.
"Zichen, what a coincidence!"
As soon as Guo Xiangyuan saw Lin Zichen, he immediately walked over with a smile to strike up a conversation.
He had purposely waited a long time in the corridor, finally catching Lin Zichen after he had finished eating.
The reason for meticulously pretending to bump into him was to avoid being too abrupt like yesterday, which might have given Lin Zichen a bad impression.
For a sports prodigy like Lin Zichen, he believed he had to take the initiative to recruit Lin Zichen into the Martial Arts Team as soon as possible, not wasting even a single day of training.
Wasting even one more day was a crime against heaven, deserving of thunderous retribution.
"Coach Guo, I was actually looking for you."
Originally, Lin Zichen had planned to visit the gym after school, but since he had run into Guo Xiangyuan now, he might as well get to know about the Martial Arts Team right away.
Upon hearing this, Guo Xiangyuan was initially astonished, then said with great excitement:
"Are you interested in learning about the Martial Arts Team?"
"Yes."
Lin Zichen nodded.
Guo Xiangyuan immediately approached with enthusiasm, smiling cheerfully:
"Feel free to ask any questions. I'll answer everything I know."
So, in the following time, Lin Zichen asked many questions.
About the city's martial arts competitions.
About how the competition prizes were.
About the strength of martial arts teams from various schools, and so on.
Guo Xiangyuan patiently answered all these questions.
Shen Qinghan, seeing that the two might talk for quite some time, silently took Lin Zichen's lunchbox to wash it together, not disturbing them.
...
About half an hour later.
The two in the corridor finally ended their chat.
Lin Zichen verbally agreed to join the Martial Arts Team and said he would visit Room C of the gym after school.
Then he turned around and went back inside the classroom.
It was currently the lunch break, and the classroom was almost empty.
At a glance, there were only about ten students who were not napping and were diligently studying.
Among them, the diligent and studious Shen Qinghan.
Lin Zichen walked to his spot, sat down, put on his headphones, and searched his phone for a bunch of martial arts competition videos to understand what the competition process was like.
Next to him, Shen Qinghan was bent over grading a test paper, occasionally frowning, occasionally relaxing her brows.
About half an hour passed.
Shen Qinghan finally finished the test paper.
She tidied up the paper with a great sense of achievement, turned around, and patted Lin Zichen on the shoulder, wanting to talk to him.
Lin Zichen took off his headphones and asked her:
"Did you finish the paper?"
"I did, yeah."
"Not bad, finished in under an hour this time. You've improved."
"Of course, I may not be as smart as you, Xiao Chen, but I'm still pretty clever."
Shen Qinghan was slightly smug.
Then, curiously, she asked Lin Zichen:
"By the way, Xiao Chen, are you joining the school's Martial Arts Team?"
"Yeah, I've already verbally joined."
"So, does that mean I'll get to see you compete in the future?"
"It seems so."
Hearing this, Shen Qinghan's eyes smiled, and she said cheerfully, "Then I'll be your little fangirl, cheering for you in the audience every day, okay?"
"Okay," Lin Zichen smiled and replied.
No sooner had he spoken than Shen Qinghan yawned hugely, looking sleepy.
Seeing this, Lin Zichen moved a chair from the podium next to the chair where Shen Qinghan was sitting, suggested to her:
"There's still a bit more than half an hour left for the lunch break; take a nap if you're sleepy."
"Mm, I'll take a nap then. Just remember to wake me up when it's time."
After saying this, Shen Qinghan curled up like a little cat, nestled on the two chairs put together, rested her head on Lin Zichen's leg, and quickly fell asleep.
Lin Zichen fetched a small blanket to cover her.
Then he put on his headphones again and continued to watch the martial arts competition videos on his phone.
Not sure if she was dreaming or what, but Shen Qinghan, who had just fallen asleep, moved her plump cherry lips slightly and whispered softly:
"Xiao Chen..."
"I made it into Shanhai High School by my own efforts..."
"We are still desk mates..."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 28 - 28: 28. Martial arts prodigy?
chapters.content:
Gymnasium, Room C.
Right after school in the afternoon, Lin Zichen took Shen Qinghan here.
When they first entered, Guo Xiangyuan was the only one inside, leisurely sipping tea and scrolling through short videos.
"Coach Guo."
Lin Zichen called out, his reference changing from the previous 'teacher' to the now 'coach'.
Guo Xiangyuan, hearing the voice, immediately looked up with a smile, "You're here early. None of those kids on the team arrive earlier than you. They need to improve their attitude."
"Come in, sit down and have some tea first. Once everyone arrives, I'll take you for a tour," Guo Xiangyuan said as he fetched two cups and poured tea for both of them.
...
As time passed, people began to trickle into the room from outside.
All of them were boys; not a single girl was present.
Upon entering, each of them curiously glanced at Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan sitting beside the tea table, with most of their gazes landing on Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen had a big reputation in Shanhai High School; there wasn't a student who didn't know him, most had heard of his various extraordinary tales as a study prodigy.
However, none had expected this academically exceptional prodigy to possess equally outstanding athletic talent.
"Is it you?"
Right then, a boy hurried into the room and upon seeing Lin Zichen sitting in front of the table, his reaction seemed a bit exaggerated.
It was none other than the boy who had been previously defeated by Lin Zichen at the school sports meet, forced to tearfully take silver instead of gold.
Lin Zichen, hearing him, turned towards the boy and politely smiled, saying, "Hello."
"My name is Zhang Kai, remember my name," the boy replied indifferently. After saying so, he walked off to one side with his backpack, paying no further attention to Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen just smiled and said nothing, thinking that this Zhang Kai was quite arrogant. He could only think that it was normal for middle school boys in the throes of adolescence to act this way and found it understandable.
Seeing all team members had arrived, Guo Xiangyuan stood up and, looking around with a smile, said:
"This handsome boy here is Lin Zichen. I believe everyone is familiar with him, so I won't waste time introducing him."
"From today onwards, Zi Chen will be part of our Martial Arts Team. Let's welcome him with a round of applause!"
"Clap clap clap..."
Guo Xiangyuan began clapping first as soon as he finished speaking.
Seeing this, the team members also followed suit and clapped along, very much in sync with their coach.
Except for one person, the boy named Zhang Kai.
After the applause subsided, Guo Xiangyuan addressed the team members again, "Right, everyone, introduce yourselves one by one so Zi Chen can get to know you."
"My name is Huang Tianxing, from class 9-3. You can just call me Ah Xing."
"I am Li Shutong, from class 9-6. You can call me Little Li, that's what everyone calls me, and I really like the nickname."
"My name is Han Yisuo; just call me Brother Suo..."
The team members seemed quite easygoing, introducing themselves one after another with smiles on their faces.
Lin Zichen responded with a smile too, cordially replying with a 'please guide me' after each introduction.
The Martial Arts Team didn't have many members. Aside from Lin Zichen and Guo Xiangyuan, there were only seven others, so the introductions were concluded quickly.
During this time, Shen Qinghan stood silently beside Lin Zichen, holding both of their lunch boxes, and remained quiet throughout.
She only became talkative and lively in front of Lin Zichen.
In the presence of strangers, especially unfamiliar boys, she seemed quite introverted, almost socially anxious.
"By the way, this classmate, what's your name?"
Guo Xiangyuan, always seeing Shen Qinghan accompanying Lin Zichen, knew they were inseparable and thought he should get to know her better.
"I, I'm Shen Qinghan; you can call me Xiao Shen or Qinghan," Shen Qinghan introduced herself somewhat nervously.
Guo Xiangyuan smiled and said, "Then I'll call you Xiao Shen from now on."
With that, he told the veteran team members to practice on their own. Then, he took Lin Zichen around the room for a quick tour to get familiar with the martial training equipment.
But it was all very ordinary equipment like punching bags, weighted sandbags, and wooden dummies, nothing special to look at.
"Zi Chen, there are five team members in ninth grade and two in eighth grade, and you're the only one in seventh. I have high hopes for you. Follow me closely, and within a year, I guarantee you'll become the ace of the team."
After making a round, Guo Xiangyuan suddenly told Lin Zichen this, sounding a bit like he was giving false promises, but in reality, he was not.
Lin Zichen: "Thank you, Coach, for valuing me."
Guo Xiangyuan: "By the way, Zi Chen, have you ever practiced martial arts before?"
Lin Zichen: "No."
Guo Xiangyuan nodded after listening and then said to Lin Zichen, "Well, today I'll teach you a set of the most basic boxing and kicking techniques, so you can get a feel for what martial arts training is like."
Lin Zichen responded, "Okay."
Soon after, Guo Xiangyuan walked to an open space ahead, stopped, and started demonstrating the basic boxing and kicking techniques at a leisurely pace for Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen watched very closely, etching every movement enacted by Guo Xiangyuan into his mind.
...
About ten minutes later.
The demonstration ended.
Guo Xiangyuan, like a martial arts grandmaster, slowly withdrew from his stance and then smiled at Lin Zichen, saying, "You might think these moves are simple, but they actually are quite difficult. Even little Li, who is the fastest in the team to master it, spent a week's time initially."
"However, no matter how much I say, it's hard to really understand without trying it out."
"Come on, give it a try."
Guo Xiangyuan said and stepped aside to let Lin Zichen have a go.
Lin Zichen walked over, stopped, and based on the memory of just observing from the sidelines, he quickly replicated the set of boxing and kicking techniques demonstrated by Guo Xiangyuan—and replicated them perfectly, one to one.
His talented nature allowed him to master all the movements after watching just once.
Use reinforced the learning, making each replication of the movements more explosive than the last.
As his movements got faster and faster, familiar textual information soon appeared in the void.
[You are practicing boxing, Qi-Blood +1, muscular strength in hands +1, agility in hands +1, boxing proficiency +1]
[You are practicing kicking, Qi-Blood +1, muscular strength in legs +1, agility in legs +1, kicking proficiency +1]
At the side, Guo Xiangyuan was completely stunned.
This is his first time practicing martial arts?
Really?
Are you sure he's not lying?
The other team members, who were practicing on their own and glancing over from time to time, all had incredulous expressions when they saw Lin Zichen instantly grasp the basic boxing and kicking techniques.
"Zi Chen, is this really your first time practicing martial arts?" Guo Xiangyuan asked somewhat skeptically after a moment of collecting himself.
Realizing that he might have been showing off too much supernatural prowess, Lin Zichen made up a quick excuse, "It's not really my first time. I took some interest classes in martial arts during elementary school, practicing boxing and kicking for a while."
"No wonder," Guo Xiangyuan said with relief, touching his forehead with a smile. "I wondered how you could perfect it on the first try, you gave me quite a scare."
Guo Xiangyuan laughed at himself for overthinking it.
How could someone, who had never practiced martial arts, just watch once and get it?
If humans had such strong learning abilities, would they be in the current predicament, constantly living under the threat from Exotic Beasts from outside the human realm?
By now there would likely be countless geniuses born, beating those Exotic Beasts from outside the human realm into submission.
...
Time flew by, and before he knew it, it was already 6:30 PM.
The Martial Arts Team generally practiced until 7:30 PM.
However, Lin Zichen didn't want to train that late and applied to go home an hour early.
Guo Xiangyuan didn't mind these things as he was quite laid-back in leading the team, with most of the time relying on the team members' self-discipline.
As for training until 7:30 PM, it only meant that he, as a coach, would stay in the gym until that time.
"Zi Chen, remember to bring a clean set of clothes to put in your backpack tomorrow. Otherwise, after practicing and sweating, you might catch a cold on your way home," Guo Xiangyuan reminded Lin Zichen as he was about to leave.
Lin Zichen nodded, saying, "I know, thanks for the reminder, Coach."
After saying that, he left the gym with Shen Qinghan.
...
When they arrived at the bicycle shed.
Seeing Lin Zichen still sweating, Shen Qinghan took out a tissue and said, "Xiao Chen, you're still wet from sweat, let me wipe it off for you."
Saying so, she carefully used the tissue to wipe the sweat off Lin Zichen's face and neck.
As for the sweat under his clothes, that was beyond her help.
Lin Zichen felt it was wiped enough, so he let her sit in the rear seat of the bicycle, and under the pleasant evening sun, he rode home leisurely with her on board.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 29 - 29: 29. Shudder without being cold
chapters.content:
```
"Xiao Chen, I heard from your mother that you joined the school's Martial Arts Team, how does it feel?"
Lin Zichen had just returned home when he was asked this by Lin Yansheng in the living room.
He had called Zhang Wanxin after school to say he had joined the school's Martial Arts Team and would be coming home late, so both of his parents were aware of this.
"It's quite good, I can sweat it out after school and work out a bit."
Lin Zichen replied while taking off his shoes.
Lin Yansheng asked another question, "Xiao Chen, whether it's academic talent or athletic talent, you excel in both. Have you decided which path to pursue in the future?"
"I think my athletic talent is more remarkable than my academic talent, and the path of martial arts seems more promising too. Once I reach high school, I'll join the Martial Arts Class and learn martial arts," Lin Zichen answered without hesitation.
There are no Martial Arts Classes in the educational stages of this world.
Because practicing martial arts too early can affect the body's development.
Only when students reach high school and their bodies are almost fully developed do schools start offering Martial Arts Classes.
Before that, students mainly focus on academic studies.
But courses related to Genetic Integrators, Mechanically Modified Humans, and Exotic Beasts are also offered to allow students to develop comprehensively.
"What a coincidence, your mother and I also want you to learn martial arts, it seems our family of three is in perfect agreement," Lin Yansheng said with a satisfied smile on his face.
In this world where humanity is constantly threatened by Exotic Beasts, all trades are inferior, only martial arts stand superior.
Because only by training in martial arts to a certain physical strength can one bear the backlash of Genetic Fusion and mechanical modification, becoming a superior Genetic Integrator or Mechanically Modified Human.
"By the way, where's mom?"
"Your mom and your Aunt Xu went out to buy groceries. They said it's Friday, so everyone will get together tonight."
"No wonder I didn't see her around the house."
Lin Zichen nodded and didn't chat further, quickly going upstairs to take a shower.
He had worked up a sweat during martial arts practice and now felt sticky and uncomfortable.
...
In the bathroom.
Lin Zichen finished his shower, dried off his body, and stood naked in front of the mirror, carefully examining himself.
Despite the intense workouts he did regularly, his muscles didn't look bulky at all. They weren't exaggerated like a bodybuilder's but were lean and toned.
He appeared slim when clothed but muscular once undressed.
"Not bad, a perfect physique."
Looking at his reflection, Lin Zichen felt very satisfied.
Then, on a whim, he started practicing punches and kicks in front of the mirror.
[You're practicing punching, Qi-Blood +1, strength of hand muscles +1, hand flexibility +1, proficiency of punching +1]
[You're practicing kicking, Qi-Blood +1, strength of leg muscles +1, leg flexibility +1, proficiency of kicking +1]
He hadn't been practicing for long when laughter and conversation drifted up from downstairs.
It was the voices of Zhang Wanxin and Xu Meng, who had returned from grocery shopping.
At the same time, he heard Shen Jianye and Shen Qinghan's voices.
The two families were getting together for dinner that evening, and all three members of the other family had arrived.
Seeing that everyone was there, Lin Zichen grabbed his clothes, got dressed, opened the door, and went downstairs.
When he reached downstairs,
He saw the two mothers cooking in the kitchen, the two fathers chatting leisurely at the tea table, and Shen Qinghan sitting on the sofa doing her papers, studying hard.
Hearing the sound of Lin Zichen coming downstairs, Shen Qinghan looked up at him and complained,
"Xiao Chen, you took such a long time to shower, I've been here for half an hour."
"It was alright."
Lin Zichen replied and sat down beside her, casually starting to check his phone.
He was looking at the current news, keeping an eye on the situation everywhere.
Not long after, Shen Qinghan leaned over with a mysteriously excited expression and said,
"Xiao Chen, guess what sort of groceries your mom and Aunt Xin bought. You'll never guess it."
"King crabs?"
"No."
"Lobster?"
"Wrong again."
"Then I have no idea."
"I knew you wouldn't be able to guess!" Shen Qinghan said with a victorious smile before revealing, "It's Phantom Squid Meat, three pounds of it!"
Phantom Squid Meat?
Lin Zichen thought he must have heard wrongly, visibly surprised.
From the front, Lin Yansheng said, "Your mom knew you and Qinghan wanted to have this, so she specially asked your Aunt Xu to buy it at the market."
```
Hearing this, Lin Zichen suddenly felt an indescribable sensation in his heart.
He looked toward Zhang Wanxin, who was busy in the kitchen, and quickly stood up, walking over to say, "Mom, let me help you."
Shen Qinghan also went into the kitchen to help upon seeing this.
...
It was now 8:30 p.m.
Dinner was finally ready.
Although the meal was served much later than usual, causing everyone to be ravenously hungry, the sight of the eight dishes and one soup on the table made them feel the wait was worthwhile.
"Xiao Chen, this Phantom Squid Meat is so fragrant, and the texture is chewy, really delicious!"
Shen Qinghan, her face beaming with happiness, took the initiative to pick up a piece of Phantom Squid Meat and place it in Lin Zichen's bowl.
Lin Zichen tasted a bite, and it was indeed delicious.
[You have absorbed a trace of the "Phantom Squid's" life essence]
[Phantom Squid Album: 3.01%]
Huh?
The progress bar for the album actually increased?
Lin Zichen was first startled, a bit surprised, but then he thought it made sense.
If touching it with his hands allowed him to absorb, then eating it would undoubtedly result in absorption as well.
While he was pondering these things, the television screen in front of them was broadcasting a piece of news.
"Genius girl shocks the nation!"
"At just fourteen years old, she successfully merged with the heart of energy, becoming the youngest Mechanically Modified Human in the country's history!"
"When the energy is activated, she can easily lift a 2000kg off-road vehicle with one hand, sprint a hundred meters in just 3 seconds, and perform a vertical jump from a standstill to a height of 8 meters!"
"The prodigy of Capital City from yesteryear and today's genius girl, which of the two peerless geniuses will become the king of this era?"
"Will Genetic Fusion be unrivaled, or will mechanical ascension prove undefeatable? Let's look forward to the ultimate showdown between these two geniuses in the future!"
Everyone at the dining table watched this news report.
Among them, Zhang Wanxin said somewhat incredulously, "Another genius girl has popped up? She's only fourteen, her body has not even fully developed, and she's already undergone mechanical modification. I really don't know what her parents were thinking."
Lin Yansheng sipped his soup and said, "They probably saw how successfully the prodigy from Capital City marketed himself, making a fortune, and they wanted to jump on the bandwagon to make a quick buck as well."
Listening to this, Lin Zichen also felt that this so-called peerless prodigy was all about marketing to make money.
Earning money, well, there's no shame in that, it's understandable.
Shen Qinghan, looking at the news on the television screen, thought that the term 'peerless twin heroes' sounded really nice, so she looked at Lin Zichen with full enthusiasm and said,
"Xiao Chen, I'm going to work hard to improve myself and strive to become peerless twin heroes with you one day!"
"Yeah, keep it up," Lin Zichen made an encouraging gesture to her.
Watching the interaction between the two children, Shen Jianye and Xu Meng across the table felt a hint of bitterness, growing increasingly worried about Shen Qinghan's future.
Strive to become peerless twin heroes?
But the reality was, the gap between the two children would only grow wider and wider.
Forget it, Han Han is still young.
Let her enjoy her happy days as long as they last, and cherish the friendship as long as it continues. Let her live in the present.
What's to come can be dealt with later...
Shen Jianye and Xu Meng had come to terms with it, feeling that letting nature take its course was the best approach. They were no longer plagued by needless worries.
After all, worrying would only bring bad moods and couldn't change a thing.
Soon.
The television screen switched to another news story.
"In XX District of Shanhai City, the captain of the local security force tragically perished last night at 11 p.m. in his office. Surveillance footage shows he died from a giant Exotic Rat that had infiltrated the premises."
"The captain, named He Chunshan, had held his position for three years, making outstanding contributions to the security of XX District during his tenure, with a record of arresting nineteen followers of the Rat God Cult, helping Mechanically Modified Humans kill three giant Exotic Rats..."
After reporting on the security force captain's contributions, the TV screen immediately played an interview clip.
The interviewees were security officers from the office, all looking furious and shouting that from now on they would fight the Rat God Cult to the death.
After watching this news report, everyone in the room widened their eyes in disbelief.
The security force captain was dead?
Last night at 11 p.m.... wasn't that shortly after they had left the security office?
Thinking of this, everyone felt a chill of fear.
Especially Lin Zichen, who remembered the rat he had seen the night before and shuddered.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 30 - 30: 30. Survival of the Fittest
chapters.content:
Late at night, Lin Zichen lay in bed without sleeping, his mind full of thoughts about the captain of the security team's death.
The report said he died in the jaws of a giant mutant rat.
Was the big rat he saw in the car the same one that killed the security team captain?
But that so-called big rat was only the size of a cat. How could it possibly be the three-meter-long giant mutant rat?
He couldn't figure it out for the life of him.
He looked out the window.
The night was deep.
All the streetlights were out, no one was visible.
"Speaking of which, it's been a long time since I last tested my biometric attributes. Since I can't sleep now, I might as well go outside and test them."
Thinking this, Lin Zichen put on his hat and mask, and left his home quietly.
He specifically chose paths without surveillance cameras and after some time, he arrived at an abandoned highway.
He warmed up simply and then quickly took out his phone to start the stopwatch for a hundred-meter sprint test.
Then, just in a brief moment, he sprinted the hundred-meter distance he had measured in advance.
The phone showed the timing: 4.61 seconds.
Last time it was six seconds, this time 4.61 seconds, an improvement of nearly 1.4 seconds, not bad.
After testing his speed, he started to test his jumping ability.
He found a few places with some height, measured them, and then tried to see if he could jump up with a vertical leap to roughly gauge his ability.
After about ten trials, he came up with a fairly accurate figure.
—5.51 meters.
Last time it was four meters, this time 5.51 meters, an improvement of nearly 1.5 meters.
After testing the speed and jumping, it was time to test the strength.
Lin Zichen avoided cameras all the way, eyeing the cars by the roadside.
He had memorized the models of all the cars in this world and their corresponding weights.
He wanted to pick a suitable car, to use it as a barbell, to see if he could easily lift it with one hand.
"You're it."
After looking at a dozen cars, Lin Zichen finally picked a car that weighed around 1500 kg.
He walked around the car, looking for the right leverage point to lift it, then tried to lift it with one hand.
Three minutes later.
He failed.
