The SUV was too heavy; he couldn't lift it at all and had to try a lighter one.
Soon enough, Lin Zichen picked a car around 1200 kg.
Halfway lifted, no good, couldn't hold it.
Finally, he settled on a 1000 kg small car for women, managing to lift it with some difficulty.
Last time it was 700 kg, this time 1000 kg, an improvement of 300 kg.
All three basic attributes had greatly improved.
One could only say that during the development phase, as the body grows rapidly, the basic attributes also increase quickly.
...
Time flew by quickly.
In the blink of an eye, it was Monday of the following week.
In the afternoon after school, Lin Zichen went to the gym to practice martial arts.
Saying he was practicing martial arts, in reality, involved training some basic hand and foot techniques, not like those powerful arts described in martial arts novels.
However, Lin Zichen didn't care about these things.
The reason he joined the Martial Arts Team was just to compete and win prize money, never to learn anything there.
"Zi Chen, your martial arts talent is too strong. No matter what techniques I teach, you're always the fastest to learn them. Your future is promising!"
Guo Xiangyuan said with a laugh.
He had just demonstrated a dodging technique to the eight team members, using a continuous movement of the head to avoid an opponent's punches.
As soon as he finished demonstrating, Lin Zichen immediately mastered it.
The other seven teammates, however, still looked very stiff and would need several days of shaking their heads before they could do it smoothly.
"It's all thanks to the coach's good teaching."
Having said that, Lin Zichen took the clean clothes Shen Qinghan passed to him and walked towards the changing room in the front.
It was just a quick rinse typical of the south, not the full back-scrubbing that goes on in the north.
So, in less than five minutes, Lin Zichen came out of the changing room.
"Xiao Chen, I've taken care of your dirty clothes for you," Shen Qinghan said with a sweet smile at the door of the changing room.
Lin Zichen noticed her fringe was a bit messy and carefully arranged it for her, saying softly,
"Let's go home."
```
"Hmm."
Shen Qinghan softly responded, silently walking beside Lin Zichen.
They arrived at the bike shed.
As Lin Zichen was just pushing his bicycle out, Shen Qinghan next to him took out her phone and showed him the photos she had just taken in the gym.
"Xiao Chen, look, you look so cool when you're throwing a punch."
"Your fringe swings with the momentum, flinging out droplets of sweat, it's just so cool.
"If your little fangirls saw this, they'd probably go crazy."
Shen Qinghan placed her phone in front of Lin Zichen, swiping through the photos for him to admire, one after another.
Lin Zichen laughed and said, "The main thing is your excellent timing in taking these shots."
...
Days went by, one after another.
Before he knew it, Lin Zichen had been a member of the Martial Arts Team for over a month.
At first, Shen Qinghan was the only girl who watched him practice martial arts in the gym, quietly waiting for him to finish so they could go home together.
Gradually, word got out that he had joined the Martial Arts Team and many little fangirls knew he would go to the gym after school to practice martial arts.
So today, not long after he began his practice in the gym, girls trickled in one by one to watch him sweat it out, and by half an hour later, there were already over thirty spectators.
"Wow, Zi Chen junior, that kick you just did was so cool. If you kicked me like that, it would definitely hurt so much I'd cry, right?"
A senior girl from ninth grade said, utterly smitten after watching Lin Zichen deliver a kick to the wooden post in front of him.
Lin Zichen felt somewhat speechless and immediately lost his motivation to practice.
He had brought up this issue with Guo Xiangyuan before.
Saying to not let girls come in anymore, as it interfered with everyone's training.
In the end, he was awkwardly met with unanimous opposition from the other seven members of the team.
The practice of martial arts used to be a couple of guys solemnly training in a huge space, which was incredibly boring and dull.
But now, with the sudden influx of female spectators, it made them feel like they had arrived in heaven, filling them with motivation to practice and unwilling to disturb this state.
It was the same for Guo Xiangyuan.
Seeing the increased seriousness in practice among the team members and more attention garnered by the Martial Arts Team with the presence of the female audience, he felt this was a good development and asked Lin Zichen to make a slight sacrifice.
After thinking, since everyone else thought it was a good arrangement, Lin Zichen decided it didn't bother him either.
...
Time ticked away second by second.
In the blink of an eye, it was almost 6:30 in the evening.
It was about time for Lin Zichen, so he took the clothes that Shen Qinghan handed him and headed towards the changing room.
At this moment, a ninth-grade senior girl blocked his path, blushing with infatuation, "Zi Chen junior, I brought you milk, it's fresh milk!"
"No need, thank you for the kind offer, but I'm allergic to milk." Lin Zichen didn't want to accept gifts from the opposite sex to avoid misunderstandings, so he found an excuse to politely decline and then walked past her.
But he hadn't gone two steps when a dissatisfied voice called out from behind him.
"Zi Chen, how can you reject a girl's kindness like that?"
"Even if you're allergic to milk, you can still accept it and then give it to someone else to drink. Why do you have to break a girl's heart?"
"Can't you be a little more gentlemanly?"
This was Zhang Kai's voice, the same boy who won a silver medal in a previous school sports competition.
And the girl who had just offered Lin Zichen fresh milk was the object of his secret affection.
Lin Zichen felt that Zhang Kai was being nonsensical and responded to him without a pleasant tone, "My matters are for me to decide, mind your own business."
Zhang Kai was just a junior high school brat, and he took offense at this, feeling he had lost face, and immediately challenged him:
"Dare to spar with me? If I lose, I won't nag you anymore. If I win, you have to accept the milk!"
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone perked up with interest.
It was the same for Guo Xiangyuan.
Lin Zichen had joined the Martial Arts Team for more than a month and had always practiced silently on his own, showering and going home after each session without ever having sparred.
Over time, the rest of the team became very curious about his strength.
Faced with Zhang Kai's challenge, Lin Zichen was also a bit annoyed.
To make this brat learn to behave and stop causing a scene in the future, he said without a second thought, "Fine, let's spar."
No sooner had the words left his mouth than familiar text information appeared in the air.
[Achievement: In a formal competitive setting, using the most primitive biological method, eliminate 1000 different competitors]
[Reward: Acquire Biometric Attributes—Survival of the Fittest]
[Number of Competitors Eliminated: 0/1000]
Seeing the text information in the air, Lin Zichen was initially stunned, then his heart stirred with excitement.
After such a long wait, he finally received his fourth achievement mission.
He wondered what effect the Biometric Attribute of Survival of the Fittest would have and if it would be more powerful than the previous three.
...
PS: Reaching out for Monthly Pass recommendations!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 31 - 31: 31, Dominating the Martial Arts Team
chapters.content:
"Junior Zi Chen, teach him a lesson! Senior sister really hates those guys who like to moral-bind others!"
"Junior Zi Chen, I'll be cheering you on loudly!"
"Junior Zi Chen, go for it, I'll take some great photos for you!"
"..."
As Lin Zichen stepped up to fight, the crowd instantly burst into excited chatter.
Most of it came from the voices of Lin Zichen's little fangirls.
Hearing these overwhelmingly supportive voices, Zhang Kai felt no inner turmoil, and even wanted to laugh.
Do you all think I'm some brainless young fool?
Wrong! Dead wrong!
I am dumb like a fox!
You're on the third level, thinking I'm on the first, but in fact, I'm on the fifth!
I am taking advantage of this talented junior's undeveloped stage, quickly overpowering him while still the bigger one, to leave an extremely glorious record in my martial arts career!
Zhang Kai had noticed Lin Zichen's leap-ahead martial arts talent over the past month.
He knew very clearly that, given another half year, no one in the team would be a match for Lin Zichen.
Therefore, he had to take advantage of Lin Zichen's recent start and immature strength, and openly spar with him to crush him completely.
That way, the higher Lin Zichen's martial arts achievements grew, the more he could boast about it.
Meet someone and brag, "Back in the day, I was the man who thrashed Genius Lin on the Martial Stage!"
Lin Zichen had no idea of the drama going on in Zhang Kai's head.
With a thought, he closed the text information in the air, handed back the clothes to Shen Qinghan, and walked towards the Martial Stage saying:
"It's getting late. I still need to go home for dinner, so let's make this quick."
"Come on!"
Zhang Kai responded, and likewise walked towards the Martial Stage.
Guo Xiangyuan, acting as the coach, quickly followed the two towards the Martial Stage as well.
...
On the Martial Stage.
After both had taken their positions, Guo Xiangyuan said, "I will be the referee for this spar. Remember, friendship first, competition second. Don't hurt the harmony."
Lin Zichen: "Okay, understood coach."
Zhang Kai didn't respond but shouted towards Li Shutong in the audience, "Little Li, record our spar!"
He wanted to keep a video record of today's achievement, so when Lin Zichen really made something of himself in the future, he could bring it out and brag spectacularly.
"Sure." Li Shutong, being a member of the Martial Arts Team, gave him an ok gesture, then took out his phone and started recording the Martial Stage.
Shen Qinghan, also among the audience, took out her phone to record as well. Differently from Zhang Kai, she knew how strong Lin Zichen was; her recording was to document his victorious process.
"Are you both ready?"
On the Martial Stage, Guo Xiangyuan looked at the two sparring teammates and asked.
Lin Zichen: "Ready."
Zhang Kai: "We can start now, coach."
Seeing them both ready, Guo Xiangyuan moved to the edge of the Martial Stage, raised his right hand high, and then swung it down forcefully, declaring:
"The spar officially begins!"
As his words fell, neither of them made a move right away.
Zhang Kai, feeling sure of his victory, arrogantly boasted to Lin Zichen:
"Junior, you've been in the team for just over a month, while I've been here for nearly two years. So, I'll let you have three free moves to prevent you from saying later that I bullied the younger."
"Sure."
Lin Zichen responded curtly and immediately used Blink Step to rush forward, getting close to Zhang Kai in an instant and kicking him off the Martial Stage.
Zhang Kai: "???"
The six teammates below: "Holy shit!"
Guo Xiangyuan was dumbstruck.
The Fresh Milk Senior Sister screamed, "Ahhh! Junior Zi Chen, you're too awesome, you've captured senior sister's soul!"
The other little fangirls also squealed their infatuations.
...
Atop the Martial Stage.
Lin Zichen paid no heed to the clamor below him—his attention was wholly captured by the floating text in the void.
[You have defeated a rival and successfully captivated a member of the opposite sex, earning the right to first choice in mating]
[Rivals eliminated: 1/1000]
999 more rivals to eliminate…
Thinking this, Lin Zichen put away the text and looked down at the six other teammates, asking:
"The six of you, do you want to spar with me as well?"
"..."
However, no one responded to him.
Everyone was still in shock and hadn't recuperated from the scene that had just unfolded.
The first to snap out of it was Zhang Kai, whom he had just kicked off the Martial Stage.
At the moment, Zhang Kai was enduring the pain emanating from his abdomen, struggling to get up from the ground to return to the Martial Stage, stubbornly insisting, "That didn't count, I wasn't ready yet. Let's go again!"
Guo Xiangyuan slowly came back to his senses at the sound of this and frowned at Zhang Kai, saying somewhat irritably, "Zhang Kai, you need to accept a loss when you've wagered. Don't throw away your martial spirit just because you've lost."
Zhang Kai opened his mouth to argue, but Guo Xiangyuan didn't give him the chance. The next second, he turned to Li Shutong below the stage and shouted, "Little Li, get up here and spar with Zi Chen."
"Oh, oh, alright!" Li Shutong said as he put down his phone, and while answering, he stepped onto the Martial Stage.
...
In the following time.
Lin Zichen sparred with all his teammates on the team and, as expected, won every time.
However, to appear as though his strength was still within a normal range, he did not instantly defeat his opponents as he had with Zhang Kai.
Instead, he circled around for a while, exchanging a few moves before beating them.
As a result, the exaggerated display of strength he'd shown when he instantly defeated Zhang Kai could be explained away, avoiding many unnecessary problems.
Everyone assumed that Zhang Kai was defeated so quickly purely because he was arrogant and careless, not because Lin Zichen truly had the strength to defeat him instantly.
"Genius, Zi Chen, you are truly a genius!"
"You've only joined the Martial Arts Team for just over a month, and you've already become the ace of the team!"
"In this year's district martial arts competition, our Shanhai High School will surely beat the other nine schools and take first place!"
Guo Xiangyuan patted Lin Zichen on the shoulder with a smile so wide his mouth wouldn't close.
At the same time, Zhang Kai, who had initially refused to accept Lin Zichen's victory, thinking that he had lost the match due to his own carelessness, now thoroughly acknowledged his defeat.
Zhang Kai had watched all of Lin Zichen's sparring matches with the rest of the team members seriously and realized that he was indeed no match for Lin Zichen; he had no grounds to argue.
"Zi Chen, I, Zhang Kai, admit my loss willingly. From now on, even if you were to shit on my head, I wouldn't complain!"
Zhang Kai looked at Lin Zichen, loudly proclaiming in a resounding voice, as if taking an oath.
He thought such a gesture looked very cool—admitting defeat graciously and sticking to his word would surely win the favor of the girls.
However, the surrounding girls, upon hearing him crudely mention "shit," felt disgusted by his vulgarity and did not even want to give him a second glance.
Lin Zichen had no time to deal with Zhang Kai and was instead frowning at the text in the void.
[Achievement: In official contests, eliminate 1000 different rivals using the most primitive biological means]
[Reward: Acquire the Biometric Attributes—Survival of the Fittest]
[Rivals eliminated: 1/1000]
Only when he defeated Zhang Kai did he make a bit of progress; defeating the other six teammates didn't count.
After careful consideration, Lin Zichen quickly deduced a conclusion based on the previous messages that appeared when he defeated Zhang Kai.
Not every fight counts towards the achievement progress, it must involve a conflict of interest, a competitive nature, to advance.
The initial spar with Zhang Kai was judged as a primeval battle for mating rights.
"It seems that if I want to complete this achievement, I'll need to participate in more competitions in the future."
Lin Zichen murmured internally.
Each contest in a competition is filled with rivalry.
There's the competition for ranking.
There's the competition for prize money.
Therefore, if he could defeat his rivals in those competitions, he would certainly make progress in the achievement task.
...
PS: Holding out my bowl, asking for Monthly Passes and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 32 - 32: 32. Follow the path of martial arts
chapters.content:
Time flew by.
Before I knew it, more than a month had passed since Lin Zichen had dominated the Martial Arts Team.
Since that day, Lin Zichen's status in the team had changed.
He went from being a newcomer to directly transforming into the team's ace.
However, the only changes were in the attitudes of the coach and teammates toward him; he himself hadn't really changed at all.
After school, he still came to the gym to practice martial arts, still found a spot to practice alone, and still only practiced until 6:30 PM before showering and going home.
As for Shen Qinghan, she still waited in the gym every day for Lin Zichen to finish training so they could go home together.
During the wait, Shen Qinghan was either reading or doing practice problems, occasionally taking out her phone to snap some good-looking photos of Lin Zichen, passing the time quite pleasantly.
Sometimes, seeing Lin Zichen sweat profusely, she would even take the initiative to wipe it off for him.
To the scenes of their interactions, everyone in the gym looked on with faces full of envy.
The girls envied Shen Qinghan, envied her for being Lin Zichen's childhood friend, and for being able to stay by Lin Zichen's side every day.
The boys envied Lin Zichen, envied him for having Shen Qinghan, a childhood friend who knew how to take care of others.
As for Lin Zichen's internal reaction to everyone else's envy, there wasn't a ripple.
Shen Qinghan, on the other hand, fitting the heart of a teenage girl, felt a sweet satisfaction when faced with the envious gazes from her peers.
"Han Han, let's go."
In the gym, after Lin Zichen had finished practicing martial arts and come out from the shower room refreshed, he looked at Shen Qinghan, who was quietly waiting at the door, and said.
Upon hearing his voice, Shen Qinghan obediently followed, with her high ponytail swaying with her steps, full of the youthful and lively spirit of a young girl.
The seven teammates who were still in the gym continuing their training saw Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan always coming and going together, every single one of their faces brimming with envy.
"Alright, stop being envious and focus on training!"
"Summer break is almost here, and the new year's inter-school martial arts competition involving eight schools is coming up. As always, there'll only be five spots for competitors, and the best will take the field."
"Now that Zi Chen has already secured one spot, the seven of you will only have four spots left to contend for. Whoever performs well will get to compete."
Seeing that the team members were all staring at the departing back of the childhood friends, Guo Xiangyuan immediately spurred them on with a few words.
Upon hearing this, the seven instantly wore urgent expressions and threw themselves back into training, fearing they would fall behind.
Five of them were in their third year of junior high.
This year's inter-school competition would be the last one they could participate in, and none of them wanted to leave with regrets.
...
In the blink of an eye,
The second semester of the first year was about to come to an end, with only a week left before the final exams.
In that week, in order to help Shen Qinghan achieve good results, Lin Zichen visited her room every night to help her identify and fill in her knowledge gaps.
This evening,
Having just finished dinner and taken a bath, Lin Zichen headed next door to Shen Qinghan's place.
Xu Meng knew he would arrive on time and was waiting for him at the entrance to the house with the door open.
Upon seeing him, she said with a smile,
"Xiao Chen, you've really been a big help lately, coming over every night to tutor Han Han. After you finish your exams and start summer break, Auntie Meng will buy you a present—anything you want."
"No need to be formal, Auntie Meng. I grew up with Han Han, so helping her out is the right thing to do," Lin Zichen said with a smile.
Afterwards, he went straight into the house and headed to the second floor.
Shen Qinghan's room was on the second floor, separated from his own by only two walls.
You could say their rooms were right next to each other.
He stopped at Shen Qinghan's half-open door.
Lin Zichen didn't think too much about it and simply pushed the door open and entered, saying, "Qinghan, I..."
He meant to say "I'm here," but before he could finish, he almost bit his tongue, and his whole person froze on the spot.
Because at that moment, the girl in the room was sitting on her bed, about to pull up her pajama pants, and right above the pajamas was a distinctly visible diaper.
Lin Zichen: "..."
Shen Qinghan: "..."
At that moment, both of them were silent, the air nearly solidifying, the atmosphere becoming extremely awkward.
After a moment of regaining his composure, Lin Zichen took the initiative to break the silence, "Uh... I'll come back in a bit."
He said before hastily turning around and leaving, also closing the door behind him.
No sooner had Lin Zichen left than Shen Qinghan's face turned beet red, and she covered her head with the blanket, curling up into a ball on the bed, completely motionless…
She felt socially dead and wanted to live on a different planet.
...
Ten minutes later.
Lin Zichen felt that enough time had passed, so he stretched out his hand and knocked on the door in front of him, the awkwardness in his voice was hard to disguise, "Han Han, may I come in now?"
"Um..." A nearly inaudible voice came from the room, indicating Shen Qinghan hadn't recovered from the awkward moment just now either.
Lin Zichen acted as if nothing had happened, entering the room with a composed face.
"I... only need to wear diapers when I sleep at night, I don't need them during the day."
Shen Qinghan pursed her lips, bringing up the topic with embarrassment, her delicate face blushing brightly.
Lin Zichen didn't know how to respond, so he simply nodded, "Yeah, I know."
Then, neither of them spoke, and the atmosphere once again lapsed into awkwardness.
However, Shen Qinghan quickly decided to break the ice. She played with her hair delicately with her pale fingers and started a conversation as naturally as possible:
"During dinner tonight, I asked a question to mom and dad. I asked whether they think I look better with my hair tied up or let down."
"Then, dad said I look better with it down, while mom said I look better with it up."
"Xiao Chen, do you think I look better with my hair up or down?"
While asking this, Shen Qinghan mustered the courage to look into Lin Zichen's eyes, hoping to move past the diaper incident and ease the awkwardness between them.
Lin Zichen responded without hesitation, "I think you look good either way."
"That's so evasive, just pick one."
"After thinking about it, I guess you look slightly better with your hair tied up."
"Then, do you think I look better with a single ponytail, double ponytails, or a bun?"
"I like the bun and single ponytail more."
"Then I'll wear a bun tomorrow and a single ponytail the day after... Oh right, between a low ponytail and a high ponytail, which do you think looks better?"
"I think a high ponytail looks better..."
Gradually, both of them opened up, and the conversation flowed more freely than when Lin Zichen first entered the room, easing the initial awkwardness.
It seemed as though the matter of the diapers had been completely forgotten, never to be brought up again.
Before long, they started on the main agenda for the night: one studied as a student, the other tutored as a teacher, and they spent a productive evening at the desk together.
...
Time flies.
A few days later.
Shanhai High School was holding the end-of-term exams.
As a top student, Lin Zichen once again effortlessly secured the first place in the entire school.
Shen Qinghan also did very well.
Within just a year, she had moved up from third from last at the beginning of the school year to the top twenty of her class, proudly receiving an award certificate for Most Improved.
In this process, not only were her own efforts evident but Lin Zichen's tutoring and help played a significant part.
"Xiao Chen, thanks to your help in spotting and fixing my weaknesses, I did really well in the exams!"
In the classroom, Shen Qinghan held the "Most Improved" award certificate, her face full of joy as she spoke to Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen smiled and said, "It's mainly because you were diligent in your studies."
"Xiao Chen, at this rate of progress, in two years, I am definitely going to get into the same class as you, and then we can continue to be desk mates!" Shen Qinghan said with anticipation.
Continue being desk mates in the same class?
Having heard Shen Qinghan's words, Lin Zichen suddenly remembered that he had decided to take Martial Arts Class in high school and that he hadn't mentioned it to her yet, so he said, "Han Han, I've decided to join the Martial Arts Class in high school."
"Then I'll join the Martial Arts Class too!" Shen Qinghan declared without hesitation.
Lin Zichen wondered if she was really suited to take the martial arts path, but seeing her so resolute in her decision to join him, suitably or not, it seemed she was determined to join.
"If you've also decided to take the martial arts path, then from today on, you'll need to change your focus in studies. You'll need to learn more about Exotic Beasts, Genetic Fusion, and mechanical enhancement," he advised her.
"Yeah, I'll do my best!" said Shen Qinghan, full of determination.
She was confident in this area of knowledge; after all, she had read a lot of books with Lin Zichen when they were younger.
The only area where her confidence lacked was perhaps physical fitness.
Lin Zichen thought of this as well, and soon suggested, "Then, after school in the afternoons, come to the gym with me and I'll teach you some exercises for strengthening the body."
"Okay, I'll do whatever Xiao Chen says!" Shen Qinghan nodded obediently.
Her experiences from childhood had taught her that, whatever the matter, following Lin Zichen's advice was always right.
...
PS: Bowl out, asking for monthly and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 33 - 33: 33. Dimensionality Reduction Strike
chapters.content:
"Everyone, train seriously!"
"Don't slack off!"
"There are only four spots left to compete for, and only those who perform well will represent our school in the competition!"
In the gymnasium, Guo Xiangyuan abandoned his usual laissez-faire attitude and was strictly supervising the team members' training.
The final exams had just concluded, and the Martial Arts Team was preparing for the most important martial arts competition of the year, which would take place in mid-summer vacation.
The competition was jointly organized by eight middle schools in the district.
The event was scheduled for August 1st.
Thus, in the month leading up to the competition, Guo Xiangyuan gathered the team members back at school for intensive training.
Afterwards, based on their performance during the training, four members would be selected to represent the school in the competition.
While Guo Xiangyuan was pushing the seven team members through rigorous training, Lin Zichen, who had already secured a spot in the competition and did not need to train with the others, was training Shen Qinghan on the side.
Ever since Shen Qinghan decided to continue with the Martial Arts Class in high school, Lin Zichen had created a summer training plan for her to improve her physical condition.
To avoid affecting her growth, the intensity of this training plan wasn't very high, and the daily regimen only consisted of the following:
One: Jog for 3000 meters to increase stamina.
Two: Practice martial arts techniques for an hour to improve fighting skills.
Three: Push-ups, sit-ups, squats, and pull-ups to train the muscles, performed with reasonable effort for a dozen or so reps each to slightly increase physical strength.
Beyond this, there were no other activities.
Even so, Shen Qinghan, who was somewhat frail, still found it a bit too much.
Right after exercising, she collapsed to the ground, panting non-stop and drenched in sweat.
"Han Han, that was good, you've successfully completed your training for today as well."
Lin Zichen twisted open the bottle cap and passed the sports drink in his hand to Shen Qinghan, affirming her training attitude.
Taking a few sips of the sports drink, Shen Qinghan said with still uneven breaths, "Chen, training the body is really tiring, much more than studying."
"That's for sure, since it does make you sweat." Lin Zichen took a yoga mat from the side, spread it out, and then knelt down on it, saying, "Come, lie down on the yoga mat with your legs spread apart, and I'll help you relax your muscles."
Shen Qinghan obediently lay down on the yoga mat and slightly spread her slender and straight legs.
Seeing this, Lin Zichen quickly started to massage her proficiently.
Perhaps the massages were a bit too vigorous, as the stimulation to the sore muscles might have been too intense.
From time to time, Shen Qinghan would let out a shy, muffled moan, her hands instinctively gripping the yoga mat tight, and her face looked to be in discomfort.
Sometimes, when she could no longer bear it, she would involuntarily cry out in pain and plead for him to be gentler.
Unfortunately, gentleness wasn't an option.
Because to quickly dissipate the lactic acid that had built up in the muscles, some force was necessary during the massage, or else it would be ineffective.
First, he massaged her calves, then her thighs, and lastly her arms. In just a short ten or so minutes, Lin Zichen had massaged nearly every part of Shen Qinghan's body.
Feeling that the massage was sufficient, he took out a set of clean clothes from his backpack and handed them to Shen Qinghan, saying, "Go take a shower, and after that, we'll head home."
"Okay, I'll be quick." Shen Qinghan got up from the yoga mat feeling refreshed, took the clothes Lin Zichen passed her, and headed to the changing room.
After each training session, she very much enjoyed being massaged vigorously by Lin Zichen.
Although the process was somewhat painful, afterwards she would feel completely relaxed all over, which was especially comfortable.
...
A month later.
The training camp ended.
The five competitors were determined.
Among them, the very lively Zhang Kai didn't make the cut.
Disheartened, he left the Martial Arts Team upon hearing the results and didn't even bother to attend as a spectator.
However, no one paid it much heed, life went on as usual.
The next morning.
Guo Xiangyuan drove the school bus, taking the team to the city gymnasium for the competition.
Shen Qinghan also went along, saying she would cheer for Lin Zichen from the spectators' seats as his little fan girl.
Lin Yansheng and Zhang Wanxin also managed to take time to come to the event, wanting to support their son.
As for Xu Meng and Shen Jianye, the couple was busy teaching the senior class at school and couldn't take time off to watch the competition.
However, they asked Shen Qinghan to record Lin Zichen's match and bring the video back for them to watch.
...
City gymnasium, athletes' rest area.
All the competitors from the eight schools lined up to draw lots for their match-ups.
The rules of the competition were straightforward—school against school, and only three rounds were needed to decide the champion.
One round was fought each day, completing the event in three days.
Soon, the draw results were announced.
Shanhai High School, where Lin Zichen was a student, unfortunately drew Shanhai No.1 Middle School, the strongest competitor.
Upon seeing this, Guo Xiangyuan's face changed instantly.
The other four teammates also had grim expressions, all feeling like they would be eliminated in the first round.
Among them, the teammate named Li Shutong even lost hope before the fight started, saying, "It's over, I've heard that this year No.1 has a tough guy who can sprint 100 meters in under 9 seconds. We're definitely going to be smashed!"
"What are you babbling about? We have Zi Chen with us, so it's not certain who'll lose," Guo Xiangyuan glared at Li Shutong and retorted.
That's what he said, but as a coach, he didn't have much confidence either.
In his eyes, Lin Zichen was indeed formidable, but after all, he was just a first-year junior high student and hadn't fully grown yet. Facing someone who could sprint 100 meters in under 9 seconds, most likely he would be crushed.
Sigh, he just hoped the kid's mindset wouldn't be shattered too.
Otherwise, if his confidence was affected, that would be a huge loss.
The Martial Arts Team's banner for the next two years would still have to be carried by him... Guo Xiangyuan worried inwardly.
Lin Zichen, the person in question, had a calm expression at this moment, his heart not the least bit perturbed.
A 9-second 100-meter sprint was strong, but in front of him, who could run 100 meters in 4.61 seconds, they were as insignificant as ants, easily squashed with a simple press.
...
Before long, the first round of the competition began.
The opening match was between Shanhai High School and Shanhai No.1 Middle School.
"Which one of you four will go first?"
Guo Xiangyuan looked at the other four teammates besides Lin Zichen and asked.
None of them made a sound. They were all intimidated, not wanting to be the first to confront the opponent.
Shanhai No.1 Middle School was the champion of the previous year, and they were even stronger this year than last. The first one to go up against their team was basically the same as being the first to be beaten up.
Junior high students are in their most face-conscious period, and no one wanted to be the first to make a fool of themselves.
"Does no one want to go first?"
Guo Xiangyuan furrowed his brow and, seeing that still no one wanted to step up, finally said, "Since none of you are willing to go first, let's decide by drawing lots."
After saying this, he went to get a pen and paper.
However, before he had taken two steps, Lin Zichen spoke up, "Coach, I'll go."
Guo Xiangyuan immediately refused, "No way, you're our trump card. You need to go last to make the most of your advantage."
The benefit of going last is that one can observe the opponent's habits from the sidelines, thus knowing the enemy and oneself, winning every battle.
But, for Lin Zichen, who overwhelmingly outclassed everyone, this wasn't necessary at all.
What he needed was to defeat as many opponents as possible to quickly complete his achievement tasks and gain rewards.
So he said earnestly, "Coach, I want to be the first one to go up."
Guo Xiangyuan was silent, not immediately answering.
But seeing the seriousness in Lin Zichen's eyes, and that the other four really didn't want to go, he eventually had to compromise, "Alright then, Zi Chen, you'll go first."
...
After both sides had decided on their first competitors,
the first round's opening match soon commenced.
The opponent's first to take the stage was a big boy over 1.9 meters tall, all muscle, looking like a mountain seated on the Martial Stage, exuding an immense sense of pressure.
Lin Zichen, whose body hadn't developed as quickly and was less than 1.7 meters tall, stood in front of the other guy like a freshly hatched chick, easily squashed.
"Little junior from Shanhai, I've seen your information on the roster, it's impressive that you're standing on the Martial Stage of the eight-school competition as a first-year. You're very talented," the burly boy said with a naive smile on the Martial Stage.
Seeing how naively the opponent smiled, Lin Zichen thought the big guy seemed pretty nice.
But just as he was about to reply politely, the burly boy's demeanor shifted abruptly, his eyes becoming filled with contempt as he said,
"However, I think it's my duty to tell you that this is not a place for a first-year like you, especially one who's not even 1.7 meters tall."
With that, the opponent tensed his muscles forcefully, showing off his massive pecs with a juvenile attitude, "Soon, you'll experience what a physical disparity feels like, what a difference in strength means!"
...
PS: Holding out my bowl, seeking Monthly Pass and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 34 - 34: 34, The Child of Destiny
chapters.content:
The sudden burst of chūnibyō from the big boy left Lin Zichen somewhat speechless.
This kid must be a bit air-headed.
...
On the other side, in the audience seats.
Watching the big boy on the Martial Stage, Zhang Wanxin was completely shocked.
What on earth did this child eat to grow so big and tall in middle school?
Then, with a worried face, she said, "Husband, the kid is so big, how can Xiao Chen fight against him? What if he gets hurt?"
"It's fine, these big types usually aren't very agile. Xiao Chen can win by using nimble footwork, and as for injuries... there's a referee watching, so it shouldn't happen."
Lin Yansheng said soothingly.
He said these words, but in reality, even he didn't feel confident; he was more trying to calm Zhang Wanxin.
Differently from the couple, Shen Qinghan was full of confidence in Lin Zichen.
She looked at Zhang Wanxin and said confidently, "Don't worry, Aunt Xin, Xiao Chen will definitely win. Against those dumb brutes, Xiao Chen can knock them down with a single punch!"
Hearing her call someone a dumb brute, Zhang Wanxin immediately said with a gentle voice, "Han Han, you shouldn't call people dumb brutes, it's not nice."
"Oh, I won't do it again, Aunt Xin," Shen Qinghan said, acknowledging her mistake.
Afterwards, she looked towards the Martial Stage and put her delicate, white hands in front of her mouth, shouting with her little voice, "Xiao Chen, come on!"
When her cheering voice was heard, people on the opposite side of the audience seats quickly yelled back, not to be outdone, "Da Zhuang, come on, take him down!"
Zhang Wanxin, upon hearing this, was immediately displeased and also shouted, "Xiao Chen, come on, you can win, Mom believes in you!"
After shouting, she nudged her husband, Lin Yansheng, and urged him, "Husband, shout quickly, your voice is louder, we can't lose in momentum!"
"Xiao Chen, come on!!!" Lin Yansheng bellowed with all his might, making several nearby spectators' ears ring.
Guo Xiangyuan, in the rest area, heard this and had the other four team members cheer for Lin Zichen as well.
Seeing this, people from Shanhai No.1 Middle School immediately imitated them and shouted out their cheers.
In just a brief moment, the whole venue became lively.
...
On the Martial Stage.
Lin Zichen smiled and waved to both sides when he heard the cheers from his family and teammates.
His opponent, the big boy, stood there with a cold face, not moving at all, paying no mind to the family and teammates cheering for him, thinking it made him look cooler.
"Competitors, please take your positions quickly. The match is about to begin!"
The referee, seeing it was time, immediately said to the two on the stage with a loud voice.
Hearing this, both of them quickly took their positions.
Seeing that both were ready, the referee immediately raised his right hand and chopped down, "The duel, begins!"
As soon as the words were out, the big boy immediately charged at Lin Zichen like a bull.
This was a formal match; no competitor would foolishly let their opponent strike first.
This is a bad habit that doesn't lead to victory; if a competitor up top dares to do that, the coach below dares to curse them out.
Faced with the charging big boy, Lin Zichen simply sidestepped to avoid him and then lightly pushed on the boy's back with his hand.
Then, in the next moment, the big boy lost his balance and stumbled straight out of the Martial Stage, losing in record time.
All at once, the venue fell silent, stunned by this unexpected scene.
About two seconds passed.
Shen Qinghan was the first to snap out of it, her small face filled with excitement as she yelled:
"Xiao Chen, you're so amazing!!!"
Zhang Wanxin also hugged Lin Yansheng excitedly, exclaiming,
"Husband, you really have a knack for prediction; Xiao Chen actually won with agility against that big lump!"
"Ha ha ha, that's right, that's right." Lin Yansheng couldn't be happier, having merely guessed the outcome; no one could have expected that.
With the voices of these three, the other people around also came back to their senses, and a wave of murmuring erupted in the audience seats.
"What the heck? He's so much bigger and stronger, how could he lose?"
"Dead muscles, definitely dead muscles, not agile at all, no wonder he lost."
"Damn it, stupid lump, there goes my money down the drain!"
"..."
On the other side, in the competitor's rest area.
Guo Xiangyuan and the four teammates were all insanely excited, each of them shouting at the top of their lungs, "Zi Chen is awesome!"
Meanwhile, the people from Shanhai No.1 Middle School were all frowning, feeling somewhat displeased.
The coach from Shanhai No.1 Middle School, in particular, was so angry that his face turned green, berating the hulking boy, "Footwork! Footwork! How many times have I told you? Don't just rush straight in on the Martial Stage! Use footwork! Why don't you ever listen!!!"
The hulking boy was dumbfounded by the scolding, his eyes instantly welling up with tears, but he dared not cry.
Lin Zichen watched the coach from Shanhai No.1 High School and felt that this person might not be very competent.
The reason the hulking boy had been pushed out of the Martial Stage wasn't that he was moving too fast and couldn't stop, causing him to lose balance. It was purely the strength of the light push on his back that was too great.
After all, an arm that could easily lift over 1000kg was not something a middle schooler could withstand.
Even if this middle schooler was extremely bulky, he would still end up being pushed off the Martial Stage when faced with such a powerful burst of strength.
[You have successfully defeated a competitor, and your ranking in the competition has improved.]
[Total opponents knocked out: 2/1000]
As expected, as long as he defeated competitors in a highly competitive contest, he could advance the progress bar for his achievement tasks!
Lin Zichen felt a surge of excitement in his heart, eager to get started on the next duel.
Luckily, there was no break time in the middle of this tournament's matches, and competitors had to fight the next round immediately after winning their current duel.
"Chen Feng, you're up for this duel. Go all out from the start and defeat that freshman from Shanhai High School as fast as you can, got it?"
In the rest area of Shanhai No.1 Middle School, the coach, with a stern face, told the crew-cut boy ranked second in strength on their team.
The crew-cut boy nodded seriously and said, "I got it, Coach."
After speaking, he took his position on the Martial Stage calmly and stood there, silently waiting for the referee's signal to begin.
Seeing both competitors ready, the referee immediately raised his right hand and chopped it down, "The duel begins!"
Hearing the signal to start the duel, the crew-cut boy charged out in a burst, aiming a sharp side kick at Lin Zichen's neck.
Lin Zichen calmly ducked down, narrowly evading the side kick, and casually pushed the crew-cut boy's waist with his hand.
The next moment, while still in the middle of executing the side kick and standing on one leg, the crew-cut boy's body instantly lost balance. To the far-off onlooker, he looked as if he had slipped. He fell to the ground with a "thud."
Conveniently, he happened to hit the back of his head and passed out on the spot.
The venue fell silent once again, utterly stunned by the scene on the Martial Stage.
The first to react were the medical personnel who had been waiting below the stage.
After seeing the crew-cut boy faint from hitting the back of his head, they immediately rushed to the stage with a stretcher and carried him away for treatment.
Then, a flurry of discussion broke out in the spectators' seats.
"What's going on? How come that student from Shanhai High School is so lucky?"
"Well, geez, the previous opponent lost by running out of the ring, and now this one accidentally slips, hits his head, and faints. Is this the son of fortune?"
"It's not just luck, though. That move just now to dodge the side kick was really quick. They've got skill."
"Holy crap! It must be a rigged match! Refund!"
"..."
In the rest area of Shanhai No.1 Middle School.
The coach from Shanhai No.1 Middle School was dumbfounded, unable to believe the scene unfolding before his eyes.
Luck? Was this really just luck?
No! It wasn't luck!
This freshman from Shanhai High School had real skill!
Realizing this, the coach from Shanhai No.1 Middle School immediately turned to the strongest person on the team, a sprinter who could run a hundred meters in just 9 seconds, and said with a hint of panic in his voice, "Gaofei, you're up for this next duel. Focus on defense; don't attack proactively. Let's see what this freshman from Shanhai High School is all about. You absolutely cannot lose!"
"Don't worry, Coach. I'll win."
The boy named Gaofei responded confidently and then walked onto the Martial Stage with a self-assured demeanor.
He had observed the entirety of those two recent matches and felt that Lin Zichen wasn't particularly strong physically; he was just agile and knew how to take advantage in combat, which is why he could win so effortlessly.
So he believed that with his equally agile body, rich fighting experience, and the ability to sprint a hundred meters in just 9 seconds, as long as he took the upcoming duel seriously and stayed fully focused, there was no reason for him to lose.
...
PS: I'm setting the bowl down, asking for monthly tickets and recommendation votes!

chapters.title: Chapter 35 - 35: 35. Undefeated champions
chapters.content:
"I heard that Gaofei from Shanhai No.1 Middle School can run 100 meters in under 9 seconds, that's just ridiculous, considering he's still a junior high student."
"That's normal, his father is a Genetic Integrator, so as an offspring of a Genetic Integrator, it's certain that his physical quality far surpasses that of an ordinary person."
"Hearing you guys talk like that, it seems that the freshman from Shanhai High School doesn't stand a chance."
"What's there to worry about? He's just a freshman now. Give him a couple of years to grow, then Shanhai High School will surely be in the top spot..."
As soon as Gaofei from Shanhai No.1 Middle School appeared, the spectator stands were immediately filled with murmurs about him.
Most were in awe, captivated by his exceptional physical quality.
As for Lin Zichen...almost no one was optimistic.
Even Zhang Wanxin and Lin Yansheng didn't hold much hope, feeling that their son was probably going to lose.
In the eyes of the parents, their son was very talented, but still within the range of ordinary people; they thought it nearly impossible for him to compete with the monster who could run 100 meters in 9 seconds.
While they thought so, Zhang Wanxin still shouted to Lin Zichen as usual, "Xiao Chen, come on, as long as you try your best, you can definitely win!"
Hearing that, Lin Yansheng and Shen Qinghan beside her also started to cheer for Lin Zichen.
...
On the Martial Stage.
Lin Zichen, hearing Shen Qinghan and his parents' shouts of encouragement, immediately waved his hand with a smile in response, just as before.
Gaofei, seeing this, said, "Junior from the mountain school, you and your family seem to have a great relationship. It makes me envious."
"It's okay," Lin Zichen replied with a smile.
No sooner had he spoken than Gaofei, with a look of envy, said, "Unfortunately, I can't stand seeing other people have harmonious family relationships. For the upcoming duel, I suggest you prepare yourself mentally, because... I'm going to launch the fiercest onslaught on you!"
Lin Zichen was exasperated to hear this, having encountered yet another junior high boy who seemed a little off. It seemed that Shanhai No.1 Middle School was a breeding ground for such youthful exuberance.
"The duel is about to begin, please take your positions," the referee told the two of them.
At that, they both took their positions and prepared for the start of the duel.
Seeing them ready, the referee skillfully raised his right hand and brought it down, declaring, "Begin the duel!"
At this command, Gaofei leveraged his calf muscles, instantly dashed in front of Lin Zichen, and launched his family's martial art, the Flowing Water Rock-Smashing Fist.
In a flash!
His fists hammered toward Lin Zichen like raindrops, with speed, precision, and ferocity!
Lin Zichen found this set of fist techniques interesting and didn't rush to take Gaofei down. Instead, he easily dodged the attacks while memorizing and learning every move and style.
"Gaofei, what are you doing? I told you to focus on defense, why are you attacking?"
Below the stage, the Shanhai No.1 Middle School's coach, seeing his student ignore the tactical arrangement, was so frustrated that he shouted loudly.
However, Gaofei on the platform paid no attention to him and continued his fierce attacks against Lin Zichen, self-willed as always.
Defense?
That kind of turtle strategy wasn't needed by someone with his talent!
As soon as he stepped onto the stage, he was determined to launch the most vicious attacks on his opponent!
Either a swift victory or a swift defeat!
Never to shrink back!
That was what Gaofei thought as he began his offensive.
But as time went on and he realized he couldn't land a hit on Lin Zichen at all, his mentality collapsed!
"What's going on?!"
"How can you dodge my attacks?!"
"This is unscientific!!"
Gaofei stopped attacking, looked at Lin Zichen in disbelief, and asked loudly.
Without answering, Lin Zichen simply asked, "Do you have any other moves? Show them all."
"You...!"
Hearing Lin Zichen's words, Gaofei's face turned red with anger.
It was an unabashed mockery!
Damn it!
Enraged, his complexion flushed, he quickly charged at Lin Zichen again, launching a furious barrage of punches!
Seeing that he was still using the same techniques, Lin Zichen knew that Gaofei was out of tricks and didn't want to waste any more time. He promptly kicked him off the Martial Stage, claiming victory in the duel.
Gaofei actually lost?
At that moment, everyone in the audience was stunned, never expecting such an outcome to the duel.
Soon, the venue erupted with incredulous gasps of amazement.
"Xiao Chen, you're so awesome!!!"
"Honey, our son is amazing!"
"Zi Chen, badass!"
"What's going on, what's the deal with that freshman from Shanhai High School?!"
"This is too fake, it must be a rigged match!"
At that moment, the entire stadium was filled with the piercing noise of the crowd.
Lin Zichen paid no attention to these voices and quickly started the next match.
...
The fourth match, taken down at lightning speed!
...
The fifth match, taken down at lightning speed!
...
In less than ten minutes, Lin Zichen had defeated the remaining two players from Shanhai No.1 Middle School, single-handedly overcoming the whole school.
Then.
In the following two days, he continued in the same vein, single-handedly defeating the next two schools they faced, successfully leading Shanhai High School to win the championship of the eight-school league.
During this time, his four teammates didn't play a single match, winning lying down.
Perhaps for them, not having played in their last competition might be a bit regrettable.
But Lin Zichen didn't care about these things, he only cared about his progress in completing achievement tasks.
...
On the winner's podium.
Lin Zichen held the championship trophy aloft, taking pictures with the coach, teammates, family, childhood friends, and even several passing spectators.
After sharing the joy of the victory, he immediately looked into the void to check the progress of his achievement task.
[Total Opponents Eliminated: 16/1000]
He still needed to defeat 984 different opponents to complete this achievement related to Survival of the Fittest.
With such a gap in progress, it definitely couldn't be finished anytime soon.
It seemed it would take years...
Thinking this, Lin Zichen shook his head, no longer overly concerned with this achievement task, and turned to ask Guo Xiangyuan about the division of the championship prize money.
The champion of the eight-school league had a total prize money of 30,000 yuan.
The school took a share, and then the coaches and teammates took theirs.
In the end, Lin Zichen, as the absolute main force, received a bonus of 20,000 yuan.
He took away two-thirds of the total.
It was much more than he had expected.
...
That evening, the two families gathered together for a celebratory dinner.
Lin Zichen, the champion, was praised by the parents of both families from start to finish.
He had the stature of a Mechanically Modified Human!
He had the stature of a Genetic Integrator!
They showered him with compliments and high hopes.
Listening, Lin Zichen felt no emotion inside; he was busy calculating how much money he had saved up.
There was the 20,000-yuan bonus for winning the martial arts competition.
There was the prize money from various academic contests he had won before.
And there was the scholarship money from the school.
All added together, it was almost 30,000 yuan.
"This is a substantial amount of money, it's time to find a personal shopper to buy some Phantom Squid Meat, aiming to unlock the Phantom Squid's compendium before graduating from junior high..." Lin Zichen thought to himself.
...
PS: Begging for monthly tickets and recommendation votes!

chapters.title: Chapter 36 - 36: 36, Junior High School Graduate
chapters.content:
It took a few days of wandering around the mall.
In the end, Lin Zichen successfully found an old man to act as his personal shopper.
This old man was a local landlord, owning several properties for rent. On his days off, he'd stroll through the mall in his boxer shorts and flip-flops, helping to tidy tables or dig through trash bins for empty bottles to sell.
He wasn't short of money, but he just liked collecting trash to save up.
Every time he found an empty bottle, he felt an immense satisfaction, elated to the point of bliss.
All Lin Zichen had to do was tell the old man that all the empty bottles from his house would be his, and the old man happily agreed to help him with the purchases.
With the personal shopper settled,
the thirty thousand yuan he had was quickly spent.
All on devouring Phantom Squid Meat, consuming thirty jin in a row, directly boosting the progress of the Phantom Squid album to 33%.
...
In the half month of summer vacation that followed,
Lin Zichen trained every day, working out three times a day: morning, noon, and evening. Each session was intense.
During breaks, he'd call Shen Qinghan out from her home to help her train her body.
Days passed by one after another.
When the summer vacation ended and the moment to step into the second year of junior high arrived,
Lin Zichen's Biological Level broke through.
He successfully went from a regular Third Order to a regular Fourth Order.
At the same time, all his physical data improved tremendously.
He could easily lift a weight of 1090 kg with one hand.
His vertical jump from a standstill reached 5.65 meters.
And his 100-meter sprint took just 4.49 seconds.
However, upon closer examination, one could see that the improvement in these three data points wasn't as exaggerated as the previous two evolutions, which had doubled or quadrupled.
Lin Zichen could understand this. After all, it gets harder to strengthen the body as it improves, and the scale of improvement couldn't always be in multiples, as it also depended on the original figures.
Take strength, for instance.
Increasing from 100 kg to 400 kg, the value quadrupled.
But going from 400 kg to 800 kg, it merely doubled.
Yet, the latter's improvement was clearly larger, with an additional 100 kg gained.
"Before, I thought that reaching a regular Fourth Order before graduating junior high would be an achievement, but now, only in the second year, I've already made it. It seems I underestimated myself..."
Lin Zichen thought to himself with a smile.
...
Time flew by, and two years passed in the blink of an eye.
Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan had both completed their middle school exams and successfully graduated from the junior division of Shanhai High School.
On the day of graduation, both sets of parents found time to attend their children's ceremony.
"Come on, you two, get closer, and give me a brighter smile!"
Zhang Wanxin, as always, was in charge of taking a joint photo of this pair of childhood sweethearts, capturing their growth at each school age with photographs.
While they posed for the photo, many girls around them were watching.
Seeing Shen Qinghan clinging to Lin Zichen, the onlooking girls were all brimming with envy, wishing they could pull Shen Qinghan away and take her place next to Lin Zichen.
Feeling the envious gazes of her peers, Shen Qinghan felt incredibly elated, believing she was the happiest girl in the world.
Almost half an hour passed.
The photo session ended.
Lin Zichen looked down at Shen Qinghan beside him and realized that without noticing, he had almost grown a head taller than her.
Shen Qinghan noticed his gaze and immediately turned to him, lifting her incredibly beautiful face, her eyes shimmering, and she asked,
"Why are you staring at the top of my head, is there something stuck there?"
"No, I just suddenly realized I'm almost a head taller than you."
"Don't talk nonsense, how can it be a whole head, we just measured our heights a few days ago; you're 1.78 meters, I'm 1.62 meters, it's only a difference of 16 centimeters. A head's difference has to be at least 20 centimeters."
Shen Qinghan pursed her rosy lips slightly, showing her dissatisfaction with Lin Zichen's imprecise wording.
As the height difference between them grew larger, she became very conscious of her own height, not even a centimeter could be discounted.
Lin Zichen corrected, "Don't be in such a rush, I said I'm almost a head taller than you, don't ignore the word 'almost'."
Shen Qinghan pouted, "I don't care, even 'almost' is not okay, it must be precise to the centimeter!"
After saying this, she looked at the widening height gap between herself and Lin Zichen and couldn't help worrying, "You're nearly 1.8 meters now, if you continue to grow after entering high school, I'll have to stand on my tiptoes to wipe the sweat off your face."
"You're overthinking it, you're so short that standing on tiptoes won't be enough to reach me anyway, you'd at least have to stand on a chair."
Lin Zichen reached out to pat her head, teasing her.
"Ah, that's right!" Shen Qinghan glared at him annoyed, "In a few more years, I'll be so short I'll have to jump to hit your knee!"
Zhang Wanxin watched the two of them with an auntie's smile and said, "It's fine, Han Han, if standing on tiptoes is still not enough, you can just let Xiao Chen pick you up, then you'll be able to wipe the sweat from his face."
"Aunt Xin, you're teasing me again~" Suddenly being made fun of by Zhang Wanxin, Shen Qinghan's cheeks flushed red with embarrassment.
Lin Zichen, on the other hand, didn't seem to mind and just smiled without saying anything.
But now that he thought about it, it had been a long time since he had held Shen Qinghan.
In kindergarten, he used to hold her often; during nap times at school, Shen Qinghan liked to crawl into his blanket and hold him while they slept, and over three years, she had peed on him almost 100 times.
In elementary school, he had only carried her a few times, but he carried her on his back quite frequently.
During the three years of middle school, he only held her when they encountered trouble from the Heretical Sect, and hadn't held her since.
It could only be said that ultimately they had grown up.
Their physiological differences became increasingly pronounced, and their secondary sexual characteristics became more apparent, making physical contact with the opposite sex more sensitive.
Out of various considerations, they couldn't casually hug and hold each other like they did when they were younger.
...
Half a month later.
The results of the middle school exams were released.
As everyone expected, Lin Zichen secured the first place in the district.
Whether it was the cultural subjects or the physical fitness data needed for the Martial Arts Class application, he was the absolute first in the district.
Actually, he could have been the first in the entire city, but he thought it would be better to keep a low profile; being district number one was enough.
For Shen Qinghan, there was an unexpected turn.
She performed exceptionally well in cultural subjects, going above and beyond to rank within the top hundred in the district, more than enough to advance to Shanhai High School's high school division.
However, her physical fitness data fell short of the admission score for the Martial Arts top class at Shanhai High School, missing it by over ten points; that was a significant margin.
"Xiao Chen, I've been training so hard, but my physical fitness scores just won't improve, I feel as if I'm not suited for martial arts."
Shen Qinghan lay on her bed with her right arm covering her eyes, looking utterly disheartened.
Lin Zichen sat beside her bed, comforting her, "Don't lose confidence in yourself, you just didn't get into the top class, that's all. You're already better than many people, and you're still young, just 15 years old. Your body hasn't fully developed yet, you still have a lot of potential."
"What do you mean I'm still young, you're only a day older than me, why do you say it as if you could be my dad?" Shen Qinghan couldn't help but retort.
Lin Zichen teased with a smile, "I wouldn't mind being your dad."
"Ah, you're so annoying, I'm already so heartbroken, and you're still joking around with me!"
Shen Qinghan lightly hit Lin Zichen, but didn't put much force into it, like the playful banter between a couple.
After that, she quickly added with a defeated tone, "Even though our bodies haven't fully developed, your physical fitness scores are way better than mine. Compared to you, I feel like a useless homebody."
Lin Zichen was about to console her when his phone suddenly rang in his pocket.
It was a call from Zhang Wanxin.
Upon answering, he learned that the principal of the high school division of Shanhai High School was at his home, making a special visit to this district's number one prodigy and academic star.
The purpose of the visit was to ensure he would proceed to Shanhai High School's high school division, instead of being secretly poached by another high school.
After hanging up, Lin Zichen turned to Shen Qinghan on the bed and said, "Qinghan, the principal of the high school division is at our place, come with me to meet him."
"I don't feel like going..." Shen Qinghan was in a low mood and just wanted to stay quietly in her room.
Lin Zichen spoke gently, trying to persuade her, "Still, come with me. Greet the principal, let him get to know you, so when school starts we can continue being classmates and desk-mates."
Upon hearing this, Shen Qinghan pressed her lips together and reluctantly got up from the bed, following Lin Zichen to meet the principal of the high school division.
After all, with her ordinary physical fitness data, there was no way she could get into the Martial Arts top class of the high school division.
If she wanted to remain in the same class as Lin Zichen, she would have to use her relationship with Lin Zichen like during the transition from elementary to middle school, taking advantage as a beneficiary of favoritism.
...
PS: Bowls out, seeking monthly tickets, recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 37 - 37: 37. Open the Ghost Squid Album
chapters.content:
```
Lin Zichen led Shen Qinghan back home, and upon entering the door, they saw the principal of the Shanhai High School's high school division.
The person was a middle-aged woman wearing gold-rimmed glasses, her hair neatly pinned up, dressed in a ladies' business suit, giving off a very capable vibe.
"Xiao Chen, Han Han, come sit over here and have a good talk with Principal Bai."
As soon as the two children arrived, Zhang Wanxin immediately waved them over to sit down on the sofa.
Soon, Lin Zichen sat down opposite the female principal.
He was well aware that the female principal was there for student recruitment, so after briefly chatting with her, he cut straight to the chase and asked:
"Principal Bai, I personally prefer to skip ahead to the high school division, but I have a small request. I'd like to continue being in the same class as my childhood friend here. Is that possible?"
"Of course, that's no problem!"
The female principal answered without hesitation.
She had already discussed this with the middle school's Principal Chen and knew Lin Zichen would make such a small request.
And she had also learned everything about Shen Qinghan beforehand.
The academic performance was very good; it was just the physical test scores that were lacking, causing the failure to be accepted into the martial arts elite class.
For a student whose grades weren't terribly bad, bending the rules to admit her was no big deal.
The conversation was brief.
In the end, both Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan confirmed they would attend Shanhai High School's high school division, and just like in elementary and middle school, they would be in the same class.
The only difference was, Shen Qinghan was not as cheerful as she was during the transition from elementary to middle school.
Back then when she learned that she would go to the same school and class and sit next to Lin Zichen, she was extremely delighted.
Yet now, as she transitioned from middle to high school, she felt more embarrassed, inferior, and discouraged.
As she grew older, Shen Qinghan had come to realize that getting in through the back door was actually quite disgraceful.
But unfortunately, she had to rely on this method every time to stay in the same class and desk as Lin Zichen.
This made her feel utterly useless, like a large infant completely dependent on others.
...
A few days later.
At the Shanhai High School's middle school division, inside the gymnasium.
Guo Xiangyuan, the Martial Arts Team coach, was rigorously training the twenty-six team members.
In the past, the Martial Arts Team wasn't given much attention by the school leaders and had few members, so he lacked the enthusiasm to train them, and the team was mostly in a free-range state.
But ever since Lin Zichen joined the Martial Arts Team and took it to a whole new level, everything changed.
The school leaders started to pay attention to the Martial Arts Team.
The number of students wanting to join the Martial Arts Team increased too.
These changes made him also become more responsible and committed to leading the Martial Arts Team properly.
"Hello, captain!"
"Hello, captain!"
"Hello, Senior Shen!"
"..."
No sooner had Lin Zichen and Shen Qinghan stepped into the gym from outside than the Martial Arts Team members training inside all stopped to greet them.
Even Guo Xiangyuan, as the coach, changed from his stern expression to a smile and said, "Zi Chen, Xiao Shen, there's tea on the table that's just the right temperature. Sit down and have a cup first."
"No need, I just came to grab a yoga mat to use, and then I'll leave," Lin Zichen replied, picked up a yoga mat with one hand, and went to a corner up front to relax Shen Qinghan's muscles.
Shen Qinghan had just finished training on the outdoor field and was now all achy and utterly exhausted. As soon as she saw the yoga mat laid out on the ground, she flopped down on it without any strength.
Immediately after, she skillfully parted her legs to facilitate Lin Zichen's massaging of her leg muscles.
Thanks to several years of training, Shen Qinghan's physical fitness had improved a lot, and her body proportion had become even more perfect.
Take her legs, for example; they used to be straight and slender, like chopsticks, without much flesh and lacking a sense of beauty.
But now, a bit of flesh had filled out her legs, making them fuller. This not only improved the feel but also made her legs look healthy and attractive.
"Xiao Chen, you can use a bit more force on the thighs."
"Okay."
"No, no, that's too hard, it hurts!"
"How about now?"
"Now it's just right."
Shen Qinghan relaxed her body, lying on the yoga mat, closing her eyes to rest and relieve fatigue, while enjoying Lin Zichen's massage at just the right pressure.
About half an hour later.
The massage was over.
```
Shen Qinghan rose from the yoga mat and stretched languidly, her face expressing utmost comfort.
Then, she looked down at Lin Zichen, seated beside her, and said with a smile, "Xiao Chen, it's your turn to enjoy my massage techniques. Lie down, quick."
"Remember to press hard," he replied.
"No problem, I'll take care of all your needs!"
"Then come on, start with my calves."
As he spoke, Lin Zichen lay down, letting Shen Qinghan's delicate hands work on his body.
…
One month later.
The date had turned to August 1st.
Having joined the Martial Arts Team for three years, Lin Zichen was about to enter his third inter-school competition.
In this competition, just like the previous two, he defeated an entire school by himself.
Sweeping through three rounds, he claimed the championship with an uncontested victory.
After receiving his prize money,
Lin Zichen immediately went to the marketplace to find the broker who rented stalls there, seeking a purchase.
He was only 20% away from unlocking the Phantom Squid album. With a prize money of 20,000 Yuan, he could unlock it today.
Soon enough,
he got his hands on the purchased Phantom Squid Meat.
After leaving the mall, Lin Zichen headed to a small grove without surveillance cameras and eagerly began to devour it.
[You have consumed a significant amount of the "Phantom Squid's" Life Origin.]
[Phantom Squid album: 100% complete.]
Following the appearance of the text, a blue squid slowly began to emerge in the void, casually swimming in the ethereal ocean, seemingly content.
This was a Phantom Squid.
It had eighteen tentacles.
And on each tentacle was an eye.
It looked particularly odd and peculiar.
Suddenly, the squid seemed to sense Lin Zichen's gaze and swiftly sank into the depths of the void ocean, vanishing without a trace.
At the same time, new text appeared in the void.
[You have successfully unlocked the Phantom Squid album and acquired the Biometric Attribute—Blessing of Melting Water.]
[Blessing of Melting Water: Significantly enhances your affinity with water, allowing you to move freely in the water and disappear without a trace.]
That's it?
After reading the description of the attribute, the first thought that come to Lin Zichen's mind was that the effect of Blessing of Melting Water seemed somewhat trivial.
Out of thoroughness, he immediately found the nearest swimming pool to test out the effect of the Blessing of Melting Water attribute.
He soaked in the pool for a whole three hours.
Ultimately, he discovered that the Blessing of Melting Water attribute had the following effects:
One: after spending a long time in water, his skin didn't wrinkle like it used to.
Two: soaking in water felt very comfortable.
Three: when swimming, he could clearly feel a significant reduction in water resistance.
Beyond that, there were no other effects.
Lin Zichen felt a bit disappointed; compared to attributes like Use It or Lose It, Divine Human Wisdom Root, and Survival of the Fittest, Blessing of Melting Water fell far short.
But on second thought, it was normal for it to be far inferior.
After all, the Phantom Squid was a very low-level Exotic Beast, valuable only for consumption and with no value for Genetic Fusion.
The Biometric Attribute gained from unlocking its album would naturally also be low-level.
To acquire Biometric Attributes of a higher level, one would likely need to consume those high-level Exotic Beasts used for Genetic Fusion.
With this realization, Lin Zichen came to terms with it.
After all, the Blessing of Melting Water Biometric Attribute only cost 100,000 Yuan to obtain, which was quite a bargain; there was nothing to be disappointed about.
To acquire better Biometric Attributes, he could slowly save up money to buy them in the future; they would come eventually.
Or perhaps, once he became stronger, he could hunt and consume wild Exotic Beasts.
For example, those Giant Mutant Rats that were the closest to him... Lin Zichen suddenly thought boldly.
…
PS: Begging for Monthly Passes and recommendation tickets!

chapters.title: Chapter 38 - 38: 38. The reason why Shen Qinghan easily wets the bed
chapters.content:
Time flew by, and by late August, less than a week remained until the start of the school term.
Zhang Wanxin, seeing that both children's summer vacations were almost over and neither family had properly gone out to have fun together, suggested that they go to the beach for a vacation in the remaining days.
Her proposal was met with unanimous approval from everyone.
The next morning.
Both families got up bright and early, ready to drive to the nearest bay for some fun.
Before departure, as usual, Shen Qinghan wanted to ride in Lin Yansheng's car and sit in the back row with Lin Zichen.
Lin Zichen felt it was not quite right to always lure someone else's daughter into his family's car, so he suggested riding in Shen Jianye's car.
...
About two hours later.
The car smoothly arrived at the destination.
The two families rented a seaside house, and after moving all the stuff from the cars and setting it up inside, they quickly set out for the beach.
It was now the height of summer, and the sandy beach was bustling with activity.
Wherever one looked, there were people everywhere.
Lin Yansheng and Shen Jianye, the two adult men, faced with the occasional passing sexy bikini-clad women, wanted to look but didn't dare to and awkwardly ended up squinting.
Lin Zichen, also a male, was not at all interested in the so-called bikini beauties.
His gaze constantly swept back and forth along the shore.
Looking for a spot with fewer people that was suitable for swimming.
With the "Blessing of Melting Water" attribute, he felt excited at the sight of water now.
The wonderful feeling of being soaked in water at the pool the last time had left him yearning for more, and he couldn't wait to experience it again.
"Xiao Chen, there's a changing room over there. I'm going to change into my swimsuit, so wait for me outside,"
Shen Qinghan pointed to a building ahead and said.
Originally, she could have changed into her swimsuit back at the seaside house, but she was too shy at the time and felt very embarrassed. It wasn't until she got to the beach, where everyone was wearing swimsuits, that she gradually let go.
Lin Zichen accompanied her to change into her swimsuit.
And waited outside the building.
As for himself, he had come wearing only his swim trunks and was not as shy as Shen Qinghan.
...
About ten minutes later.
Shen Qinghan came out of the changing room.
She wore a very conservative swimsuit, so conservative that it didn't even reveal her navel and only showed her arms and legs.
It hardly looked like a swimsuit at all.
Still, Shen Qinghan felt very embarrassed, her face flushed red as she came out.
"Xiao Chen, do I look strange in this swimsuit?"
"No, not at all, I think it looks very good,"
"Really?"
"Really."
Lin Zichen said, with his conscience gnawing at him.
Did it look nice?
Very nice!
But it was so covered up that it did look a bit strange.
Shen Qinghan had no idea what he was really thinking; hearing him say it looked very good, her delicate face instantly bloomed with a smile.
Soon, the two of them found a spot with fewer people to play in the water.
Coincidentally, the parents of both families were also there.
All six family members had the same idea and had chosen this prime spot.
"Xiao Chen, the sea water is so cold!"
"It's like this when you first get in. Just slowly get used to it, and soon it won't feel cold anymore."
No sooner had he finished speaking than Lin Zichen submerged himself in the sea water, starting the swimming session he had looked forward to for so long.
With the "Blessing of Melting Water" attribute, he felt as comfortable in the water as if he were back at home, with every part of his body feeling especially wonderful.
[You are swimming. Qi-Blood +1, whole-body muscle strength +1, whole-body muscle coordination +1, water affinity +1, swimming skills +1]
[You are diving. Qi-Blood +1, whole-body muscle strength +1, whole-body muscle coordination +1, water affinity +1, anaerobic capacity +1, water pressure resistance +1, diving skills +1]
Under the influence of "Use It or Lose It," Lin Zichen became like a fish that had lived in the sea from a young age, swimming more and more comfortably in the sea water.
Breaststroke, backstroke, butterfly stroke, freestyle... he tried them all in turn.
Without repeating a single stroke from start to finish.
...
On the shore.
Lying on a chair and enjoying a sunbath, Zhang Wanxin saw Lin Zichen swim so amazingly that she couldn't help feeling surprised and said,
"Husband, look at Xiao Chen! How can he swim so well? I don't recall us taking him to the swimming pool that many times since he was a child, have we?"
"He probably learned it at school."
Lin Yansheng responded nonchalantly, happily sitting nearby grilling a variety of delicious skewered meats.
At that moment, not far ahead, Shen Jianye, standing on a rock, shouted to him,
"Old Lin, come over here, there's a rock we can jump from! I've checked underneath; there are no hard objects, you can jump with confidence!"
"Coming, coming!"
Upon hearing there was a place to dive, Lin Yansheng left his barbecue and jogged over.
Following that, childish yells quickly came from the direction of the rock.
"Woo-hoo, a crow takes flight!"
"Bam!!!"
"Splashhh—"
"Watch my cannonball dive!"
"Bam!!!"
"Splashhh—"
The two adults were getting more and more excited as they jumped, splashing water everywhere, competing to see whose splash was higher.
On the shore, both Zhang Wanxin and Xu Meng were astounded, teasing that these two dads, at their age, were still acting so childishly and were less mature than the kids.
...
Elsewhere.
With his powerful core strength, Lin Zichen was practically motionless as he floated on the surface of the sea, watching the two divers from a distance, finding it quite amusing without thinking it childish at all.
After all, a man is a boy until death, and as a fellow male, he could quite understand this.
"Xiao Chen, don't just swim by yourself, come and teach me how to swim!"
In the shallow water where the sea reached her knees, Shen Qinghan saw Lin Zichen leaving her behind and couldn't help but shout at him a bit aggrievedly.
Upon hearing her, Lin Zichen realized he had been enjoying swimming so much that he had unintentionally left Shen Qinghan behind.
Aware of this, he swam back immediately and started teaching Shen Qinghan how to swim, hand in hand.
...
"Xiao Chen, swimming is so easy, I learned it right away!"
"Xiao Chen, diving is also super easy, I picked it up instantly!"
"Wow, Xiao Chen, I'm so awesome! I've always heard people say it's hard to open your eyes in the sea because it stings, but I don't feel uncomfortable at all, it actually feels rather cool and comfy."
"..."
Under Lin Zichen's tutelage, Shen Qinghan suddenly had an epiphany.
